raw.description:
Position: Road and Trail Program Coordinator

Location: Remote within Canada

Reports to: Manager, Marketing and Events (Domestic Programs)

Classification: Contractor

Duration: 12 months

Overview

Athletics Canada is the national sport organization for track and field, cross county, road, mountain, and trail running. Its purpose is to support high performance athletics excellence at the domestic and international level and to provide leadership in developmental athletics in partnership with its provincial/territorial branch partners. Athletics Canada is a not-for-profit, charitable organization operating under a Board of Directors elected by provincial/territorial members.

The Job

Athletics Canada is seeking an organized, collaborative and passionate Road & Trail Program Coordinator to support the continued growth and development of road running, trail running and mountain running across Canada.

The successful candidate will play an important role in delivering Athletics Canada's national Road & Trail programs and services, working closely with Athletics Canada staff, Provincial/Territorial Branches, event organizers, athletes, coaches, and volunteers. The position will have direct responsibility for several national programs while also supporting the delivery of several Canadian Championships and the Mountain & Trail National Team.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who understands the culture and landscape of road, trail and mountain running and is excited by the opportunity to help build stronger, more accessible and better-connected programs across Canada.

The position reports to the Marketing & Events Manager, while working closely with the Director, Domestic Programs & Safe Sport on program development, policy implementation, governance and the broader Athletics Canada Road & Trail strategy.

Responsibilities

1. Program Development & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Develop strong relationships with Athletics Canada Branches, event organizers, clubs, athletes, coaches, officials and other stakeholders within the Road & Trail community.
  • Provide leadership to the Athletics Canada Off-Track Committee and related working groups.
  • Monitor developments within Canadian and international Road & Trail running and identify opportunities for program improvement.
  • Assist with communications, resources and educational materials for event organizers and participants.
  • Collect and maintain program data and provide regular updates and reports to Athletics Canada staff.
  • Contribute to broader Athletics Canada initiatives that support participation, athlete development, competition and excellence in Road & Trail running.


2. Road, Trail & Mountain Canadian Championships

Support the Marketing & Events Manager in the planning and delivery of Athletics Canada Road, Trail and Mountain Running Canadian Championships, including:

  • Assist with championship documentation, host selection, contracting, and coordination with host organizations.
  • Assist with event planning, timelines, communications and operational requirements.
  • Support championship eligibility, registration, technical and event information.
  • Support championship marketing and promotional activities.
  • Assist with post-event reporting, evaluation and continuous improvement.
  • Develop strong working relationships with Race Directors, Local Organizing Committees, and other event partners.

3. Road Race Label Program

Lead the ongoing delivery and development of the Athletics Canada Road Race Label Program, including:

  • Manage applications, label requirements, agreements and communications with approved Road Race Label events.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for event organizers
  • Coordinate event requirements, including sanctioning, course certification, technical requirements and other Athletics Canada standards.
  • Support the development and implementation of event benefits, marketing opportunities and athlete-facing communications.
  • Monitor program participation and identify opportunities to strengthen the quality, profile and reach of the national road race calendar.
  • Work with Athletics Canada staff and Branches to ensure consistent application of national requirements.

4. Mountain & Trail National Team

Support the delivery and development of Athletics Canada's Mountain & Trail National Team program, including:

  • Support Athletics Canada's participation in international mountain and trail running championships and events.
  • Assist with athlete and coach communications and team administration.
  • Support team selection, registration, travel and logistical planning.
  • Assist with national team event preparation and on-site team operations.
  • Contribute to the continued development of a strong and sustainable national mountain and trail running program.

5. Course Measurement & Certification

Coordinate the Athletics Canada Road Course Measurement & Certification Program, including:

  • Manage applications and communication with event organizers seeking course certification.
  • Maintain an accurate national database of certified courses and renewal dates.
  • Support the transition to updated course certification requirements and processes.
  • Provide guidance to event organizers regarding course measurement and certification requirements.
  • Help develop and coordinate pathways and training for certified course measurers.

6. National Road & Trail Sanctioning

Support the implementation and ongoing administration of the Athletics Canada Road & Trail Sanctioning Framework, including:

  • Work with Athletics Canada Provincial/Territorial Branches and event organizers to support adoption and implementation of national minimum requirements.
  • Assist with the development of tools, resources and communications to support consistent application across Canada.
  • Monitor implementation and identify areas requiring clarification, education or additional support.
  • Work closely with the Director, Domestic Programs & Safe Sport on policy implementation and governance matters.
  • Help ensure that Athletics Canada's national Road & Trail programs are aligned with broader organizational policies and strategic objectives.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of technical knowledge, organizational ability and a genuine understanding of the Road & Trail running community.

  • Understanding of the Road & Trail landscape – Knowledge of competition rules, age categories, competition formats and the culture of the road, trail and mountain running community. Familiarity with event management and delivery is strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills – Ability to manage multiple programs, deadlines, projects and communications streams simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Program coordination experience – Experience coordinating programs, events or projects, ideally within sport, nonprofit, community development or a similar environment.
  • Strong communication skills – Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with athletes, coaches, volunteers, event organizers and organizational partners.
  • Bilingualism – Fluency in both English and French is considered an asset.
  • Athlete and participant focused – Comfortable communicating directly with athletes and participants in an empathetic, respectful and responsive manner and able to work effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and at different stages of their athletic journey.
  • Collaborative mindset – Ability to work effectively with the Athletics Canada Off-Track Committee, Provincial/Territorial Branches, Local Organizing Committees and colleagues across Canada.
  • Solution-oriented approach – Proactively identifies opportunities to improve programs, solve problems and strengthen the overall Road & Trail system.
  • Independent and self-motivated – Comfortable working remotely and managing responsibilities independently while maintaining strong communication with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Passion for sport – Genuine interest in running and a commitment to supporting the growth and development of Road & Trail running in Canada.

Work Location

This is a fully remote position based in Canada.

The position requires occasional evening and weekend work, particularly around competitions, meetings and national team activities.

Regular domestic travel will be required for Canadian Championships, national team activities, meetings and other Athletics Canada events.

Occasional international travel may be required in support of the Mountain & Trail National Team or other international activities.

The position requires the ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining effective communication and collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across Canada.

To Apply

The application deadline is Sunday, November 15th, 2026. We thank all candidates who apply. Athletics Canada is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
At NVIDIA, we are at the forefront of innovation in AI, accelerated computing, and networking. Our work is redefining industries from healthcare and automotive to telecommunications. In this role, you will build and grow NVIDIA's engagement with the global Telco, 6G, and AI-native RAN developer ecosystem, working directly with partners, universities, research institutes, and industry innovators to advance next-generation wireless networks through applied research, hands-on prototyping, and ecosystem development.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in 6G, AI-native RAN, and wireless research. Serve as the trusted technical advisor, problem solver, and champion for the developer ecosystem in Telco, 6G, and AI-native RAN, with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies.
  • Accelerate critical workloads by demonstrating and integrating the NVIDIA software stack (tools, libraries, SDKs, NIMs, and blueprints) into partner products, platforms, and pipelines.
  • Guide partners through onboarding and integration by providing technical resources—such as sample code, guides, and demo pipelines—to accelerate 6G/AI-RAN-specific adoption and foster co-innovation of next-generation solutions.
  • Map and monitor the developer ecosystem to identify growth opportunities, collaborating with engineering, product management, and marketing to inform roadmaps and optimize partner adoption strategies.
  • Engage partner technical leaders to drive best-practice integrations and resolve technical challenges, using regular syncs to track adoption, surface new workflows, and channel critical field insights back to NVIDIA product teams.
  • Establish trusted relationships with leading universities, research institutes, faculty, principal investigators, graduate students, and applied research labs working on 6G, AI-RAN, wireless AI, and accelerated computing; connect their work with NVIDIA platforms, software, research, and product roadmaps.
  • Build hands-on proof-of-concepts and reference prototypes for AI-native RAN—including simulation, algorithm development, model training and inference, system integration, benchmarking, and experimental validation including over the air testing—enabling researchers to adopt NVIDIA technologies through reproducible code, notebooks, sample applications, and technical guides.
  • Represent NVIDIA in academic conferences, technical workshops, 3GPP-related forums, and the AI-RAN Alliance; develop technical contributions and cultivate partnerships across the global 6G research and standards community.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 10+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architect, or product management, including 5+ years of direct hands-on experience in wireless communications, Radio Access Network (RAN) architecture, advanced algorithm development, or applied AI research—including experience working with universities, research institutes, or collaborative research programs.
  • Proven experience leading, partnering, and scaling developer programs at major technology companies, and Telco/6G/AI-RAN ISVs, or within relevant verticals.
  • Significant technical depth in Telco and wireless communications software including AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), wireless simulation environments (MATLAB, Python-based simulators, software-defined radio, over the air RAN testbeds), GPU-accelerated computing, and RAN software stacks, and contributions to product integrations and software libraries.
  • Experience leading technical collaborations with engineering and product teams—including architectural design, code reviews, technical mentorship, and delivery of technical talks or workshops.
  • Proven ability to structure and implement complex technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal or external collaborators (across sales, legal, product, or marketing teams as needed).
  • Skilled at distilling complex technical concepts for audiences from engineers to executives, with end-to-end experience in defining, integrating, building, and jointly marketing solutions with strategic ISV partners.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing vertical-specific solutions (e.g., network stacks, AI-native RAN algorithms, PHY-layer signal processing pipelines, or end-to-end 5G/6G RAN prototype systems).
  • Familiarity with advanced computing, AI, and/or GPU acceleration platforms (CUDA, Aerial SDK, TensorRT, NeMo, cuBLAS, or other NVIDIA frameworks relevant to AI-native wireless and accelerated RAN).
  • Successful history of building and scaling developer communities and delivering impactful technical enablement programs.
  • Expertise in building frameworks to capture developer sentiment and market shifts, translating real-time ecosystem dynamics into actionable intelligence for Telco/6G/AI-RAN industry strategy and product rationalization.
  • Published IEEE or ACM research, 3GPP contributions, or recognized technical leadership in AI for wireless or AI-native RAN; established relationships and engagement across the global 6G research ecosystem including universities, government-funded research programs, and industry consortia such as the AI-RAN Alliance and O-RAN Alliance.

If you're eager to contribute to crafting the future of telecommunications and meet the above qualifications, we’d love to hear from you. Submit your application and join NVIDIA as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
The Technical Lead (Salesforce) is a senior individual contributor responsible for technical execution quality and engineering enablement for Sonexus Salesforce solutions, with primary focus on ConnectSource and Marketing Cloud. This role provides deep technical leadership, Salesforce architecture awareness, and bridges engineering teams with business and delivery stakeholders by translating business intent into sound Salesforce designs and implementation decisions.

The Technical Lead owns technical standards, code/configuration quality, design integrity, and technical risk mitigation, partnering closely with Solution Owners, Product, and cross‑functional teams to ensure Salesforce solutions are built and operated reliably through disciplined SDLC practices.

The Technical Lead is in place to ensure how we build is consistent, secure, scalable, and reliable—reducing technical ambiguity, improving engineering execution, and minimizing rework and production risk through disciplined technical leadership and enablement.

Within Sonexus, Software Engineering plays a critical role in enabling Patient Access and Support Services through reliable technology platforms that support patient journeys, program operations, and client engagements.

Responsibilities

Technical Ownership & Execution Quality

  • Own technical execution quality for Salesforce solution areas, including implementation approach and delivery of technical/config components to agreed standards
  • Lead design and code/configuration reviews (e.g., Apex, integrations, Flows, security model, data model) to ensure standards and best practices are met
  • Identify Salesforce platform risks early and propose options, tradeoffs, and mitigation plans in partnership with delivery leadership

Architecture Awareness & Technical Direction

  • Provide Salesforce architecture awareness (data model, permissioning, integration patterns, environment strategy) to ensure components fit end‑to‑end
  • Define and reinforce Salesforce standards/patterns to promote consistency and reuse
  • Create supporting technical documentation (design decisions, integration contracts, deployment notes) to guide critical decisions and continuity

SDLC Enablement & Engineering Discipline

  • Ensure Salesforce work is planned and executed with SDLC rigor (requirements → design → build/config → test → release), including change control and operational readiness expectations
  • Define tasks, milestones, and technical deliverables; independently determine technical methods (configuration vs custom code vs integration approach)

Run Stability, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with run/support teams to improve Salesforce stability through monitoring/telemetry, defect trend analysis, and root‑cause analysis
  • Drive technical debt remediation (org health, automation cleanup, integration hardening) to reduce incidents and rework
  • Provide technical guidance to managed service/external partners as applicable

Cross‑Functional Partnership & Influence

  • Translate technical concepts into clear language for non‑technical stakeholders
  • Partner with Solution Owners and Product on selecting appropriate Salesforce components aligned to standards while meeting requirements
  • Partner with shared service teams (Risk/Security) to ensure controls are implemented properly
  • Serve as escalation point for complex Salesforce technical issues, leading resolution paths that minimize business impact

​Coaching & Technical Leadership

  • Mentor engineers/admins and raise Salesforce technical maturity through standards and review practices
  • Coach less experienced colleagues and lead complex technical initiatives with significant scope and long‑term impact

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience preferred
  • 8+ years of hands‑on application development experience (custom and/or enterprise platforms) preferred
  • Strong Salesforce technical experience (configuration + integration + SDLC delivery)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives and resolve production issues effectively
  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and enterprise CRM integrations preferred
  • Experience with build/run operational practices, security controls, and regulated environments preferred
  • Experience producing reusable Salesforce patterns, standards, and technical roadmaps preferred

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
  • Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models
  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope
  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact
  • Provides solutions which may set precedent
  • Independently determines method for completion of new projects
  • Receives guidance on overall project objectives
  • Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Benefits: Paid Time Off | Retirement with Employer Match | Health and Wellness Benefits | Learning and Development Opportunities | Competitive Pay | Bonus Scheme | Recognition | Employee Stock Purchase Plan I Inclusive & Supportive Culture


Your Challenge:

  • Lead and develop a strategic global key account in the commercial vehicle/OEM sector, ensuring growth and excellence.
  • Drive revenue growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction, acting as the primary point of contact for the assigned account.
  • Design and execute a structured global account strategy that aligns with evolving business objectives and market trends.
  • Cultivate and strengthen long-term relationships, supporting sustainable partnerships and mutual success.
  • Drive targeted hunting activities to win new customers in region.
  • Strong ability to independently hunt and convert new business opportunities.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills across diverse cultures and geographies.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively in a fast-paced, international environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a talent for strategic planning and execution.
  • Manage and expand OEM customer relationships within the assigned sales territory
  • Develop and implement sales strategies to drive revenue growth
  • Identify new business opportunities and market trends
  • Proactively engage new prospects to grow revenue beyond existing OEM portfolio.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Product Management, Marketing, Technical Support)
  • Negotiate contracts and pricing
  • Provide regular sales reports to the Sales Director

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field
  • Several years of experience in sales, ideally within the OEM sector
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Self-motivated, structured work style, and high initiative
  • Fluent in English and preferably in French or at least another European language

About Us:

Customer Support Specialist, APAC

a-tune (a Transnetyx company) | Australia (remote), Melbourne or southern Australia preferred | Full-time

Location: Fully remote, home-based in Melbourne or Southern Australia (AEST/AEDT)

Department: Support & Service Delivery

Travel: Up to 10% of the time, domestically and internationally. This may include onsite customer visits once you are fully trained, the APAC User Group Meeting every second year, and in-person training or team meetings.

Compensation: $85,000–$100,000 AUD per year, plus superannuation, depending on qualifications and experience.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Do you have a background in life science or animal research, and enjoy solving problems and building relationships? Join a-tune as our Customer Support Specialist for the Asia-Pacific region and become the trusted voice of the customer for research institutions using tick@lab, our animal colony management software.

Our APAC community is highly engaged and values having a dedicated advocate in the region. You will be that person. Your day-to-day will focus on supporting the customer. As you grow in the role, you will take on more regional customer care and Voice of the Customer work, becoming the primary communication channel between APAC customers and our global teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer support (your core focus)

  • Be the first point of contact for tick@lab Support in APAC, resolving issues submitted through our web-based support portal.
  • Own customer communication from first contact through resolution, prioritising and escalating urgent issues to meet service levels.
  • Partner with Technical Support, Configuration, Product and Development when an issue needs deeper expertise, and coordinate regional coverage with our APAC Technical Support Specialist.
  • Keep accurate ticket records and keep customers informed of updates through the tick@lab support hub.

Regional customer care and community

  • Lead regular check-ins with assigned customers to review open items, listen to concerns and escalate urgent matters.
  • Host the quarterly APAC community meeting (virtual to start, with the potential for onsite meetings once fully trained), sharing new features and creating space for customers to learn from each other.
  • Help shape and plan the APAC User Group Meeting, held every second year.
  • Understand the regulatory requirements of customers across the region and apply them to your support, meetings and events.
  • Partner with our Customer Success Manager and Project Leads on account health and training needs, and provide technical training for clients.

Team contribution and growth

  • Advocate for APAC customer needs and bring their feedback to Product and Development, following requests through to a clear outcome.
  • Build strong working relationships with our global Support teams, Product and Development, and Sales in the region.
  • Own your onboarding and training, including in-person training with our US team.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Essential

  • Bachelor of Science in Biology or a related life science discipline.
  • At least one year of experience in a customer-facing or client support role, such as supporting customers, researchers or facility users.
  • Ability to learn software quickly and troubleshoot user issues using sound analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High-level written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical information clearly to customers and stakeholders at all levels.
  • The ability to stay calm, confident and professional when managing escalations and advocating for customers.
  • Experience facilitating virtual meetings with customer groups and building relationships at all levels, including institutional leadership.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise a varied workload and respond promptly to urgent issues.
  • The ability to work autonomously as our sole team member in the region, with sound judgement on when to resolve, escalate or seek guidance.

Highly regarded

  • Experience in animal research, such as working as an animal technician, colony manager or in a similar role within a laboratory or research animal facility.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting customers in a technology or software-as-a-service (SaaS) environment.
  • Familiarity with the Australian Code for the Care and Use of Animals for Scientific Purposes and working with Animal Ethics Committees.
  • Awareness of animal research regulatory requirements in New Zealand and the wider Asia-Pacific region, or the ability to develop this knowledge quickly.
  • Experience using colony management, laboratory information or similar database systems.

WORKING ARRANGEMENTS

This is a full-time, remote role based in Australia, with a preference for Melbourne or southern Australia, where most of our APAC customers are located. You will report to our Director of Global Customer Support, who is based in the US (Central Time).

  • Flexible schedule: You will join regular early-morning meetings with our US and EU teams, typically around 7:00 AM AEST/AEDT, one to two mornings per week. Your working hours will be adjusted to balance these commitments.
  • Travel: Up to 10% of the time, domestically and internationally. This may include onsite customer visits once you are fully trained, the APAC User Group Meeting every second year, and in-person training or team meetings.
  • Work rights: You must have full working rights in Australia.
  • Employment: This role is employed through our Australian employment partner, with benefits in line with Australian employment standards.

SALARY

$85,000–$100,000 AUD per year, plus superannuation, depending on qualifications and experience.

WHY JOIN US

At a-tune, a Transnetyx company, our work serves the research community, and our culture is built on our Pursue the Pulse YX values: every person has a voice, be yourself, be kind, stay curious, and leave every interaction better than you found it.

  • Be the dedicated advocate a highly engaged regional community has asked for, with real influence on how our products evolve.
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing learning, including in-person training with our global Support team.
  • A culture of belonging, collaboration and fairness, with year-round heritage and diversity celebrations and community giving through YX Gives.

raw.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

This regionally aligned team (Northeast, Southeast, Central, and West) will manage the launch and ongoing lifecycle of Revolution Medicines’ approved therapies using a patient centric model.

This role requires a strategic team player with deep expertise in oncology market access, clinical knowledge, and a passion for ensuring no patient is left behind.

The Field Reimbursement Director (FRD) serves as key field-based expert in market access and the subject matter expert in navigating the reimbursement and access landscape for healthcare providers, office staff, and other critical stakeholders. This role provides education across the entire access journey, with deep expertise in prior authorization processes, coverage criteria, and payer-specific requirements across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid plans.

This role requires strong business acumen, an understanding of the national payer environment, and the ability to build trusted relationships with provider offices, HUB services, Nurse Case Managers, specialty pharmacies, and internal cross-functional partners. The FRD ensures a positive customer experience by delivering clear guidance, resolving issues efficiently, and supporting timely and appropriate patient access to therapy.

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively address patient access barriers by working with customers and accounts to resolve complex access issues, including prior authorizations, appeals, and denials.

  • Monitor and support resolution of access issues for hub-enrolled patients.

  • Educate private practices, Oncology groups/facilities, and their staff on patient support programs, coverage, and payer policies.

  • Accountable for ensuring access barriers are minimized, for appropriate patients, to obtain Revolution Medicines’ approved therapies.

  • Deliver clear and actionable information to practice managers, billing staff, nurses, and case workers to improve their understanding of payer policies and processes.

  • Report Payer trends related to approved products to Patient Services and Market Access account management teams.

  • Provide expertise within the national/regional Payer landscape to educate providers and office staff, on navigating the access process and payer trends.

  • Leverage market insights to anticipate customer needs and develop strategies that maintain a competitive edge.

  • Ensure that all activities and interactions adhere to relevant pharmaceutical regulations, industry standards, and ethical guidelines.

  • Maintain rigorous documentation standards to ensure access barriers are tracked, addressed, and compliantly resolved in alignment with a “no patient left behind” mindset.

  • Foster a culture grounded in patient advocacy, compassion, compliance, customer centricity, urgency, and collaboration.

  • Create and manage a “one-team” mindset with other critical access teams, including third-party hub provider, non-commercial pharmacy, third-party copay provider, RNCM Team, Medical, Quality Control, and Patient Access leadership.

  • Travel as needed to home office as applicable and external meetings and conferences.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • 7 to 9+ years of experience in oncology, Field Reimbursement, Market Access or Patient Services.

  • Capability to develop strategic account plans in collaboration with cross functional partners.

  • Proven track record of success, meeting or exceeding business KPIs.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret sales data, market trends, and customer insights.

  • Experience working in CRM systems and sales analytics tools.

  • Ability to travel as required ~60% of the time to meet with customers and attend industry events.

  • Proven experience supporting specialty or oral oncology launches (start-up or high-growth environments strongly preferred).

  • Deep understanding of payer dynamics, specialty pharmacy and distribution models, reimbursement processes, and patient support program operations.

  • Exceptional skills in communication, compliant documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred Skills:

  • Advance degree (MSN, MBA, MHA, other).

  • Launch and customer-facing experience.

  • Experience with targeted oncology product experience strongly preferred.

  • Experience in a smaller, rapidly growing company preferred.

Our base pay salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. raw.excerpt: Joining NVIDIA's DGX Cloud AI Efficiency Team means advancing the performance, efficiency, and resiliency of large-scale AI workloads.
raw.description:
Joining NVIDIA's DGX Cloud AI Efficiency Team means advancing the performance, efficiency, and resiliency of large-scale AI workloads. We help AI researchers and platform teams understand end-to-end behavior across GPUs, networking, storage, and software stacks. We are seeking a Senior Performance Engineer to characterize workloads, establish performance baselines, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive optimizations from investigation through deployment. Your work will shape scalable DGX Cloud systems, turn complex measurements into prioritized engineering decisions, and continuously raise the performance and reliability of AI workloads. Join our technically diverse team of infrastructure experts to unlock more efficient AI at scale.

What you'll be doing:

  • Analyze end-to-end performance of large-scale AI workloads across compute, network, storage, and software stacks.

  • Design and execute rigorous performance studies to establish baselines, diagnose regressions, and quantify bottlenecks.

  • Define performance and efficiency evaluation methodologies, benchmarks, and success metrics for AI workloads.

  • Use profiling, observability, and data analysis to turn performance measurements into actionable optimization plans.

  • Partner with deep learning engineers, platform teams, and GPU architects to validate and deliver performance improvements.

  • Communicate performance findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to influence system and software design decisions.

What we need to see:

  • BS or higher degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 12+ years of experience in strong programming skills in C++ and Python, with the ability to build reliable analysis and automation workflows

  • Solid foundation in operating systems, computer architecture, and distributed systems

  • Experience with performance engineering, benchmarking, profiling, and optimization of complex software or systems

  • Ability to communicate technical findings, prioritize high-impact work, and build alignment across teams

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience analyzing large-scale AI clusters or distributed training and inference workloads

  • Experience with CUDA, GPU computing systems, and GPU performance analysis

  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX/XLA

  • Deep understanding of system-level performance analysis, workload characterization, and optimization

NVIDIA leads the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions, from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for exceptional people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 1, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Role Title: Principal Engineer / Professor — Technical Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in an engineering or physical science field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

micro1 is engaging principal-level engineers, scientists, and faculty to design the technical problems that measure what AI systems can actually do. Your domain expertise is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

We’re building this across four areas: aerospace, semiconductors, manufacturing and industrial engineering, and materials science. If your work sits in one of those — or across two of them — this is for you.

The work draws on what you already know: the problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong.

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area, with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in engineering, physics, materials, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major engineering organization, a national lab, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one area, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another expert could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role
  3. Profile review
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

Role Title: Game Developer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Game Developers to contribute to a pioneering customer project focused on evaluating and advancing AI capabilities in the domain of game creation and interaction. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Leverage your hands-on experience to build authentic debugging and feature challenges within real game projects, directly impacting how AI agents learn to analyze, play, and develop games. Developers from all backgrounds—whether from AAA studios, indie circles, or solo projects—are encouraged to participate.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and build small-scale game projects or interactive scenes in a major game engine to serve as the foundation for assessment tasks.
  2. Integrate realistic gameplay bugs that require thorough playtesting and on-screen analysis to discover and resolve.
  3. Develop multifaceted gameplay feature challenges that rely on multiple in-game systems and mechanics.
  4. Draft clear and concise briefs for each task, emulating the style of instructions from players, designers, or producers.
  5. Create comprehensive reference solutions—including both bug fixes and feature implementations—for every assignment.
  6. Define detailed success criteria, including input sequences, expected visual outcomes, and verifiable in-game states.
  7. Conduct end-to-end playtesting of each task to guarantee reliability and solvability.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in game development, whether in AAA, indie, solo, or serious hobby contexts.
  2. A portfolio or verifiable published work (personal site, itch.io, Steam, GitHub, game jam entries, or shipped title credits). Your portfolio is the most important part of your application and plays a major role in our selection, so please include the work that best represents your skills.
  3. Advanced proficiency with at least one major game engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), including editor tools, scene management, and debugging utilities.
  4. Comfort with engine scripting languages such as C#, GDScript, C++, or Blueprints, with the ability to interpret, troubleshoot, and enhance gameplay logic.
  5. Proven ability to identify and resolve gameplay issues through iterative playtesting.
  6. Strong written communication skills for drafting precise task instructions and acceptance criteria.
  7. Experience in game QA, technical design, systems design, automated testing, or prior contribution to AI evaluation projects is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

raw.description:
Director of Development & Automation

Why Digacore?

We’re a fast-paced, people-first MSP recently recognized as one of New Jersey’s Top Workplaces for 2026, with:

  • Real career growth
  • Autonomy to own projects and make decisions
  • A collaborative culture (we back each other up — no egos)
  • The chance to shape a function — your structure, your standards, your scorecard

About the Role

Reports to: CTO

We’re looking for a Director to take ownership of Digacore’s Development & Automation (DNA) team — a capable group of developers, data, product, and AI specialists working across three streams: AI services for clients, internal data and reporting, and a client-facing software product. The direction is set; now it needs a leader to turn it into structure, consistency, and results, so the CTO can step back from the day-to-day.

You’ll start by getting to know the team and what’s in flight, then put the foundation in place — SOPs, guidelines, a delivery cadence, and KPIs that give leadership a clear view of where things stand — and grow the team as the work demands. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock a build or prove out a solution, but your impact comes from leading through others, not writing the code yourself.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the existing team: learn each person’s strengths, set clear ownership, and manage each one the way they need — including senior specialists who are deeper than you in their own domains
  • Set the standards: write and roll out SOPs and guidelines for how the team works — intake, prioritization, delivery, documentation, and handoffs — starting with our repeatable client AI Services processes
  • Own the KPIs: define and track the metrics that prove impact (time to deploy, delivery against dates, time saved, adoption, ROI) and give the CTO a clear monthly view of what’s on track and what isn’t
  • Run the team’s weekly delivery cadence so every initiative has an owner, a priority, a next step — and status is visible at any point without chasing people down
  • Own the roadmap across all three streams — when urgent asks compete, decide what comes first, what waits, and what doesn’t happen, and reset expectations with stakeholders
  • Take ownership of client AI engagements — assessment, setup, training, and custom builds — so they move from signed to live quickly and run without escalating to the CTO
  • Oversee product releases with the Product Owner and developers — pressure-test estimates, surface risk early, and hold to commitments
  • Back the internal data and reporting work — the data warehouse and leadership scorecard, including AI Services results — so leadership gets numbers it trusts
  • Be the escalation point on client issues — including security, compliance, and data privacy questions — and prepare the team to handle them well
  • Partner with leadership and department heads to identify manual work and friction, and turn it into automation and AI solutions
  • Grow the team when needed — identify gaps, define new roles, and hire and onboard as the function scales
  • Own tooling and vendor decisions, budget input, and capacity planning for the function

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Every team member known with clear ownership, and every initiative inventoried with an owner, priority, and next step
  • A weekly delivery cadence running, and a monthly KPI report the CTO can read in two minutes
  • Core SOPs written and followed, starting with client AI deployment
  • The CTO out of routine client engagements, with client builds moving from signed to live on a fast, predictable timeline
  • Shipped wins with documented ROI, and a clear view of where the team needs to grow next

What You Bring

  • Proven leadership: 7+ years in automation, development, data, or technical operations, including 3+ years leading a technical team with direct reports — coaching, accountability, and running a delivery cadence
  • You’ve built the playbook: a track record of putting SOPs, operating rhythms, and KPIs in place for a team that didn’t have them — and getting people to actually follow them
  • Experience leading people more technical than you — you set outcomes and check progress without micromanaging
  • Shipped AI, automation, or software that moved a measurable number — not pilots and slide decks
  • Strong technical grounding in the Microsoft stack (M365/Azure, Power Platform, Power BI), APIs, and integrations — enough to unblock, review, and build when needed
  • Comfortable in client-facing work, including tough conversations around data, security, and compliance
  • Strong business translation — you turn “we need X” from non-technical stakeholders into a delivered solution
  • Thrives in a lean, fast-moving environment — candidates who need heavy corporate structure won’t be the right fit

Nice to Have

  • MSP, SaaS, or multi-client service experience
  • Background in software product delivery or data/BI leadership

Compensation:

$150,000–$180,000 Annually (depending on experience)

Perks & Benefits

  • Nationwide medical, dental, life, and LTD insurance (we cover LTD + life 100%)
  • Generous PTO + Mental Health Days
  • 401(k) with company match
  • HSA & FSA options
  • Paid training & certification assistance
  • $500 sign-on bonus
  • Quarterly team events and career coaching
  • Equal opportunity employer — veterans encouraged to apply

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer!

Salary: $150,000-$180,000, DOE

raw.description:
Position Summary

As ICU Medical transitions to Workday, this role will support the implementation of Workday, with a focus on the Integrations and Reporting/Analytics workstreams, by assisting with requirements documentation, testing, data validation, reporting, and post-go-live support. Working under the direction of the Workday Program Manager, the HRIS Manager and senior project team members, this position will partner with the functional HR, Finance, IT & Training business leaders to ensure integrations requirements are collected and mirrored in our Workday platform. Reporting & Analytics will also be a key focus for this role. Ensuring current data reporting is available and no business gaps are created with the deployment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Workday Report Development

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced Workday reports (Advanced, Matrix, Composite) and complex calculated fields across HCM, Recruiting, Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Talent, and Payroll.
  • Build reporting solutions that account for Workday security model impacts (domain, role-based, and user-based security), ensuring accurate, appropriately scoped data for each audience.
  • Build and manage dashboards and discovery boards to deliver self-service analytics to HR leadership and COE partners.
  • Serve as an escalation point for report defects, performance issues, and complex data interpretation questions, and evaluate new reporting features with each biannual Workday release.

Integrations

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain Workday integrations using EIB, XSLT, Document Transformation, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Studio, and Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST APIs).
  • Develop and support inbound and outbound integrations across Workday HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and various third-party vendors.
  • Partner with Workday analysts and business stakeholders to gather integration requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs.
  • Own the full integration lifecycle, including requirements gathering, functional and technical design, development, UAT, deployment, and post-production support.
  • Design and maintain custom reports that serve as data sources for outbound integrations, including web service-enabled reports (RaaS) consumed by downstream systems and vendors.
  • Develop integration audit, reconciliation, and error reporting to monitor data flows between Workday and connected systems.
  • Partner with the HRIS team on reporting requirements for integrations built on EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, and Orchestrate, and validate report-based integration outputs during testing cycles and biannual releases.
  • Ensure all integrations comply with data privacy, security, and audit requirements, aligning with organizational and regulatory standards.

Team & Platform Partnership

  • Support Workday bi-annual releases by assessing potential impacts, conducting regression testing, and implementing required updates.
  • Collaborate closely with the HRIS team on configuration changes, integrations, and platform enhancements that affect reporting.
  • Mentor report writers and analysts, and contribute to reporting standards, naming conventions, and best practices.
  • Advise on data quality, governance, and audit readiness, and identify opportunities to extend analytics beyond native Workday via Prism Analytics or Power BI.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong technical expertise in Workday integrations (EIB, XSLT, DT, Core Connectors, Studio, SOAP/REST).
  • Experience supporting integrations across Workday HCM and Financials.
  • Ability to gather and translate business requirements into scalable, reliable integration solutions.
  • Proficiency with web services and APIs.
  • Advanced skills in Workday calculated fields and report creation.
  • Strong ability to prioritize work, manage time independently, and follow through on tasks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Basic project management skills, including scoping work, planning tasks, and communicating progress.
  • This role involves interaction and collaboration with other departments and requires excellent judgment and interpersonal skills.
  • Natural self-starter and creative problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset.

Minimum Qualifications, Education & Experience

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent relevant work experience, is preferred.
  • 6+ years of hands-on Workday reporting & integrations development and support experience in a production environment.
  • Proficiency in EIB, XsLT, DT, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Studio, Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST APIs). Workday Certification preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Workday Security concepts including domain and business process security policies, security groups, and ISU configuration.
  • Proficiency in creating complex calculated fields and reports.

Work Environment

  • This is largely a sedentary role.
  • Typically requires travel less than 5% of the time.

raw.title: Recruitment & Client Support Virtual Assistant (NDIS/ Aged Care)
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE COMPANYOur client is a registered NDIS provider delivering mentoring, support work and group programs across South Australia and Queensland, with around 118 staff and 280 participants.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is a registered NDIS provider delivering mentoring, support work and group programs across South Australia and Queensland, with around 118 staff and 280 participants. They help people build skills, develop confidence and receive the support they need in their day-to-day lives. Recruitment, report preparation and after-hours phone cover are pulling their local recruiter, team leaders and managers away from other work, so they are looking for a reliable, organised Virtual Assistant to take these on.

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • We are looking for a reliable, organised Virtual Assistant to support three key areas: recruitment, participant report preparation and after-hours phone support.

  • You will screen applicants, conduct pre-screen calls, arrange interviews, prepare draft participant reports using the client's systems, and assist staff and families with enquiries and roster changes.

  • The scale is real. Each job advertisement can bring in 200 to 300 applicants, and around 240 participant reports are needed every four months, so organisation and attention to detail are essential.

  • Excellent customer service and clear, confident spoken and written English are essential. Previous NDIS experience, particularly in rostering or service coordination, will be highly regarded. Training will be provided in the client's systems, processes and reporting requirements.

  • The client's recruiter and managers interview and choose every hire, and Team Leaders review and finalise every report. This role prepares, checks and supports, and escalates anything outside its authority.

  • This is a home-based role, working as part of the client's team. The client is also moving to a new CRM, so being quick to learn new systems matters.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To give the client's recruiter a steady flow of suitable, well-screened applicants with clear notes and organised interview bookings, to prepare accurate and well-checked draft participant reports for Team Leader review, and to provide calm, professional after-hours and weekend phone and rostering support for participants, families and staff.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    ▸ Recruitment Screening & Coordination

    • Review resumes against current recruitment priorities, including location, availability, relevant experience and role requirements

    • Identify applicants suited to specific service areas, for example candidates available to work in North Brisbane

    • Use an AI screening tool to help review large volumes of applications, and check the results before relying on them

    • Conduct phone pre-screens using an agreed checklist to confirm suitability, communication skills, availability and required credentials

    • Maintain accurate applicant records, including screening outcomes and any outstanding information

    • Book suitable applicants into the Recruiter's calendar for interviews and provide clear screening notes

    • Communicate professionally with applicants and follow up where information is missing

      • ▸ Participant Report Preparation

      • Monitor the CRM for upcoming quarterly and end-of-plan reports

      • Download the relevant case notes and access the participant's recorded goals and profile information

      • Use the client's approved AI reporting agent to generate draft reports

      • Review drafts against the client's reporting guidelines, checking that the correct participant and reporting period are used, information is clear, consistent and easy to understand, goals align with those recorded in the participant's profile, statements about progress are supported by the case notes, and obvious errors, contradictions or missing information are flagged

      • Refer unclear information to the relevant Team Leader rather than making assumptions

      • Prepare drafts for Team Leader review and follow-through, and keep report status records up to date

      • Note: this role prepares and checks draft reports. Team Leaders remain responsible for reviewing and finalising them

        • ▸ After-Hours Phone & Rostering Support

        • Act as the primary phone contact between 4:00 pm and 7:00 pm on rostered working days, and provide coverage during agreed weekend shifts

        • Respond warmly and professionally to calls from participants, families and staff

        • Assist with cancellations, staff availability, shift changes and other routine roster enquiries

        • Make roster adjustments within training, approved procedures and delegated authority

        • Record calls, actions taken and outstanding follow-up clearly in the appropriate system

        • Escalate urgent matters, incidents, safety concerns and issues outside your authority to the designated Team Leader or on-call contact

        • Provide clear handovers so outstanding matters can be followed through

          • ▸ Processes & Team

          • Follow documented procedures and help document processes as tasks are handed over, so each task has an SOP

          • Take part in team chats and meetings and build relationships with local colleagues

            • ▸ Hours & Location

          • Remote, home based. 11:00 am to 7:00 pm Adelaide time, with primary phone coverage from 4:00 pm to 7:00 pm, planned as Wednesday to Sunday including weekend shifts

          • The applicable time zone, working days and weekend roster will be confirmed before commencement

          • Reliable internet and a quiet, professional environment for phone calls required

MUST-HAVE (ESSENTIAL)

  • Excellent spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently over the phone

  • Strong written English, reading comprehension and attention to detail

  • A warm, patient and professional customer service approach

  • Sound judgement, including knowing when to resolve an issue and when to escalate it

  • Strong organisation and the ability to manage competing priorities and interruptions

  • Confidence using CRMs, calendars, online documents and AI-assisted tools, and quick to learn new systems

  • Ability to follow procedures, maintain accurate records and handle confidential information appropriately

  • Proven experience in a customer service, administration, recruitment support or coordination role (2+ years is ideal)

  • A friendly, proactive communicator who joins team chats and builds relationships with local colleagues

  • Reliable internet and a quiet, professional environment for phone calls

  • Availability for the agreed working hours and weekend roster

NICE-TO-HAVE (HIGHLY REGARDED)

  • Knowledge of the NDIS and disability support services

  • Rostering, scheduling or service coordination experience

  • Recruitment administration and phone screening

  • Customer service involving participants, families or support staff

  • Reviewing reports or checking AI-generated content for accuracy and clarity

  • Experience supporting Australian clients or businesses

  • Social media and SEO blog writing

Essential Skills and Attributes

  • Excellent spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently over the phone

  • Strong written English, reading comprehension and attention to detail

  • A warm, patient and professional customer service approach

  • Sound judgement, including knowing when to resolve an issue and when to escalate it

  • Strong organisation and the ability to manage competing priorities and interruptions

  • Confidence using CRMs, calendars, online documents and AI-assisted tools, and quick to learn new systems

  • Ability to follow procedures, maintain accurate records and handle confidential information appropriately

  • A friendly, proactive communicator who joins team chats and takes an active interest in the client's work

  • Reliable internet and a quiet, professional environment for phone calls

  • Availability for the agreed working hours and weekend roster

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit a CV along with a short cover note outlining your years of relevant experience, whether you have worked with Australian clients, any NDIS, rostering or recruitment experience, and your availability for the working hours and weekend roster, including your notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted to progress to the next stage of the process, which includes a phone screen and a recorded video interview.

raw.description:
Location: UK (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time

Position: Senior Support Engineer

Minimum Experience: 5+ years of experience in software support, infrastructure support, or a similar technical role, with significant time spent handling complex Level 2 issues

Compensation: £38,000

Summary:

BlackRainbow is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Senior Support Engineer to provide
technical support across its SaaS and self-hosted platforms. The role will take ownership of complex
incidents, service requests and technical escalations as well as combine advanced troubleshooting
with professional customer communication.

Who We Are:

BlackRainbow was created to solve investigation case-management inefficiencies experienced by
investigators in law enforcement, government intelligence sectors and large corporate

organisations.

We have grown rapidly since bringing our NIMBUS product to market and are working towards
becoming the standard bearer for innovative investigation case-management solutions globally.
We have worked as, and alongside, investigators in more than forty countries over the past two
decades. This experience helps us understand investigative challenges and develop solutions that
meet the needs of investigators and analysts.

What we are looking for:

The Senior Support Engineer will play a key role in ensuring our customers receive fast, effective, and technically sound support across both our SaaS and self‑hosted environments. They will take ownership of complex issues, lead root‑cause investigations, and contribute to improvements that strengthen our product reliability and customer experience. Working closely with BlackRainbow’s Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams, they will help shape best practices, evolve our documentation, and mentor others within the team.

Our ideal candidate brings deep technical troubleshooting experience, a strong understanding of modern infrastructure, and a proactive mindset for preventing issues before they arise. Experience working within ITIL frameworks, along with knowledge of standards such as ISO 27001 and ISO 9001, would be highly beneficial. We’re looking for someone who is calm under pressure, confident in managing high‑priority incidents, and motivated to drive continuous improvement across the support function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate & resolve complex technical issues, reducing unnecessary escalation and
    improving resolution times and overall support quality.
  • Maintain high standards of ticket and case management, ensuring accurate
    prioritisation/categorisation, troubleshooting evidence, customer communication,
    escalation information and auditable records throughout the ticket lifecycle.
  • Support major incident identification, technical diagnosis, service restoration and post
    incident review.
  • Identify and resolve recurring problems through root-cause analysis and controlled
    change
  • Develop and maintain high-quality technical knowledge, including troubleshooting guides,
    known errors and runbooks, helping improve self-service, resolution quality, onboarding and
    consistency across the support function.
  • Provide technical leadership and coaching to the wider Support team as well as senior
    operational cover where formally required.
  • Collaborate effectively across all specialist resolver groups, working with Product & Platform,
    Security, Enablement, Solution Consultants and Customer Success to coordinate complex
    investigations, remediation, customer-specific issues and technical escalations.
  • Drive proactive service and continuous improvement, using support trends, recurring issues,
    customer feedback and operational knowledge to improve service quality, customer
    experience, support efficiency and the prevention of repeat issues.

    Essential Requirements

  • Ability to pass DBS, NPPV3 & SC Vetting
  • Practical experience working within an ITIL-aligned support environment.
  • Five or more years’ experience in software support, SaaS support, infrastructure support or
    a comparable technical support role.
  • Significant experience operating at Level 2 or Tier 2 and managing complex technical cases.
  • Proven experience supporting both cloud-hosted and self-hosted or on-premises customer
    environments.
  • Experience owning customer issues from initial investigation through escalation, resolution
    and closure.
  • Experience managing high-priority incidents and working in a structured incident-response
    environment.
  • Demonstrable experience collaborating with other specialist resolver teams.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or supporting team development.

WHY JOIN BLACK RAINBOW?

Black Rainbow is ambitious, driven and deeply cares about the ability to make a difference to people’s lives with our software. Be a part of our team as we scale up.

Some of our benefits:

  • Fully remote working, including working-from-home expenses.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Twenty-five days’ annual leave in addition to public holidays.
  • Workplace Pension.
  • Private healthcare, including eligible family members.
  • Death-in-service cover at three times annual salary.
  • Training and professional-development support.
  • Regular company meet-ups.

If you who have the required skills and experience, together with the drive and ambition to succeed in this role, please apply via the BambooHR link in our career page.

raw.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs Labeling
raw.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is seeking a Director, Regulatory Affairs Labeling, who will drive cross-functional development and execution of global regulatory labeling strategy for pipeline, late stage, and marketed products. This individual will manage regulatory labeling through all phases of development and post-approval, ensuring that the latest requirements and standards are met. This is an opportunity to join a growing regulatory organization and provide a direct impact on new label development and process initiatives at Revolution Medicines.

The position can be based at our Redwood City, CA site in a hybrid work schedule (preferred) or remote-based with quarterly and as needed travel.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to develop labeling strategy.

  • Manage development, review, and approval of high-quality labeling, including Target Labeling, Core Labeling (e.g., Company Core Data Sheet [CCDS]), and Regional Labeling (e.g., USPI, EU SmPC), in a timely manner according to internal SOPs and external regulatory requirements.

  • Lead cross-functional Labeling Working Group and Senior Labeling Committee meetings.

  • Maintain expertise regarding key labeling requirements and stay current with labeling guidelines/regulations as they pertain to the development/maintenance of labeling and advise key stakeholders on the application of these labeling principles.

  • Research the content of other labels in the same therapeutic class, including competitor labeling, to help guide the team in developing labeling text, including contingency strategy development for negotiation with regulatory authorities.

  • Responsible for proofreading and departmental QC work; ensure quality of labeling deliverables (e.g., alignment of labeling text with data, regulatory requirements, consistency between labeling documents).

  • Liaise and negotiate with global regulatory authorities as needed for all aspects pertaining to labeling including resolution of key regulatory issues and labeling changes.

  • Ensure the dissemination of approved labeling documents and supporting documentation.

  • Maintain controlled records for all labeling changes and communicate labeling updates to stakeholders at the time of implementation.

  • Build partnerships with key stakeholders from other functions to ensure that strategic business goals are met through the sharing of knowledge and expertise.

  • Participate in any relevant continuous improvement efforts for the end-to-end labeling process.

  • Monitor global regulatory environment and assess impact of changes on business and product labeling activities.

  • Facilitate policy development and updates with internal stakeholders.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science or other related discipline.

  • 12+ years in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry leading the development/maintenance of product labeling across two or more major geographic areas.

  • Ability to review regulatory labeling documents for accuracy and adherence to regulatory requirements, noting deviations and inconsistencies.

  • Experience leading cross functional meetings and facilitating strategic discussions.

  • Experience negotiating with internal stakeholders and regulatory authorities on complex labeling issues.

  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and strong judgment and decision making.

  • Detail oriented and highly organized with the ability to deliver against tight timelines.

  • Proven ability to achieve goals within a cross-functional team environment and as an individual contributor, and interact effectively with all levels/roles with a high level of professionalism.

  • The candidate should be a self-starter and be comfortable with broad responsibilities in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Advanced degree in science or other related discipline.

  • 10+ years in the biotech or pharmaceutical industry leading the development/maintenance of product labeling across two or more major geographic areas.

The base pay salary range for this full-time position for candidates working onsite at our headquarters in Redwood City, CA is listed below. The range displayed on each job posting is intended to be the base pay salary range for an individual working onsite in Redwood City and will be adjusted for the local market a candidate is based in. Our base pay salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual base pay salary is determined by multiple factors, including job-related skills, experience, market dynamics, and relevant education or training.

Please note that base pay salary range is one part of the overall total rewards program at RevMed, which includes competitive cash compensation, robust equity awards, strong benefits, and significant learning and development opportunities.

Revolution Medicines is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, disability, marital status, medical condition, and veteran status.

Revolution Medicines takes protection and security of personal data very seriously and respects your right to privacy while using our website and when contacting us by email or phone. We will only collect, process and use any personal data that you provide to us in accordance with our CCPA Notice and Privacy Policy. For additional information, please contact .

Base Pay Salary Range
$201,000—$251,000 USD

We are aware of recent recruitment scams in which individuals or organizations falsely represent themselves as being affiliated with Revolution Medicines. These scams may appear as false job advertisements or unsolicited contacts through communication or chat platforms, email, phone, or text message.

Please note that Revolution Medicines does not extend unsolicited employment offers and will never ask candidates to provide financial information, purchase equipment, or pay fees as part of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from Revolution Medicines will come from an official @revmed.com email address.

If you believe you’ve been contacted by someone impersonating a Revolution Medicines recruiter, please report it to so we can share these impersonations with our IT team for tracking and awareness.

We are on a mission to discover new treatment answers for patients in times of need.


But we can´t do it alone.


We´re seeking an experienced Pricing Analyst to optimize our pricing strategies, directly impacting the financial grow for our Clinical Pharmacology Services (CPS).


This is why we need you.


Your job matters. Join Fortrea and be part of something meaningful.

ABOUT THIS JOB


This is a full-time, permanent job. Remote or hybrid ideally based in The UK (in Leeds we have our brand new, world class, state-of-the-art 65,000 ft² clinic with 100 beds fully dedicated to CPS research).


Thrive in a Global Team: This job requires some schedule flexibility to collaborate effectively with US colleagues during core overlap hours.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will act as a primary person in the assessment and approval of budgets for the UK and the US 4 x Clinical Research Units Services. Your will work on highly time sensitive client deliverable, as you will be the last team to approve budgets before they go to the client. You will:


  • Help ensure pricing packages are approved and delivered to clients on time.
  • Check that budgets and financial calculations are accurate.
  • Review margins
  • Advising Sales and Client Managers on client pricing negotiations, discount guidance and authorizations.

You will also take a leading part:

  • Building and maintaining internal costing models and tools,
  • Developing commercial data pricing analysis for key insights into Fortrea´s commercial engine.

You will also support commercial, sales, RFI responses and Clinical teams with all their data analytics and reporting needs.

  • Your analysis will help gather, interpret and analyse data to support client-facing requests (specially Requests for Information), using data from multiple systems.

YOU NEED TO BRING…


Education


  • Bachelor of Science degree in Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Business or Life Sciences

Experience & Skills


  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in the fields of financial budgeting, pricing, margin analysis, proposals or contracts.

Previous experience in the clinical research sector is a plus (i.e. translating protocol procedures to costing models, building clinical budgets based on preliminary feasibility indications, etc.)

  • This job relies heavily on Microsoft Excel skills; proficiency is a must-have. Familiarity with Salesforce, Tableau and Power BI are beneficial.
  • Efficient multitasker: adept at prioritizing tasks within a dynamic, changing priorities and rapidly expanding environment.
  • Skilled in building rapport through diplomacy and tact, with excellent communication and presentation abilities to convey analysis and recommendations clearly and concisely.
