Global Trade Management roles lie either within the Trade Operations & Compliance or Export Controls area. Responsibilties include understanding the laws and regulations related to customs or export controls regulations globally. Advising the business units and overall organization on best practices and new opportunities to reduce risks and/or costs; ensuring that processes for customs or export control activities reduce risks and/or costs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Trade Operations and Compliance - Maintains a strong understanding of laws and regulations related to import/export in the assigned geography and is accountable for compliance in the assigned geography; provides technical expertise related to import/export laws and regulations.
  • Evaluates processes to identify opportunities to reduce risks and/or costs for import/export activities in the assigned geography and develops and implements process changes to capture such opportunities.
  • Advises the business to capture new opportunities and meet current needs in a compliant manner at minimal cost. Acts as a point of escalation for complex, non-routine problems; resolves complex problems.
  • Reviews and presents management reports on import/export activities.
  • Conducts training as needed on import/export topics. Maintains and expands strong relationships with appropriate governmental organizations in countries key to the organization’s operation and with brokers to ensure that the organization has appropriate supporting documentation and consistent compliance with import/export regulations.
  • Provides guidance and direction on problems and issues; delegates work assignments considering employee skills and development needs.
  • Export Controls -
  • Develop, maintain and execute a strong understanding of export control laws and regulations related to defense and dual-use products and registrations required to maintain compliance globally.
  • Communicates important changes to relevant laws and regulations; reviews license and registration applications and supporting data; prepares and reviews documentation needed to support compliance.
  • Reviews and monitors Export Control Number assignment and Restricted Party Screening programs for all business units; reviews and presents management reports regarding the programs.
  • Executes robust Global Trade Management Restricted Party Screening processes including training and roll out of manual screening within the business.
  • Accountable for compliance and provides technical expertise related to export control laws and regulations. Acts as a point of escalation for complex, non-routine problems; resolves complex problems.
  • Evaluates processes to identify opportunities to reduce risks and/or costs for export control activities; develops and implements process changes to capture such opportunities.
  • Advises the business to capture new opportunities and meet current needs in a compliant manner at minimal cost.
  • Maintains and expands strong relationships with business to ensure the organization has appropriate supporting documentation and consistent compliance with export controls regulations.
  • Promote employee development and provides guidance and direction on problems and issues; delegates work assignments considering employee skills and development needs.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Business Administration or Human Resources
  • At least 5 years of experience processing complex payroll
  • Strong end‑to‑end payroll expertise, including complex calculations and statutory requirements.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

Position Summary:


At TrendAI, we operate from our mission and pay for outcomes. This role designs how we reward the people and capabilities that drive our growth. You'll build just enough structure to keep pay fair and simple, design a total rewards model that drives business growth and rewards the right behaviors, and give leaders real-time, AI-native insight into whether our pay is working.


What You'll Do:


You'll build a light, flexible pay architecture that links pay to the capabilities and outcomes each team needs, not only to titles or grades, anchored in a global pay philosophy and benchmarked against the right markets. With Sales and Finance, you'll shape pay mix and short-term incentives that reward team and company outcomes, and with leadership you'll develop long-term incentives so Trenders share in the value they create.


You'll also build the pay intelligence that shows leaders, in one live view, whether our pay is fair, competitive and affordable, and keeps us ahead of pay equity and transparency requirements.


  • Own TrendAI's global compensation strategy, policies and programs across base pay, short-term incentives, long-term incentives and recognition.
  • Advise senior leaders, HR business partners and recruiters on offers, promotions, retention and organization changes.
  • Partner with PE&A on compensation data, analytics and Workday configuration, and with Finance on budgets, accruals and cost modeling.
  • Prepare compensation proposals and reporting for the CHRO and executive leadership.
  • Work with HR's Learning Design & Enablement Partner to train HR teams and managers on pay programs.
  • Grow a small compensation team as the function matures.

What You Should Have:


  • 8+ years in compensation or total rewards, including global programs across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific.
  • Hands-on job architecture experience, with the judgment to keep structure light in a fast-moving business.
  • Experience designing sales compensation and short- and long-term incentive plans, ideally including cash-settled or phantom equity.
  • Strong financial modeling skills and confidence presenting to senior leaders.
  • Working knowledge of Workday Compensation or Advanced Compensation.
  • Fluency with people analytics and AI tools, and experience turning pay data into real-time insight.

What Makes You Stand Out:


  • Technology or cybersecurity industry experience, ideally in a Japan-headquartered or matrixed global company.
  • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or Global Remuneration Professional (GRP).
  • Experience leading pay equity reviews and pay transparency programs.
  • Experience in a fast-growing, startup-style environment, building rewards from the ground up.

You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. TrendAI provides benefit options for you and your family.


  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability 
  • Pre-partum, maternity, parental and medical leave
  • Mental Health Wellness Program
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Wellness Incentive
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off
  • 14 Annual Holidays
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Employee Resource Groups

 

We offer competitive compensation with bonus opportunity tied to company performance, along with room to enhance your skills through ongoing learning and broad technological opportunities. Achieving work-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work.

Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender.

WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com.

What's cool about this job:

WP Engine is a growing mid-sized tech company transforming the [industry/niche] landscape with innovative solutions and a people-first culture. We’re seeking a detail-oriented and strategic FP&A Analyst to support our financial planning and decision-making processes as we scale.

The FP&A Analyst will play a key role in our Finance team by assisting in managing core financial reporting processes, administering and optimizing Workday Adaptive Insights, and partnering with our G&A functions (HR, Legal, Finance, Facilities, etc.) to drive transparency and efficiency in financial planning. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical skills, a knack for systems, and a collaborative mindset.

The day to day:

Adaptive Insights Administration (40%)

Financial Planning & Reporting (35%)

  • Assist with board of director deliverables and presentations

G&A Business Partnering (25%)

raw.title: Senior Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.
raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.

We are looking for a creative and skilled Motion Designer to join our creative team. The Motion Designer will be responsible for creating engaging motion graphics, animations, and video content for various digital platforms.

This role requires a combination of artistic creativity and technical expertise, with a strong understanding of visual storytelling, animation, and design principles. ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Senior Director, AI Enablement owns the production of role-specific AI capability: the Skills, projects, agents, product education and workflows that make GPS, Prism and our data platform usable inside the job, for the roles that matter most. Training is a delivery mechanism for this work, not the product. The product is a working set of content and tools a Greystar team member can pick up and use, on real Greystar data, and a measurable change in how they operate.

This is the technical counterpart to the Director, Talent Development in People & Culture. That role owns the enterprise learning framework, leadership development and the learning technology stack, and is the distribution channel to the workforce. This role owns what gets distributed — the artifacts, the technical standards behind them, and the adoption they drive.

This is a builder’s seat with a leader’s remit. The right person is fluent enough in Claude, ChatGPT, AI tools, MCP and data platforms to author skills personally and set the bar for a team that does, and commercial enough to argue, in NOI terms, why a given workflow should be rebuilt at all.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Responsibilities

Role-Based Capability Production

  • Define, for each priority role, what “AI-enabled” concretely means in the workflow — which decisions, which reports, which repetitive steps — and build the artifacts, or work with the teams to build the artifacts and education that deliver it.
  • Author and ship Skills, projects and agent workflows grounded in Greystar’s metric definitions (Atlas), data platform (DMP) and intelligence products (GPS, Prism, LEAP); personally build the first versions, then scale the team’s output working closely with your HR counterpart to expand delivery.
  • Maintain a governed skill & tool library with ownership, versioning, test cases and deprecation — treated as a product, not a training catalogue.
  • Sequence work by leverage: key roles first, in lockstep with leadership, the GPS roadmap and the FDI Pod deployments.

Adoption and Measurement

  • Own the adoption metric for AI capability across eligible roles: active users, repeat usage, workflow coverage, time-to-first-value.
  • Instrument enablement artifacts so usage is visible without self-report; partner with Data Engineering on the consumption and usage feeds.
  • Run the feedback loop from the field into the artifacts — what breaks, what is ignored, what gets copied — and iterate weekly.
  • Report adoption alongside FDI Pod impact so cost and value are always shown together.

Partnership with People & Culture

  • Serve as the primary technical partner to the Director, Talent Development, and to People Strategy & Programs on AI readiness; P&C owns the pathway, readiness approach and competency framework, and this role owns the technical content and the tools.
  • Feed enablement artifacts and technical curriculum into Workday Learning and P&C programs as the distribution channel; do not build a parallel LMS.
  • Share role-level adoption data (active users, workflow coverage, time-to-first-value) with People Strategy & Programs so manager enablement and communications can target where readiness lags.
  • Jointly define what an “AI-ready” role profile looks like for hiring and internal mobility, with P&C owning the competency framework.

Standards, Safety and Governance

  • Set the technical standards for enablement artifacts: data access aligned to the External Data Sharing Framework and Unity Catalog permissions; no ungoverned data paths.
  • Ensure every skill is grounded in the definition of record (Atlas/GPS); when a skill and a legacy report disagree, the platform number travels.
  • Partner with InfoSec on prompt, data and model-flexibility standards as the model landscape changes.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and retool the AI Enablement team from a training orientation to a build orientation; hire for skill authorship and applied AI over instructional design where the two conflict.
  • Build a champion network inside the business units that extends the team without adding headcount, with clear standards for what champions may and may not ship.
  • Model the operating principle of the function: narrow aperture, ship, measure, iterate; say no to requests without a role, a workflow and a metric attached.

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • Led an AI or technology enablement function in a large, complex organization through an actual adoption curve — not a pilot program.
  • Demonstrated hands-on record building with LLM tooling in production: skills, prompt systems, agent workflows or equivalent that other people used at scale.
  • Partnered closely with data or engineering teams to ground enablement in real systems and real data, and with HR or L&D as the distribution partner.
  • Measured adoption and outcomes rigorously and can distinguish reach, adoption and impact without prompting.
  • Experience in operations-heavy, distributed businesses (real estate, financial services, healthcare, logistics) is an advantage; multifamily is not required.

Skills and Capabilities

  • Technically credible: comfortable in Claude Enterprise / API, MCP, prompt and skill design, and reading a data model. Can build a working skill against a governed dataset without an engineer.
  • Commercially literal: connects an enablement artifact to a line in the P&L (NOI, hours, CAC) or does not build it.
  • Product discipline: treats skills as versioned, owned, tested artifacts with users, not as course materials.
  • Strong influencing across functions and levels; holds a boundary with HR and the business without creating friction.
  • Clear, concise communicator to a senior founder-led audience; candid about what is not working.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity, building structure where none exists, and abandoning it when it stops working

The salary range for this position is $180,000 - $200,000 USD Annually.

raw.description:
Job Description:

Strategic Interchange Analyst

Constellation Payment Processing

THE COMPANY

Constellation Payment Processing is a modern Payment Facilitator (PayFac) empowering SaaS businesses to grow revenue through seamless, embedded payments. As part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSE: CSU), a global Canadian-based software leader, we combine the agility of a specialized payments company with the strength and stability of an established global organization.

POSITION

We are hiring a Strategic Interchange Analyst to own and advance interchange, card network, routing and payment-cost optimization across our payments portfolio. This is a hands-on role for a senior payments professional who can combine deep interchange and network knowledge with advanced data analysis, workflow automation and clear business storytelling.

You will build on an established analytical foundation, using transaction-level data to identify qualification issues, cost leakage, routing opportunities and emerging portfolio trends. You will monitor network changes, quantify their impact and turn complex findings into practical recommendations for technical, financial and commercial stakeholders.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own interchange qualification and network-cost performance across the portfolio, identifying downgrade drivers, cost leakage, routing opportunities and remediation priorities.
  • Monitor Visa, Mastercard and other relevant network changes, assess their financial impact and maintain current interchange rules, cost tables and optimization guidance.
  • Analyze routing logic and transaction behavior to identify opportunities that improve qualification and payment economics.
  • Use advanced SQL and other programming or query languages to analyze and reconcile large transactions, interchange, billing and network-fee datasets.
  • Build automated monitoring, reporting and analytical workflows using AI, Python, Java or comparable tools to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability.
  • Translate complex payments analysis into clear executive insights, financial-impact assessments and practical recommendations.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, merchant acquiring, payment facilitation, processing, card networks, issuing, gateway operations or a closely related field.
  • Deep knowledge of Visa and Mastercard interchange structures, qualification criteria, downgrade drivers, assessments, network fees and card-brand operating rules.
  • Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem, including card brands, networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, gateways, PayFacs, merchants and sponsor banks.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, with demonstrated experience independently querying, joining, validating and interpreting large and complex datasets.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Python, Java or another programming or query language used for analysis, automation and data workflow development.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to automate workflows, improve analytical efficiency and communicate data-driven insights.
  • Experience in merchant acquiring, payment facilitation, or processor environments.
  • Knowledge of PIN debit, least-cost routing, FANF, VAMP, assessments, compliance fees and other network-related costs.
  • Experience building interchange reference tables, qualification engines, reconciliation frameworks, portfolio monitoring or profitability models.
  • Familiarity with payment-message data, gateway field mapping and authorization-to-clearing analysis.
  • Degree in a quantitative or technical fields such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or Finance.

Business Unit:

Constellation Payment Processing

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

raw.excerpt: Children’s Funding Project is a nonprofit social impact organization that helps communities, states and Native nations expand equitable opportunities for children and youth through strategic public financing.
raw.description:
Children’s Funding Project is a nonprofit social impact organization that helps communities, states and Native nations expand equitable opportunities for children and youth through strategic public financing. Through our hands-on technical assistance and collection of resources, we help advocates, policymakers, public agencies, and funders identify and align existing funding, generate new revenue, and implement strategies to administer funds in ways that maximize their impact. This growing organization is dynamic and seeks to meet the needs of the child and youth field and provide a healthy and fulfilling work environment. Read more about us at: .

About the Position: Children’s Funding Project is hiring a Senior Manager, Local Fiscal Mapping and Strategic Advising, to grow our local fiscal mapping portfolio while helping advocates use fiscal data to improve outcomes for children and youth across the country. In this role, you’ll work with local clients and partners to design, build, and effectively use fiscal maps to generate more dedicated funding for kids. The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of the funding streams that support children’s and youth programs, strong skills in project design, implementation, and strategic consulting, and can help communities build and understand fiscal maps that support their policy and advocacy goals. This is a new, full-time, exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Implementation and Impact.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Project Design & Implementation

  • Design, implement, and support the successful use of grant-funded and client-commissioned fiscal maps.This will include but is not limited to: acquiring public budget/finance data; performing complex data cleaning, coding and analyses; and creating visualizations and recommendations to advance local policy and revenue goals.
  • Collaborate across teams to support the integration of local fiscal mapping data into revenue generation and strategic public financing work.
  • Create and manage project workplans, ensuring that local fiscal maps are of high-quality and delivered on time and within budget.
  • Support continuous quality improvement of our fiscal mapping methodology and tools.

Client Development & Revenue Generation

  • Identify opportunities where clients need more than standard support, and scope, design, and deliver custom consulting projects that combine policy and systems knowledge with strategic public financing approaches.
  • Build relationships with and develop scopes of work for prospective local fiscal map clients that have goals to generate new revenue for children and youth services and programs.
  • Contribute to the development of proposals to foundations and other investors in our fiscal data infrastructure work.

Strategic Analysis & Guidance

  • Analyze, synthesize, and disseminate local fiscal mapping findings, lessons learned, and recommended practices to various audiences, including advocates, policymakers, funders, and other partners via reports, blogs, presentations, and other mediums.
  • Serve as a thought partner and strategic advisor to local fiscal mapping clients and partners on how to apply fiscal mapping data to advance policy and revenue goals.
  • Contribute to internal fiscal mapping strategy and planning by representing the local fiscal mapping portfolio.
  • Other duties as assigned.

SKILLS, EXPERIENCE & OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  • A bachelor's degree in social sciences, education, finance, public policy, social work, or a related field is required. A master’s or professional degree in a relevant field (e.g., public policy) is preferred.
  • 6-10 years of experience in the government, nonprofit, or human services sector, ideally in a role requiring project design and implementation, data and/or policy analysis, and strategic advising. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience in education, child and youth policy/systems, or other strategy consulting with state or community leaders.
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local funding for children and youth and technical experience developing local fiscal maps strongly preferred.
  • Comfortable with developing and communicating policy recommendations.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis software such as Excel, Power BI, Data Wrapper and/or Tableau.
  • Excellent communication skills, with an emphasis on stakeholder management and community engagement.
  • Experience fostering a supportive and inclusive team culture.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and proactive feedback loops.
  • Actively seeks opportunities for professional growth and improvement through ongoing training, professional development, openness to and delivery of performance feedback, and learning from and with colleagues.

LOCATION: Remote with ability to travel. Work may be performed from anywhere in the United States.

COMPENSATION: The hiring range for the Senior Manager position is $90,000 - $101,250. Children’s Funding Project offers a generous benefits package, a great (and growing!) team, and a working environment that emphasizes professional development and growth.

TO APPLY: A cover letter is required for consideration and should address your specific interest in and vision for the position as well as relevant professional and lived experiences.The cover letter will weigh heavily in the selection process. Note: Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States; Children’s Funding Project is unable to sponsor visas.

Children’s Funding Project commits to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment that reflects the breadth of communities and clients we serve. We are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to hiring socially conscious individuals with diverse experiences and knowledge that deepen our organization’s impact. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. People of color, members of Tribal Nations and Native communities, LGBTQ-identified people, gender-nonconforming people, people with disabilities, veterans, and people who speak a language in addition to English are strongly encouraged to apply

Salary: $90,000 - $101,250

raw.description:
About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

As part of Gartner’s Corporate Assurance Practice, you will join a dynamic team focused on advising General Counsel (GC) and other assurance leaders at the world’s largest companies to create greater value for their firms. This role will meaningfully expand insight and support for GCs. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and ideas-driven individual to help serve clients on the topics below.

Career experience with the development and deployment of privacy and information governance process, specifically from the perspective of in-house legal departments, will be valuable, as will deep familiarity with specific privacy workflows – including privacy impact assessments, consent management, subject rights requests, etc.-- and collaboration with leaders in other corporate functions such as IT, Data & Analytics, Cybersecurity, etc.

The successful candidate will be comfortable discussing and researching topics including:

  • Legal’s role in establishing and maintaining a defensible privacy program
  • Information governance processes, challenges, workflows, and cross-functional relationships
  • Evolving privacy issues and how they impact organizational strategy, including sensitive personal information, privacy and AI, consumer trust, and data ethics
  • Emerging privacy regulations and issues (e.g., biometrics, AI governance, cross-border transfer restrictions)

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Serve as a leading authority on privacy and information governance topics, such as:
    • Privacy strategy and program management,
    • GDPR, CCPA, and other leading privacy regulations,
    • Privacy impact assessments and DPIAs,
    • Cross-border data transfer restrictions and processes,
    • Data inventory and mapping,
    • Data subject rights requests processes,
    • Cookies and consent and preference management,
    • Evolving issues in the privacy landscape, including AI and privacy, biometrics, and consumer trust and preferences.
  • Stay abreast of external trends in the privacy landscape, including related areas like AI and AI governance.
  • Collaborate with peers and other experts across teams (e.g., Legal, IT, Finance) to understand client challenges, current market dynamics, evaluate vendors, and establish shared and consistent thought leadership and positions on relevant issues
  • Develop content and insight around emerging topics on AI governance
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; JD degree preferred
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including experience working in privacy, information governance, or within a corporate in-house legal department dealing with privacy and information governance
  • Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating privacy risk management efforts, setting or executing privacy strategy, working on information or data governance efforts across multiple stakeholder groups, and reviewing and synthesizing emerging privacy and related regulations
  • Demonstrate executive presence; with the ability to establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Experience with AI governance highly desirable
  • Demonstrated executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Title:

Director of Business Integrity

KBR brings together the best and brightest to deliver science, technology and engineering solutions that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most critical missions and objectives.

KBR is seeking a seasoned and strategic Director of Business Integrity to lead our Business Integrity and Anti-Corruption Compliance functions. This role is pivotal in upholding our ethical standards, managing investigations, and ensuring compliance with global anti-corruption laws. You will oversee a high-performing team and collaborate with senior leadership to drive a culture of integrity across the organization.

***Background Check Required***

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and mentor a team of investigators, compliance specialists, and a senior anti-corruption attorney
  • Manage the company-wide confidential reporting program (hotline, email, and P.O. boxes)
  • Oversee investigations into alleged violations of the Code of Business Conduct and recommend appropriate remediation
  • Collaborate with HR and senior leadership on case outcomes and disciplinary actions
  • Maintain and oversee the Business Integrity case management system
  • Direct annual ethics training and targeted compliance education for employees
  • Manage the annual conflicts of interest certification process and ethics training recordkeeping
  • Conduct trend analysis and compliance data analytics to inform program improvements
  • Prepare regular reports for senior management, the Audit Committee, and the Board
  • Advise on Code of Business Conduct interpretation and compliance strategies
  • Provide legal guidance on ethics and compliance issues, including anti-corruption compliance matters
  • Oversee due diligence and approvals for high-risk third-party partners
  • Manage outside counsel on anti-corruption matters and investigations as needed
  • Promote an ethical culture through internal communications and external benchmarking

Qualifications and Skill Requirements:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school; licensed to practice in Texas or another U.S. jurisdiction
  • 20 + years of legal experience, including 5 + years in a leadership role
  • Deep expertise in anti-corruption laws, compliance, and investigations
  • In-house ethics and compliance experience strongly preferred
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels
  • Strong writing skills for reports, summaries, and executive communications
  • Proven ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion and integrity
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize complex issues quickly
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external counsel

In everything we do, we are guided by our ONE KBR Values:

  • We Value Our People – We create diverse, inclusive environments in which each person can feel safe, respected and valued, and where everyone has opportunities to grow and reach their full potential.
  • We Deliver – We are uncompromising in our commitment to deliver innovative, high-quality, technology-led solutions for our customers and exceptional, sustainable value for all our stakeholders.
  • We Are People of Integrity – We value honesty, trust, courage, fairness, prudence and tenacity. We believe doing what’s right for the planet, the communities where we work, and our people is good for business.
  • We Empower – We empower our people with a shared purpose, the right tools and the supportive culture they need to be proactive decision-makers, to be adaptive to change, and to succeed.
  • We Are a Team of Teams – We have a will to succeed, but we value the achievements of our team of teams over individual accomplishments. Our collective focus makes us a better, stronger, more effective company.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

The Member Services Representative reports to the MBS Member Services Supervisor. The Member Services Representative is the first point of contact for our client’s members. They will assist members with billing questions, cancellation requests, and freeze requests. The Member Services Representative will need to refer to the policies and guidelines for each individual client. They will also be responsible for contacting members to notify them of past due balances and attempting to obtain payment, update billing information, and save members from cancelling. They will need to meet individual goals to include but not limited to adherence, quality, and average talk time.


The Member Services Representative should demonstrate good decision quality when making decisions and offering suggestions. They should have patience and be an attentive listener. The Member Services Representative should demonstrate composure when handling stressful situations and not be knocked off balance by the unexpected. They should have customer focus by being dedicated to meeting the expectations of internal and external clients. They should use time management effectively and efficiently to set priorities.

JOB TITLE: Product Owner REPORTS TO: Product Manager DEPARTMENT: Product Management LOCATION: Remote Job Overview Help bring AI to education and certification. Our team exists to deliver AI-centered features for the education and certification industry. As Product Owner, you'll lead and organize that work, turning product vision into a clear, prioritized backlog the engineering team can deliver with confidence. You'll sit between two groups of experts. On one side are the subject matter experts, educators and certification bodies who understand learning and assessment deeply. On the other are the AI engineers and scientists working with a technology that changes month to month. You won't need to be an expert in either; your job is to learn quickly from both, ask the right questions, and make sure each side understands what the other needs, so that real-world problems become features the team can build. You won't just execute the vision; you'll help shape it. Working closely with the Product Manager, you'll bring what you learn from users, experts and the delivery team to the roadmap for your area. About Us Prometric is a global leader in credentialing and skills development, building the workforce of tomorrow across industries and professions in 180+ countries. With more than 30 years of assessment expertise, we support organizations across the assessment lifecycle, from development through delivery and beyond. Main Duties & Responsibilities

Own and prioritize the team backlog: write user stories and acceptance criteria, lead refinement, and represent the team in PI Planning. Partner day to day with the engineering and AI science teams to deliver features in lean, iterative increments. Work with education and certification experts to understand their needs and turn them into AI powered features, making sure both sides understand the trade-offs. Help shape the roadmap with the Product Manager, drawing on user research, customer feedback and delivery data. Demo the product and communicate progress to stakeholders, users and clients. Support Product Line Marketing with product knowledge for launches.

Who You Are

You have a bias to action: you ship small, learn fast and iterate. You're curious and comfortable working with ambiguity. You move easily between the big picture and the detail. You communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical audiences. You're organized and self-directed working remotely, and a strong team player. You're a fast learner who's comfortable not being the expert in the room, and you ask good questions.

Essential Criteria

2+ years as a Product Owner or Business/Product Analyst owning a backlog in an Agile team, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria. Regular hands-on use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, and curiosity about applying AI to real problems. Experience working within SAFe or another scaled Agile framework. Comfortable with Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence, with a working understanding of software development. Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent experience.

Desirable Criteria

Experience in education, assessment or certification, or working closely with subject matter experts in another specialist field. Experience with product discovery or user research. Experience delivering AI/ML-powered product features. SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM) certification.

Employee Benefits

Pension Scheme Healthcare Scheme Life Assurance Employee Health and Wellbeing Initiatives Enhanced Annual Leave 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme Enhanced Maternity/Paternity Leave

Account Manager

REMOTE | US

About Us

Property Leads delivers high-quality, motivated seller leads to real estate investors, and we’re expanding into home services. We’re a quiet but mighty start-up that participated in 50% of off-market home sales in the last 12 months. We move fast, we’re data-driven, and we care about results.

Our customers are real estate investors and roofers/roofing companies running real businesses on our leads. When something breaks for them, it matters, and fixing it fast is how we grow. If you want to check the box on responding to a ticket without solving the problem, this isn’t the place. If you want to own real customer relationships and get on the phone to solve real problems, it is.

Role

Once Sales converts a prospect into a customer, you own the account for its lifetime: you build the relationship, keep them buying, and grow what they spend. Retention, expansion, and goodwill are your job, and your book of business is your number.

Responsibilities

  • Take the handoff from Sales at go-live, run onboarding, and get each customer to early results fast.
  • Monitor account health (purchase frequency, lead quality feedback, support history, payment activity) and reach out before customers go quiet.
  • Build goodwill by responding fast, telling customers the truth, following through, and advocating for them internally.
  • Grow accounts through new markets and increased budget once the customer’s core concerns are resolved.
  • When an account is at risk, overcome their objections and redirect them back to their original goal.
  • Log every customer conversation, risk, and outcome in the CRM.

Job Description

The Senior Sales Incentive Compensation Design Partner is the subject matter expert accountable for designing and modeling global sales incentive compensation and incentive bonus programs. The role translates business strategy, sales roles, coverage models, performance expectations, and financial goals into scalable incentive designs that drive intended business outcomes and sales behaviors. This role also leads complex financial and behavioral modeling, including sensitivity analysis, and synthesizes findings into clear recommendations and executive-level narratives that guide senior Commercial, Finance, and HR leaders through design decisions, risks, and tradeoffs. The role ensures designs are strategically aligned, financially sound, scalable, and operationally executable for the global incentive-eligible population.


The ideal candidate has significant sales compensation design experience supporting an incentive-eligible participant population of 2,000 or more in the life sciences, diagnostics, medical technology, technology, software, or another complex multinational company.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design of Agilent's sales incentive compensation and incentive bonus programs, including eligibility, performance measures, pay mix, thresholds, accelerators, modifiers, caps, and payout mechanics.
  • Advise and influence senior Commercial, Finance, and HR leaders by translating commercial strategy, financial objectives, sales roles, coverage models, and channel structures into practical incentive design choices and clearly articulating implications and tradeoffs.
  • Lead the financial and behavioral modeling of design alternatives, including payout simulations, sensitivity analyses, cost forecasts, and participant impact assessments; recommend the design that best balances commercial outcomes, affordability, risk, and participant behavior.
  • Serve as the primary incentive design advisor to senior Finance, Commercial, and HR leaders and provide design direction to Sales Operations, Quota and Crediting, Reporting, and Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) technology teams for accurate implementation.
  • Lead the incentive design decision process during annual planning cycles, periodic reviews, and material business changes by defining options, establishing evaluation criteria, and presenting evidence-based recommendations.
  • Evaluate plan effectiveness using quota attainment, payout distribution, performance-to-pay alignment, incentive cost, participant outcomes, and commercial results; identify design issues and lead recommendations for corrective action.
  • Establish global incentive design standards, governance requirements, approval criteria, and controls, ensuring approved design principles are documented and consistently applied.
  • Lead incentive design responses to significant go-to-market changes, new sales roles, channel evolution, and mergers or acquisitions by assessing impacts, modeling alternatives, and presenting recommendations, risks, costs, and implementation requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, Economics, Analytics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible incentive compensation experience, including substantial direct experience in sales compensation and incentive bonus design.

  • Deep expertise in sales incentive design principles, including eligibility, pay mix, measures, quotas and targets, payout curves, thresholds, accelerators, modifiers, caps, and governance.
  • Demonstrated experience leading financial and behavioral modeling of incentive design alternatives, including cost forecasts, payout simulations, sensitivity analyses, participant impacts, and performance-to-pay relationships.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex incentive design decisions, presenting recommendations and tradeoffs to senior leaders, and influencing Finance, Commercial, HR, and Sales Operations stakeholders.

raw.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a motivated Graduate Custom Layout Engineer to join our layout team and help deliver high-quality analog and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet-based solutions, including high-speed SerDes, UCIe die-to-die PHYs and ADC/DAC blocks. Working alongside senior layout engineers and analog designers, you will learn to take blocks from floorplan through verification to tape-out on advanced FinFET technology nodes. This role is well suited to recent graduates who are fascinated by how circuits become silicon, enjoy detailed hands-on work, and want to grow quickly in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Analog & AMS Block Layout: Implement layout for analog and mixed-signal building blocks (e.g. current mirrors, differential pairs, bias circuits, comparators, passive structures) under the guidance of senior layout engineers.
  • Advanced Node Layout: Learn and apply FinFET layout rules and practices on advanced technology nodes, including matching, symmetry, guard rings, well proximity and layout-dependent effects.
  • Verification & Sign-off Support: Run DRC, LVS and parasitic extraction, and debug and fix issues efficiently. Build exposure to EMIR, ESD/LUP and PERC checks as you progress.
  • Collaboration with Design Teams: Work closely with analog designers to understand circuit intent, sensitive nets and constraints, and translate them into robust physical implementations.
  • Scripting & Automation: Learn and use scripting (e.g. SKILL, TCL or Python) to automate repetitive tasks and improve layout productivity and consistency.
  • Documentation & Reviews: Document layout decisions and verification status, and take part in layout reviews to learn and share best practice.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics or a related field (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)
  • 0–2 years of experience in IC layout, including internships, placements or university projects
  • Solid understanding of CMOS device physics, semiconductor fabrication basics and analog circuit fundamentals
  • Awareness of key analog layout concepts such as matching, symmetry, parasitics, electromigration and latch-up
  • Hands-on exposure to a layout environment such as Cadence Virtuoso or Synopsys Custom Compiler (coursework or projects count)
  • Basic familiarity with physical verification (DRC/LVS), ideally with Pegasus
Nice-to-have:
  • Internship or project experience on a FinFET or other advanced-node technology (TSMC, Samsung, GlobalFoundries)
  • A completed tape-out from a university, MPW or internship project
  • Basic scripting experience (SKILL, TCL, Python or shell)
  • Comfort working in a Linux environment

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain your work concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from reviews
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in high-quality work
  • Ownership, reliability, and follow-through on commitments
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star: We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.
  • Connected, even remotely: We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.
  • High ownership, real impact: Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn't disappear into layers of management – it ships.
  • How we work: We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US
  • Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours
  • Equipment & setup – we’ll provide the tools you need to succeed
  • High-impact projects – design real analog IP used in customer silicon
  • Supportive team culture – a dedicated manager and a team of colleagues ready to help
  • Competitive, transparent compensation– adjusted for your location and engagement model
  • Learning & growth – AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  1. Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment
  2. Technical Interview(90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving
  3. Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance
  4. HR & Culture Call (45 min)–values, collaboration style, and ways of working
  5. Offer & Next Steps– we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.

Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.

Nov 20, 2026

 

NOTE: Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.  

This role can be performed anywhere in the United States.

 

Meet the Team 


  • The Cisco Forward Deployed Solutions Engineering (FDSE) team is a high-impact, elite hands-on engineering team that works directly alongside our most strategic global customers based in Americas to lead the AI transformation with an industry or government entity lens.
  • The goal is to leverage the power of AI to co-develop, innovate, integrate and show art of the possible solutions exceeding our customers' most critical business outcomes with fast time to value to prototype for future production environments.
  • Sitting at the intersection of the most powerful and complete AI solution in the world with the Cisco portfolio powered by the Splunk Data Platform, our team is poised to lead the market and set the standard for AI excellence. 
  • This team will work closely with Sales, Product and Technology, Software Development, Customer Success and Partners to maximize customer focus, leveraging the power of Cisco team and portfolio to exceed expectations.
  • This is a critical team of AI thought leaders operating in a high-velocity, collaborative community of senior software engineers, solution architects, and data platform engineers who thrive in agile, customer-embedded sprint environments.

Your Impact 


  • Cisco is looking for an accomplished, AI skilled, hands-on, experienced, and visionary Forward Deployed Solution Engineer (FDSE) with post-sales and/or pre-sales experience to leverage AI to build, scale, and lead customer business outcomes.
  • Compress customer time-to-value by architecting and proto-typing art of the possible solutions with the customer uniquely leveraging Cisco AI infrastructure and the Splunk portfolio into complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments.
  • Singular focus as an embedded engineer is to influence technical decision markers by strategically accelerating customer business outcomes, compressing time to value, and delivering tangible proof to drive durable growth through customer retention and growth.
  • Collaborate directly with Cisco product engineering teams to provide field-level insights, helping evolve our AI-integrated portfolio to meet the next generation of infrastructure demands.
  • Mentor and collaborate with a world-class team of Forward Deployed Solution Engineers. foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, customer obsession, and high ownership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical engineering experience.
  • 9+ years of professional experience in post-sales and/or pre-sales roles working directly with customers on distributed software and system architecture deployments.
  • 3+ years' experience in Generative and Agentic AI, machine learning platforms, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and event-driven architectures across cloud-native + hybrid platforms and large-scale enterprise data architectures.
  • AI experience realizing customer business outcomes with fast time to value
  • Willingness and ability to travel within assigned territory to meet business and customer engagement requirements

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ year track record of leading technical customer-facing engagements handling ambiguous, high-impact enterprise projects
  • 5+ years Cisco and Splunk experience and/or equivalent from a top competitor
  • Ability to articulate how AI and automation can be leveraged to solve complex business problems and achieve rapid ROI.
  • Narrative skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between deep technical AI implementation and executive-level business requirements.
  • AI, Data Science and Enterprise certifications and/or education THIS JOB DESCRIPTION DOES NOT APPLY FOR EMPLOYEES IN AUSTRIA, BELGIUM, FRANCE, GERMANY & NETHERLANDS

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $266,100.00 to $342,900.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

  • Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

The applicable full salary ranges for this position, by specific state, are listed below:

New York City Metro Area:

$266,100.00 - $394,300.00

Non-Metro New York state & Washington state:

$246,800.00 - $383,500.00

* For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.

** Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.
