raw.description:
Job Description Summary:

The Sr. Director, Franchise Operations serves as the primary point of contact representing the total region portfolio for the FSOP Channel and will steward the development of the brands , with primary accountability for growing revenue, volume, share, and transactions. We are looking for candidates with bottling or general management experience who can build relationships and execute our strategies across our network.

  

What You’ll Do for Us 


  • Responsible for weekly/monthly performance management, which includes reporting on revenue, volume, share, and transaction metrics. 
  • Monitors performance versus execution objectives, re-plans as necessary, and provides feedback to key stakeholders. Also, manages discretionary budgets based on regional need.  
  • Executes the commercial strategy and plans with franchise (bottling partners) owners for local market execution. 
  • Responsible for collaborating on the contingency plan to deliver annual business plan performance in channels to include revenue, volume, share, net outlets, SOVI (share of visual inventory), and pricing. 
  • Standardizes a common approach to capability building based on bottler segmentation. 
  • Assesses local Bottler commercial capabilities against established commercial strategies and objectives using the core measures within the Global Commercial Leadership Diagnostic Analysis Model; identifies gaps and develops action plans to improve capabilities. 
  • Coordinates training/development, enables more effective processes, scorecards, and business routines to achieve the annual business plan. 
  • Work with Franchise Commercial Director to steward the planning process that is in place bi-monthly, ensuring all customer plans are included.  
  • Be the SME for FSOP Channel Plans and work with respective Directors and their sales teams at the bottlers to execute the plan.  Participate in all channel planning routines from Atlanta. 
  • Provides Bottler performance feedback to Franchise Leadership, “serving as voice of the market.” 
  • Monitors market conditions and reports competitive activity to management, Bottler, and local associates in order to understand program effectiveness and any implementation barriers. 
  • Work with Commercial Director to support the development of commercial stewardship bi-monthly planning. 
  • Ensure all National Foodservice and Regional customer plans are communicated within the planning process to ensure end-to-end execution. 
  • Responsible for negotiating and resolving bottling contracts and National Supply Chain agreements as well as governance agreements and managing governance routines. 

Qualifications & Requirements 


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or Management; a Master’s degree is preferred.  
  • 10 or more years in a CPG organization responsible for direct sales, key account, or franchise management with P&L responsibility.  
  • Must have experience as a Business Partner with direct Bottler or manufacturing experience in the Food and Beverage industry and how to develop capacity plans to meet customer demand. 
  • Must have experience with annual business planning, forecasting, customer and distributor management , and demonstrate a track record for delivering positive revenue results.  
  • Demonstrate passion for selling, negotiating, and relationship building in an entrepreneurial environment.  
  • Understanding of channel marketing, syndicated marketing research, competitive analysis, and how to utilize this knowledge to drive sales.   
  • Must possess excellent relationship-building skills, as well as strategic leadership abilities.  
  • Distribution center knowledge is ideal. 
  • The ability to influence outcomes and be persuasive is ideal .

What We Can Do For You:


  • Exposure to World-Class Leaders: Access to global leaders that will expand your network and expose you to emerging technologies and techniques.
  • Iconic Brand: Work on the most recognized brand in the world and be part of developing the brand's next chapter.
  • Learning Culture: Access to resources that give you the tools to continually develop your skills and knowledge.

Travel Requirements: Up to 50%.

Preferred Location: Pittsburgh, PA.

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Skills:

Business Integrations, Business Planning, Channel Management, Communication, Execution Excellence, Market Dynamics, Negotiation, Revenue Growth Management, Value Chain Economics

Pay Range:

United States: 174,000 - 204,000 USD

Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.

Annual Incentive Reference Value Percentage:

30

Annual Incentive reference value is a market-based competitive value for your role. It falls in the middle of the range for your role, indicating performance at target.

Location(s):

United States of America

City/Cities:

Atlanta

Travel Required:

26% - 50%

Relocation Provided:

No

Job Posting End Date:

November 5, 2026

Our Purpose and Growth Culture:

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. When we collect your personal information as part of a job application or offer of employment, we do so in accordance with industry standards and best practices and in compliance with applicable privacy laws.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Fouress Synergy LLC is seeking an experienced International & Domestic Sales Manager – Polymers to drive sales growth across the LATAM market. This role is responsible for developing and managing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and expanding market share in the polymer and resin trading segment, covering a broad portfolio of engineering and commodity plastics.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Drive international and domestic sales of polymer and resin products across the LATAM region (Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, and other markets)
  • Identify, develop, and manage relationships with converters, distributors, and end-users across the full product portfolio: ABS, AS, ASA, C-PE, EPS, EXTEM, GPPS, HDPE, HIPS, LDPE, LLDPE, MDPE, mLLDPE, NORYL, PA 6, PA 66, PBT, PC, PE, PET, PMMA, PP, PS, PVC, SAN, SILTEM, TPE, TPO, TPV, etc,
  • Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and margin targets for the LATAM territory
  • Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, cold outreach, trade shows, and referrals
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and contracts with buyers.
  • Monitor global and regional polymer and resin market trends, pricing movements, and supply-demand dynamics
  • Coordinate with logistics, supply chain, and finance teams to ensure timely order execution and shipment
  • Prepare sales forecasts, market reports, and CRM updates for management review
  • Represent the company at industry conferences, exhibitions, and client visits across LATAM
  • Ensure compliance with import/export regulations and trade documentation for cross-border polymer shipments

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 5+ years of proven sales experience in polymers, resins, or petrochemical trading, with exposure to the LATAM market
  • Strong technical knowledge of engineering and commodity polymers (ABS, PP, PE, PVC, PET, PC, Nylon/PA, and related grades) and their end-use applications
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese, in addition to English
  • Willingness to travel extensively within the LATAM region
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills
  • Proficiency in CRM tools and MS Office/Excel for reporting and forecasting
  • Self-driven, target-oriented, and able to work independently across time zones

Benefits

Competitive salary with incentive structure

raw.description:
WR Immigration is a global immigration firm known for innovation, technology, and high-touch legal service. We have 46+ attorneys and 200+ immigration professionals across Boston, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Oakland, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Monica, and Shanghai, serving clients in over 100 countries.

We’re adding an Associate Attorney to lead strategy for research universities, hospitals and healthcare systems, and startups and small technology companies.

What you’ll do

  • Advise on cap-exempt and cap-subject H-1B strategy, EB-1B, NIW, O-1, E-2, TN, E-3, and J-1 matters
  • Handle physician and clinical matters, including J-1 waivers, Conrad 30, and Schedule A for nurses and PTs
  • Run faculty PERM special handling and permanent residence cases
  • Guide startups on immigration strategy as they grow
  • Lead client communication and review the work of paralegals and legal assistants

What you bring

  • Bar membership and 7+ years of business immigration experience
  • Strong nonimmigrant and employment-based green card knowledge, including PERM and complex RFEs and NOIDs
  • Experience with at least two of: universities or research institutions, hospitals or healthcare systems, startups or small companies
  • Strong writing, organization, and attention to detail in a high-volume setting

Interested applicants will be required to submit a resume, cover letter, and writing sample. The anticipated salary range for this position is between $170,000 and $200,000 per year.

Benefits:

WR Immigration offers a robust and competitive suite of benefits designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Benefits for full-time employees include paid time off and paid holidays; medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage; health savings and flexible spending accounts to help offset healthcare and dependent care expenses; multiple retirement plan options (401k & Roth 401k); and access to an employee assistance program. Benefits availability and eligibility may vary based on role and employment status.

Additional Information:

WR Immigration is committed to creating, fostering, and preserving an inclusive environment. We support our team members from all nations and backgrounds to achieve their goals and build lives of purpose and success. We recognize that our team members bring diverse talents, skills, and experiences, and we believe it is our responsibility to create an inclusive and respectful workplace that inspires excellence and compassion, both internally and in our service to clients.

Please note, we are not working with outside recruiters for this position.

WR Immigration does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. The firm will not be responsible for any referral fees or other compensation in the absence of a signed agreement between WR Immigration and the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without such an agreement, including those sent directly to hiring managers, will be considered the property of WR Immigration, and the firm reserves the right to pursue and hire candidates submitted in this manner without financial obligation.

Salary: $170,000 - $200,000 DOE

description: Sales Development Representative – Australia • Start conversations • Create opportunities • Build your career in digital trust.

raw.title: Sales Development Representative - Australia
raw.excerpt: Sales Development Representative – Australia • Start conversations • Create opportunities • Build your career in digital trust.
raw.description:
Sales Development Representative – Australia

  • Start conversations
  • Create opportunities
  • Build your career in digital trust.

About MATTR

At MATTR, we’re building a future where people and organisations can connect and share information securely, on their terms.

Our SaaS platform helps organisations issue, verify and accept digital credentials, bringing trust and authenticity to digital interactions. From established enterprises to web3 innovators, we enable our customers to build secure solutions that respect people’s privacy.

With roots in New Zealand and a global outlook, we’re looking for someone to spark the conversations that grow our business in Australia.

About the role

Every great customer relationship starts with a great first conversation. As our Sales Development Representative in Australia, you’ll often be someone’s first introduction to MATTR, helping them understand what we do and uncovering where we can make a difference.

You’ll respond to inbound interest, reach out to priority accounts and qualify potential opportunities across government, financial services and other regulated industries, as well as organisations adopting digital credentials and the partners supporting them.

This role calls for curiosity, thoughtful questions and relevant outreach. You’ll understand what each buyer needs, identify the right next step and give your business development colleagues the context to move the conversation forward.

What you’ll be doing

  • Make the first response count: Respond to inbound enquiries within agreed timeframes, connect people with the right colleague and ensure every lead has an owner.
  • Open doors: Reach priority accounts through email, phone, social channels and event follow-up, tailoring your outreach to each buyer’s sector and role.
  • Qualify with purpose: Assess leads against agreed criteria and establish an outcome within 30 days: a qualified handover, further nurturing or closure with a clear reason.
  • Set colleagues up for success: Hand over opportunities with a clear picture of the buyer, their needs, key stakeholders, timing and an agreed next step.
  • Know your audience: Research accounts, decision-makers, sector developments and regulatory changes to strengthen our targeting and messaging.
  • Turn engagement into conversations: Follow up on campaigns, events, webinars and partner referrals, keeping partners informed as their leads progress.
  • Share what you’re hearing: Capture buyer questions, objections and competitor mentions to help inform our messaging and product direction.
  • Keep improving the approach: Maintain accurate CRM records, including each lead’s owner, source, next step and outcome, and suggest improvements to outreach and lead handling as you learn what works.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in sales development, business development or inside sales within B2B SaaS or technology, ideally one to three years, with a track record of meeting activity and pipeline targets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the confidence to engage senior government and enterprise stakeholders.
  • An organised approach and strong CRM habits, recording conversations, next steps and outcomes accurately.
  • Curiosity about digital identity, trust and the regulatory developments shaping them, with a willingness to learn a new market category.
  • Initiative, resilience and openness to feedback, with the ability to work independently and contribute to a small, collaborative team.

A few things that would help you stand out

  • Exposure to government, financial services, identity or fraud-prevention buyers.
  • Experience using sales engagement tools.
  • An existing network in the Australian market.

Why join MATTR?

Build your technology sales career with hands-on experience in a developing field, learning from experienced colleagues and engaging with organisations tackling real challenges in digital trust.

You’ll gain exposure to complex enterprise and government buying environments, sharpen your commercial skills and see how the opportunities you create contribute to MATTR’s growth.

Ready to turn curiosity into opportunity? We’d love to hear from you.

We value diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and welcome applications from people with access needs. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

raw.description:
Overview

As a Software Engineer, you will work with our growing DevSecOps practice developing APIs and integration capabilities to connect data, services, and systems to help our customers achieve their mission. We are looking for candidates with experience with cloud platform services, understanding business requirements and implement complex integrations.

Contributions

Responsibilities include:

  • Understanding the needs of stakeholders and conveying this to developers
  • Testing and examining code written by others and analyzing results
  • Ensure that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats
  • Identify technical problems, perform root cause analysis, and develop software updates and ‘fixes’
  • Develop APIs and integrations using a broad range of software programming tasks to ensure that their systems integrations are functional.
  • Create and provide technical documentation that explains upcoming or existing integrations to non-technical individuals
  • Document as-is state of the environment, perform a gap analysis, and produce artifacts that articulate options and recommendations
  • Act as an individual contributor and mentor more junior team members
  • Engineer and implement solutions and provide recommendations for continuous improvement for the services provided
  • Present regular status updates and provide cross training to other team members.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Ability to obtain a U.S. government Security Clearance
  • U.S. citizen
  • BS Degree in an IT field OR BS in a non-IT field and 2 years related IT experience
  • 3 Years of Experience with one or more clouds (i.e. AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • 3 Years of Experience with Git SCM providers such as GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket
  • 3 Years of Experience with one or more programming or scripting languages
  • 3 Years of Experience with one or more integration technologies, such as Mulesoft

Preferred:

  • 3 Years of application development experience in an Agile environment
  • Experience implementing docker containers and utilizing platforms such as Kubernetes
  • Experience designing, implementing, and documenting APIs
  • Experience utilizing CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Pipelines, CircleCI, TravisCI
  • Experience implementing Automated Testing frameworks to test APIs and integrations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skill
  • Certifications: AWS Cloud Practitioner; AWS Solution Architect; Azure Developer Associate; Mulesoft Certified Developer Level 2

About steampunk

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $85,000 to $170,000. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here.

Identity Statement

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Steampunk is a Change Agent in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors. Through our Human-Centered delivery methodology, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. As an employee owned company, we focus on investing in our employees to enable them to do the greatest work of their careers – and rewarding them for outstanding contributions to our growth. If you want to learn more about our story, visit

raw.description:
About the group/team

The Security Group is responsible for protecting Canva systems and data from information security threats. The group runs programs across Application Security, Risk Management, Enterprise Security, and Threat Detection and Response domains. Our teams work together, and with other groups, to deliver preventive and detective controls and processes that reduce security risk.

Internal Systems Security team (ISS) helps secure our internal endpoints, networks, systems and data, used by every Canvanaut. We build and run a number of services that help run our device posture setup, secure credentials and secure our SaaS applications at scale. Additionally we partner with teams like IT, Sales and Customer Support to help build security into their roadmaps early on.

The team has to strictly balance security and user experience to make pragmatic tradeoffs every day, especially as work accelerates with AI tooling. As a result of this we will be assessing candidates' AI coding, security review and System Design skills during our interview process.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Managing a team of security engineers who do a mixture of threat modelling, security tool rollouts, building internal security services and partnering with other teams on security strategy.

  • Owning the strategy for internal security at Canva, balancing security, compliance and developer experience to build an experience that allows Canvanauts to move quickly, while having secure guardrails in place.

  • Coach and develop engineers by providing regular, practical feedback to help them reach their personal growth goals

  • Own the team’s ways of work including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives resulting in a high-performing team

  • Working collaboratively with other partner groups such as IT, Sales, Customer Support and others to build security improvements that scales beyond our team.

  • Driving adoption of our systems internally, championing the benefits of what we build.

Required Experience

  • The ability to build a strategy around access that balances usability, security and compliance requirements, being flexible to changes as user patterns change.

  • Prior experience managing and growing high performing teams.

  • Proven ability to threat model complex systems, identify security risks, develop mitigation strategies with engineering teams, and see it through to delivery.

  • Proven experience working with external stakeholder teams such as IT and Procurement to deliver secure SaaS solutions.

  • A good understanding of the internal IT environments and the security market that surrounds them. Zero trust, IDPs, SSPM, MDMs, Password Managers and more should be topics you’ve dealt with.

  • The ability to run large, complex projects across multiple groups, set the definition of done, track metrics and deliver comms at company scale.

Beneficial Experience (not required, but helpful)

  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages, with the ability to mentor others on best practices in at least one language: Python, Golang, Java.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g Terraform).

  • Experience working with identity management technologies (MFA, SAML, WebAuthn, Okta)

  • Understanding of common compliance frameworks like SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR etc.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Uzbek-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Uzbek Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $18 - $21 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Uzbek Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Uzbek and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inUzbek and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Fourteen (14) days from the posting date of October 30, 2026.

SUMMARY 

The purpose of Mortenson’s HQ Lean is to create a culture of inclusion and continuous improvement. Our chosen method to pursue this is Kaizen. The Senior Manager of Lean is a primary resource to promote, develop and support effective company execution of Kaizen, for one or more business sectors.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Engage Group Leaders and other Group resources, personally and through the direct reports you oversee, and support them to plan and execute Kaizen effectively.
  • Develop direct reports and Group Lean professionals in the Kaizen approach.
  • Support Groups to measure, capture, and sustain improvements, celebrate teams, and update baseline performance so that improvements are locked into expectations for future work performance.
  • As a member of the HQ Lean Core Team, provide significant input to the annual HQ Lean business plan, including enhancements to the approach and guidance on our strategy to provide different levels of support and activity to various Groups and projects within the organization (e.g. which Groups and Projects will receive focused support).

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Construction Management, Industrial Engineering or a related degree equivalent combination of education and technical/field experience demonstrated over multiple years of related work experience
  • Minimum of fifteen years construction or manufacturing experience
  • Minimum of ten years experience in a continuous improvement or other operational functional role (e.g. Quality, Safety, Planning, Process Excellence)
  • Experience facilitating lean activities (Kaizen Events, Improvement Initiatives, Takt Planning) using a defined approach
  • Expert understanding of and practical experience with Kaizen/Toyota Production System
  • Humble learner with curiosity and optimism
  • Proactive self-starter with growth mindset
  • Excellent reliability and follow-through
  • Strong ability to coach and mentor leaders and professionals
  • Ability to influence through relationship building at group and project leader level
  • Effectively work with those of diverse backgrounds and organizational levels

The base pay range for this role is $144,900 - $217,400. (Actual range is higher for the following office locations: Denver, CO and Chicago, IL – 5%, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR – 10%, Washington, D.C. – 12.5%).

Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience, with consideration given to internal equity. This position is eligible for Mortenson’s incentive plan.

  • Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.
  • Our postings are typically open a minimum of 5 days and an average of 44 days.

As a top builder, developer, and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), our expertise spans markets like sports, renewable energy, data centers, healthcare, and more. We are builders at heart, working to ensure the built environment has a lasting positive impact.

Director, Executive Accounts


Status: Exempt (Salaried)

Department: Sales

Reports to: Vice President

Travel: Up to 25%

Position Summary

Plug Power is seeking a Director/Sr Director, Executive Accounts to own the commercial relationship with one of our largest and most strategic customer. This is a rare, high-visibility role: you will be the senior sales leader and primary point of contact for the customer’s executive and functional stakeholders, accountable for both the health of a multi-year, multi-site relationship and the growth of the business within it.

You will work hand in hand with leaders across Product Management, Sales, Finance, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Construction, Services, and Legal to deliver reliable hydrogen and fuel cell solutions, and to expand Plug’s footprint across the customer’s operations. Success requires equal parts commercial strategist, program manager, and trusted advisor — someone who can negotiate large capital and recurring-revenue agreements, navigate complex organizations on both sides, and give the customer candid, credible guidance, especially when the news is difficult.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Account strategy: Develop and execute a multi-year strategic account plan that grows revenue, deepens share of wallet, and positions Plug as the customer’s long-term hydrogen partner.
  • Executive relationships: Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior executives and functional leaders across the customer’s operations, engineering, procurement, finance, and sustainability organizations; understand their priorities and remove roadblocks early.
  • Pursuit and close: Lead the full sales cycle from opportunity identification through close, including RFP responses, pricing and commercial strategy, contract negotiation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) and business case development.
  • Ecosystem selling: Sell Plug’s integrated ecosystem — fuel cell systems, hydrogen fueling infrastructure, hydrogen supply, and services — with a holistic vision that spans Plug solutions and business units.
  • Account health and escalations: Own overall account health, including performance against commitments, escalation management, and customer satisfaction. Communicate openly and directly with the customer, and drive timely, cross-functional resolution of issues. Lead Customer Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
  • Forecasting and reporting: Present realistic yet ambitious sales and revenue forecasts, pipeline reviews, and account performance to Plug’s executive leadership team.
  • Voice of the customer: Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Manufacturing to translate customer needs into design specifications, product roadmap input, and deployment plans.
  • Program leadership: Coordinate large, multi-site programs across internal teams, holding stakeholders accountable to schedule, cost, and quality commitments and clearing obstacles to successful implementation. Resolve resource misalignment and priority conflicts with functional leaders.
  • Executive communication: Prepare and deliver executive-level presentations and business reviews that distill complex technical and financial topics into clear, audience-appropriate messages.
  • Professionalism: Represent Plug Power with the highest standards of professionalism and integrity in every interaction.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in sales, account management, product management, engineering, or a related field, preferably with an energy, renewables, industrial, or capital equipment company.
  • Experience with fuel cells, hydrogen, batteries, or other energy storage and power technologies.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, high-value customer relationships and negotiating large commercial agreements.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in engineering or business (MBA a plus).
  • 12+ years of experience in sales, account management, product management, engineering, or a related field
  • Background in the material handling, warehousing, logistics, or industrial equipment industries.
  • Experience selling capital equipment (capex) and long-cycle, multi-site solutions.
  • Experience selling into large, sophisticated enterprise or hyperscale customers, including navigating formal RFP and procurement processes.
  • Experience selling an ecosystem — bundling equipment, infrastructure, fuel or energy supply, and services into a single value proposition.
  • Strong financial acumen, including TCO and ROI modeling and commercial pricing strategy.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic and commercial: Sharp business sense with the ability to articulate value to diverse audiences and drive results against aggressive targets.
  • Technical depth: Ability to learn complex technology quickly and engage credibly with engineers and executives alike.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal skills, with the gift of distilling complex information into key themes tailored to each stakeholder.
  • Influence and leadership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority, build alignment, and hold others accountable.
  • Integrity and candor: Straightforward and honest with customers and colleagues; a role model for professionalism and high standards.
  • Execution: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and relentless in follow-through, with a results-driven work style.

Pay Rate:

$137,500.00 - $220,000.00

We offer a fantastic total rewards package at Plug, and a brief summary is below:

Your Expertise

  • Confident use of Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Knowledge of encoding, export specifications and optimisation for social platforms.
  • A fundamental understanding of AI in production workflows, supported by examples of tools or features you've tried and what you learned from using them.
  • The ability to critically review AI output, spot errors and explain where a tool adds value.
  • A strong eye for detail, reliable delivery under deadlines, and the judgement to balance polish with the time available.
  • Clear communication, openness to feedback and the initiative to investigate problems and keep improving your work.
  • Based in LATAM and available to work 9:00am–5:30pm Pacific Time (PT).

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tools and Technology

Work with current hardware and creative tools, with opportunities to learn and apply useful developments in AI-supported production.

Ideas Welcome

We encourage practical suggestions that make the work better. When a technique proves useful, share it so others can benefit too.

An International Team

Join a collaborative team working across countries, disciplines and projects. We value skill, initiative and clear communication.

Remote Working

This role is fully remote within LATAM, with a regular 9:00am–5:30pm Pacific Time schedule. Your local working hours may change when Pacific Time moves between standard and daylight saving time.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • Apply with your CV and portfolio or showreel. If shortlisted, you'll meet members of our production leadership or recruitment team to discuss your experience, approach and the role.

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We're more interested in your craft, your judgment, and how you work with AI than in a perfect traditional CV.

We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), a component of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), protects the American people, safeguards U.S. borders, and enhances the nation's economic prosperity through innovation, intelligence, and collaboration. Within CBP's Office of Information and Technology (OIT), the Border Enforcement Management Systems Directorate (BEMSD) manages a large, diverse portfolio of mission applications—sustaining legacy systems at high availability while modernizing and developing new solutions. The Systems & Applications Integration & Lifecycle Support (SAILS) program will provide BEMSD with full-lifecycle IT services—from new application development and 24x7x365 operations to legacy modernization—delivered through Agile and DevSecOps practices.

GDIT is seeking a Portfolio Manager to support the SAILS program. In this role, you will provide leadership and operational oversight for a portfolio of applications and services, ensuring successful delivery, continuous improvement, and alignment with CBP mission priorities. You will partner with program leadership, technical teams, and BEMSD stakeholders to coordinate cross-functional activities, manage portfolio performance, and deliver secure, reliable IT services.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Lead portfolio planning, transition, and delivery across assigned applications and services.
  • Provide leadership and oversight to technical teams, ensuring quality delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Manage portfolio schedules, backlogs, risks, and dependencies in alignment with BEMSD priorities.
  • Partner with BEMSD stakeholders, vendor partners, and development teams to coordinate delivery, manage customer expectations, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Drive service improvements through analysis of business processes, workflows, and technology solutions.
  • Oversee delivery of projects, enhancements, incidents, and change requests to maintain reliable, high-quality services.
  • Evaluate technologies and operational approaches to improve performance, resiliency, and efficiency.
  • Brief BEMSD and GDIT leadership on portfolio performance, risks, priorities, and recommendations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, or management discipline.
  • 15+ years managing large-scale federal IT programs or application portfolios.
  • Experience leading multiple software development or operations teams.
  • Experience with Agile, DevSecOps, and modern IT service delivery.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and leadership skills.
  • PMP certification.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain a CBP Background Investigation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a technical or management discipline.
  • Prior DHS—preferably CBP—program experience.
  • ITIL certification.
  • Experience managing application modernization or transition activities.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or similar IT service management (ITSM) platforms.

Explore a career in cyber security at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your passion for securing the mission.

raw.description:
Is your love for leading a company based on the market dynamics coming into conflict with the realization that you are tired of working for giant companies? Would you love the idea of hands on working as part of the management team of 2 or 3 companies at once, supported by 125 other world class fractional executives? If you have held the position of VP of Marketing or CMO at one or more large Operating Companies, but don’t want to go back and do it again, you may be a fit for what we do. Chief Outsiders, www.ChiefOutsiders.com, is a national company that is growing very quickly and is looking to add CMOs in multiple US markets.

What We Do: Our focus is on helping midsize companies grow via implementing major growth initiatives in strategy, marketing and business management in a way that will continue to drive top-line growth long after we are gone.

What We Look For: We are looking for C-level operating executives who approach business from a market-based perspective. You must have held the position of VP of Marketing or CMO at one or more large operating companies. We are looking for people who have the experience to help a CEO or business owner understand where and how to grow and then determine which marketing tools to apply to make big things happen.

What It Takes To Succeed: Inquisitiveness, resilience, and knowledge. There is not a canned Chief Outsiders approach. To succeed you need to be able to help the CEO and leadership team understand what the real business problems are and then develop and implement a plan that fits the company, opportunity and competitive situation.

Compensation: This is not an “eat what you kill” environment, but we use a revenue share compensation model. You are paid a percentage of the billings for the projects that you work on. You get a bigger share of the revenue if you bring in the lead, but there are company funded programs to help you bring in leads. Most of our CMOs target taking home over $200,000 a year, with some making double that amount.

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.


About this Role

We currently have an excellent opportunity for a highly motivated, self-directed, and results-oriented Strategic Account Manager on our Commercial Real Estate Team, focused on business development, strategic account growth, and sales execution within the Commercial Real Estate market. The successful candidate will be responsible for growing commercial equipment, controls, and service sales while developing and managing a robust pipeline of opportunities across assigned territories.


This role requires a proven hunter mentality with demonstrated success identifying, developing, qualifying, and advancing opportunities through the sales funnel to drive sustainable revenue growth.


This position is open to candidates based anywhere within the United States, provided they live in close proximity to a major airport. Candidates must be willing and able to travel up to 50% to support customer engagements and business requirements.



Key Responsibilities

  • Leverage existing Commercial Real Estate relationships for new business development.
  • Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve sales targets in assigned accounts.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with partners within large Commercial Real Estate organizations to influence design standards and projects for direct and indirect sales opportunities.
  • Develop strategies for capital spending and operational priorities to align with customer ESG goals.
  • Oversee sales activities and resources within sales channels in assigned accounts.
  • Collaborate with local Carrier Commercial Sales, Service, and Controls teams on sales strategies that improve Carrier's competitive position.
  • Track project activity and market opportunities.
  • Acts as the primary contact with complex and strategic opportunities within the assigned accounts.
  • Leads and promotes bid opportunities, participates in the preparation of bid responses, and negotiates with potential customers.
  • Develops and promotes new customer contact leads for the sales business development team.
  • Proactively supports and develops prospective projects with assigned customers and presents them to the sales business development team.
  • Champion personal customer relationships with prospective accounts to influence opportunities.
  • Develop customer presentations tailored to specific customer needs.
  • Build, maintain, and manage a healthy sales pipeline of qualified opportunities to achieve and exceed annual bookings and revenue targets.
  • Develop territory and account plans that drive pipeline growth, increase market penetration, and expand strategic account relationships.
  • Utilize Salesforce.com and other CRM tools to effectively manage pipeline activity, forecast opportunities, and provide accurate business visibility.
  • Consistently prospect, qualify, and advance new opportunities within Commercial Real Estate and Facility Management organizations.



Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree with 5+ years of experience in HVAC industry sales or Commercial Real Estate OR high school diploma/GED with 10+ years of experience in HVAC industry sales or Commercial Real Estate.
  • Valid Driver's License.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% as required by business needs.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, or Marketing.
  • Demonstrated success building, managing, and closing a pipeline of strategic opportunities.
  • Experience working with Commercial Real Estate ownership groups, operators, developers, REITs, property management firms, and/or Facility Management organizations.
  • Established relationships within Commercial Real Estate and/or Facility Management companies.
  • Demonstrated success selling solutions into Commercial Real Estate portfolios and Facility Management providers.
  • Proven success in promoting and selling based on financial value propositions including life cycle costs and total cost of ownership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact with both external customers and cross-functional teams including sales, engineering, manufacturing, and marketing associates.
  • Analytical thinking to strategically identify and target high-potential growth opportunities.
  • Enterprise-level controls systems knowledge.
  • Sense of urgency, self-initiative, dedication, and ownership.
  • Outstanding follow-up and follow-through skills.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail while effectively prioritizing competing requirements.
  • Ability to build rapport and collaborate with local equipment, service, and controls teams.
  • Unwavering customer service orientation.
  • Experience utilizing Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce.com.
  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity qualification skills.
  • Acts as the primary contact with complex and strategic prospects for assigned customers.
  • Leads business development activities for account management teams within defined customer segments to support business strategy.
  • Leads and promotes bid opportunities, participates in preparation of bid responses, and negotiates with potential customers.
  • Develops and promotes new customer contact leads for the sales business development team.
  • Proactively supports and develops prospective projects with assigned customers and presents them to the sales business development team.
  • Champions personal customer relationships with prospective accounts to influence opportunities and develops customer presentations for specific customer needs.

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $117,500.00 - $234,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

raw.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Full Stack Engineer builds and owns features across YPO’s layered, AI-first platform from the member-facing React experience through the GraphQL API layer, into the AI-powered intelligence and data services that drive personalized leadership insights for YPO’s global member base.

This is a high-ownership, end-to-end role spanning the experience layer (React, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL), API and orchestration (Apigee, Auth0, Redis, Kafka), the AI-powered Leadership Intelligence layer (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Neo4j, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow), systems of record (Salesforce, PostgreSQL), and DevOps/hosting (AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog): taking features from concept through production release, instrumenting them, and iterating on data.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the full feature lifecycle architecture, implementation, code review, QA, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Build responsive React/TypeScript frontends integrated with Optimizely; design Apollo GraphQL schemas and resolvers served through Apigee; build modular Node.js/NestJS backend services using Redis for caching and Kafka for event-driven workflows.

  • Design and query PostgreSQL schemas (TypeORM/Prisma); collaborate on Snowflake pipelines and dbt models feeding the Leadership Intelligence layer.

  • Integrate OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs for AI-powered discovery, recommendations, and matching; work with Neo4j graph data for relationship-driven insights.

  • Use AI-assisted development workflows (pair programming, code generation, test scaffolding) to increase velocity without compromising quality; handle AI feature failures, timeouts, and token costs with a production mindset.

  • Instrument features with PostHog and Datadog; design and run A/B experiments and feature-flag rollouts via Optimizely; use data to drive iteration.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions, ADRs, and post-incident reviews; address performance bottlenecks across the stack (GraphQL resolvers, N+1 queries, frontend rendering, mobile time-to-interactive).

  • Partner with product, design, the Lead Security Engineer, and DevOps to ensure features are secure, well-architected, and operationally sound from the start.

SKILLS

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-cultural organization with international members, helping them achieve excellence in voluntary roles for YPO initiatives. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including strong diplomacy skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships with all levels of associates, members and vendors. Adaptable, insightful, empathetic and reliable. Great sense of humor and humility. 

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with initiative and common sense. Effective time management, organization and prioritization skills with the ability to focus on varied projects simultaneously. 

  • Possesses a distinct global mindset, sensitive to local and international customs and protocols.  

  • Demonstrate empathy through active listening and asking the right questions to find the source of an issue. 

  • Able to identify problems, research alternatives, provide solutions and/or resolve issues in a timely manner. Anticipates member/internal client needs and delivers with clarity. 

  • Analytical thinker with ability influence and guide processes with appropriate approach and execution. Natural curiosity and desire to learn more; proficiency and interest in applying new technologies and tools. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proof reading, with a meticulous attention to detail. Adjusts communication style appropriately to the audience.  

  • Professional presence, appearance, and stature to interact easily with YPO members, C-level executives and peers at all levels within the organization.  

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

  • 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience shipping production-grade products end-to-end.

  • Strong TypeScript/React skills (component architecture, state management, hooks, performance).

  • Backend experience with Node.js and NestJS building modular, tested services.

  • GraphQL experience (schema design, resolvers, subscriptions, Apollo client/server) and familiarity with API gateway patterns (Apigee or equivalent).

  • PostgreSQL proficiency (query optimization, schema design, TypeORM/Prisma).

  • Experience with Auth0 or equivalent identity platforms.

  • Familiarity with Redis and Kafka (or similar) for caching and event-driven/message-queue patterns.

PREFERED

  • Production experience with OpenAI, Google Gemini, or other LLM APIs (prompt engineering, rate limiting, fallback handling, cost management).

  • Strong architectural thinking and clear technical communication; experience with high-autonomy, end-to-end ownership.

  • Neo4j or other graph database experience.

  • Snowflake/data warehouse experience with dbt or Airflow.

  • Optimizely or similar experimentation/feature-management platforms.

  • Salesforce integration experience.

  • AWS experience (ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch).

  • Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

  • Testing with Vitest, Jest, or Playwright (unit, integration, e2e).

EDUCATION/TRAINING/CERTIFICATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate members and team members in multiple time zones.

  • Willingness and ability to travel, domestically and internationally, without restrictions, approximately 5-10% per year.

EOE

YPO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. YPO takes pride in supporting a diverse workforce and demonstrates this through its policies and practices. YPO does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Job Description:

Toxicologist

Collaboratewith Innovative 3Mers Around the World

Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, soit’sequally important you know that the company that you choose to workat, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This positionprovidesan opportunity to transition from other private, public,governmentor military experience to a 3M career.

The ImpactYou’llMakeinthis Role

As aToxicologist, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Conducting and communicating human health risk assessments on a broad range of 3M products, taking into considerationidentifiedhazards and exposure according to the intended product use. This includes assessing scientific literature, evaluating the toxicological database, determiningappropriate toxicologicaland other safety endpoints, conducting exposure assessments, and providing written documentation.

  • Authoring chemical hazard summaries for inclusion in 3M databases,advocating foralternative chemicalselectionwhere possible, and supportingchemicalsmanagement.

  • Recommending and coordinatingappropriate toxicologystudy placements withthird-party contract research organizations.

  • Actively evaluate emerging scientific methods, tools, and regulatory developments, andcontributeideas that improve the efficiency, quality, and scientific robustness of toxicological assessments.

  • Serving as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders and collaborating with project teams to support 3M’sbusiness priorities.

  • Demonstrating a personal commitment tomaintainingand enhancing technical and professional skills.

Your Skills and Expertise 

  • Master’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited universityin toxicology, pharmacology, biomedical or related scientific field of study.

  • Three (3) or more years of experience conducting toxicological assessments, human health risk assessments, or product safety evaluations, including the interpretation and integration of experimental and computational data to support business and regulatory decisions.

Additionalqualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • PhD, MD, or DVM with 1+ years of experience.

  • Board certification (DABT) is preferred but notrequired.

  • Demonstratedexpertisein the application of OECD QSAR Toolbox and other computational toxicology tools for hazard prediction, chemical categorization, read-across justification, and weight-of-evidence assessment. Ability to critically evaluate model outputs, document scientific rationale, and communicate conclusions effectivelyto stakeholders.

  • Strong interpersonal communication and technical writing skills withdemonstratedproficiencyworking effectively with technical staff from diverse backgrounds. Must be an effective communicator to technical and non-technical audiences in oral and written correspondences as well as presentation formats.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance independent work with cross-functional collaboration, effectively managing multipleprioritiesand delivering scientifically sound outcomes on schedule.

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Medical, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

This position is a contract role with Mochi Medical, a physician-owned professional corporation affiliated with Mochi Health Corp. Mochi Health is a management service organization that supports Mochi Medical by providing administrative and operational services, but the role and clinical practice are with Mochi Medical.

Employment for this position will be with Mochi Medical, a physician-owned professional corporation affiliated with Mochi Health, Corp. Mochi Health supports Mochi Medical by providing administrative and operational services, but the role and clinical practice are under Mochi Medical.

Capitated ModelContract / Remote (US-Only)

About The Role

Mochi Medical, originally founded as an obesity management practice, is expanding its virtual care model beyond weight management. We’re looking for Registered Dietitian & Nutritionists who are committed to delivering high-quality, accessible, and affordable care across a growing range of specialties. While obesity and metabolic health remain core areas of focus, our providers also support patients in areas such as dermatology, hormone replacement therapy, depression & anxiety, longevity, and hair loss. You will play a crucial role in guiding individuals through their health journey and provide personalized, evidence-based nutritional support. This role is ideal for someone passionate about metabolic health, behavioral change, and leveraging digital healthcare to improve patient outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct one-on-one virtual consultations to discuss nutrition, obesity medicine, and personalized meal planning.
  • Provide nutritional counseling that supports patients across multiple specialty areas (ex. dermatology, hormone health, mental wellness, longevity, hair loss, etc.) and recognizing the critical link between nutrition and whole-body health.
  • Build rapport, credibility, and engagement with members through exceptional communication.
  • Use motivational interviewing techniques to guide members toward sustainable lifestyle changes.
  • Provide guidance on lifestyle choices tailored to metabolic health, performance, and longevity goals.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest research on obesity medicine, binge eating disorder, and the nutritional dimensions of emerging specialty areas (e.g., gut-skin axis, hormonal balance, mood and diet).
  • Collaborate with our team of innovative healthcare providers to ensure holistic patient care.
  • Adapt to a fast-paced startup environment and contribute to team-wide improvements.
  • Engage in educational content creation (blog writing, social media, program development) as needed.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Licensed Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) with at least 1 year of experience.
  • Currently possess at least 1 state license.
  • Experienced in obesity medicine, binge eating disorder, and nutrition-based approaches to chronic and lifestyle-related conditions.
  • Proficient in online scheduling tools, EMR systems, and video-visit coordination.
  • Skilled in motivational interviewing and patient education.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, evolving startup environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience providing Medical Nutritional Therapy (MNT).
  • Willingness to obtain additional licenses.
  • Experience or interest in nutrition as it relates to one or more of the following: dermatology, hormone replacement therapy, mental health (depression & anxiety), longevity, or hair loss.
  • Active RDN licensure in one or more of the following priority states: Nevada, Maine, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, District of Columbia, Wyoming, Alaska, South Dakota, or Vermont.
  • Licensure in Connecticut, Kansas, Delaware, Wisconsin, Tennessee, Mississippi, or New Mexico is also a strong plus. We still encourage all qualified RDNs to apply regardless of state licensure.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Mission with impact: Join a nationwide team bringing dietitian care to patients who have rarely had access to it, and see your work show up in their outcomes.
  • Flexibility that is actually flexible: 100% remote. Set your own hours and your own breaks.
  • Technology that empowers: One platform for scheduling, video visits, and charting, with AI charting assistance.
  • Clinical support behind you: Direct access to our Medical Directors, plus a clinical support library of patient handouts and our nutrition protocol.
  • Collaborative community: A supportive network of RDs who share your passion for helping people live better through food, and who trade cases, resources, and wins.
  • Nutre meal discounts: A discount on Nutre’s chef-prepared meals.

Compensation

  • Job Type: 1099 contractor
  • Pay: Up to $60 per hour, with additional earning opportunities

raw.title: Engineering Manager - GRC
raw.excerpt: Today, issue management across GRC is fragmented.
raw.description:
Today, issue management across GRC is fragmented. A finding surfaces in a controls test, an audit, or a risk assessment, and the work to fix it scatters across spreadsheets, email, and disconnected tools. Owners are unclear, deadlines slip quietly, and proving that an issue was actually resolved could mean reconstructing evidence after the fact.


The Issue Management team exists to change that: one system of record for remediation with a consistent lifecycle across GRC solutions. The Engineering Manager is accountable for the health of a delivery pipeline, the growth of the engineers on it, and the quality bar the team holds itself to. You will own the engineering decisions, architecture, and resourcing for a domain where AI-assisted remediation is the north star: issues are triaged, routed, and tracked to closure with intelligence, and every action, decision, and piece of evidence is traceable and defensible to auditors and regulators.


What You’ll Own

Team & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead a team of engineers, assigning roles and tasks based on team goals and individual growth areas
  • Own the delivery schedule for your team and communicate risk to group leadership early
  • Own the issue management lifecycle and the patterns that keep it consistent across all GRC solutions alongside your Product and Design counterparts
  • Drive development of core issue management capabilities: issue and action plan management, workflow and approvals, notifications and escalation, evidence capture, and the public APIs other solutions and customers build on
  • Build and maintain the audit trail, history, and evidence infrastructure that make remediation status trustworthy and defensible to auditors
  • Define and execute product quality strategy in partnership with group leaders and individual contributors
  • Reinforce Workiva values, principles, product development standards, and agile practices across your squad(s)

People Leadership

  • Assess and document individual performance accurately, recognizing real contribution and growth, not just output volume
  • Run regular 1:1s that build trust and surface what’s actually going on, not just status updates
  • Coach engineers through career development, technical growth, and obstacles, including hard conversations when performance needs to change
  • Own team health: build a positive, engaged environment and resolve conflict directly rather than letting it fester
  • Prioritize your reports’ growth deliberately, identifying and creating opportunities that match where they want to go
  • Participate actively in recruiting, selection, and onboarding of new team members

Cross-Functional & Technical Ownership

  • Serve as the engineering voice alongside the Product Manager and UX Lead, shaping domain direction together
  • Manage collaboration at the seams where upstream solutions integrate into the issue management solution; define those contracts clearly and early.
  • Represent your team’s resourcing needs and priorities to group leadership with clear tradeoffs, not just requests
  • Partner with group leaders to define and plan team and group objectives
  • Identify technical risk early and communicate it clearly to leadership, before it becomes a fire

AI-Era Engineering Judgment

  • Build toward AI-assisted workflows while maintaining full manual paths for practitioners who need them
  • Ensure all AI-generated outputs are explainable, auditable, and traceable to source data; a human stays accountable for every decision
  • Hold the quality bar for AI-generated content to the trust standard required by high-stakes GRC audiences: boards, audit committees, and regulators
  • Evaluate your team’s output based on judgment and outcomes, not shipped volume, distinguishing genuine skill growth from AI-assisted output that looks productive but isn’t
  • Ensure your team’s code review and quality gates keep pace with AI-generated code, catching hallucinated logic, subtle errors, and security gaps before they ship
  • Coach engineers to work effectively with AI while keeping the ability to work and reason without it

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field with 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, or equivalent experience in lieu of a degree
  • 3+ years directly managing engineers, including supervisory experience of supervisors and/or individual contributors

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, set priorities, and meet deadlines in a high-compliance environment
  • A people-first mindset, with real experience in career development, performance coaching, and building team culture
  • Experience with GRC, compliance, audit, or risk management domains or similar high-compliance, high-stakes product domains
  • Experience building shared platform capabilities consumed by multiple product teams
  • Experience with workflow, state-machine, or case-management systems
  • Experience evaluating engineering output in an AI-augmented environment, able to tell the difference between genuine skill growth and AI-assisted volume
  • Strong communicator, comfortable in conflict resolution and facilitating hard discussions
  • Solid grounding in SDLC, computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design
  • Experience with automated testing or SDLC process improvement
  • Experience in an Agile development environment

Travel & Working Conditions

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for team and corporate meetings
  • Reliable internet access for remote work, as we support flexible work arrangement

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $129,000.00 - $210,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.
