A Day in the Life

The Acute Surgical business within Medtronic partners with healthcare providers to support patient care through a comprehensive portfolio of surgical technologies. This role supports the full Surgical portfolio, including Stapling, Energy, Electrosurgery, Situate, Access & Instrumentation, and Wound Closure, helping customers optimize product utilization and achieve clinical and operational objectives.

This is a remote position that supports an assigned geographic territory through virtual selling activities, customer engagement, and collaboration with field-based partners. Travel up to 25% is required to support customer meetings, business reviews, training, and team collaboration.

As an Inside Sales Representative, Acute Surgical, you will drive revenue growth and customer retention across an assigned territory through virtual sales execution, account management, and customer education. This role partners closely with field sales, clinical, and commercial teams to expand product adoption, identify new business opportunities, and support customers throughout the sales process.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Drive disposable and capital equipment sales growth by managing and expanding business within assigned accounts.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new sales opportunities while maintaining strong retention of existing customers.
  • Promote adoption and utilization of Acute Surgical products across targeted healthcare facilities and stakeholders.
  • Conduct virtual customer meetings, product presentations, and demonstrations to support product awareness and purchasing decisions.
  • Build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals, supply chain stakeholders, and key decision-makers within assigned accounts.
  • Analyze territory performance and account data to identify growth opportunities and develop targeted sales strategies.
  • Collaborate with field sales, marketing, and cross-functional partners to execute territory plans and customer engagement initiatives.
  • Resolve customer concerns and provide ongoing support to ensure a positive customer experience.


Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 6+ years of relevant sales, customer support, or related experience in medical devices, medtech, healthcare, or life sciences; OR Associate's Degree and 4+ years of relevant experience; OR Bachelor's Degree and 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Proven track record of achieving sales objectives and managing customer relationships within an assigned territory or account base.
  • Experience identifying, developing, and closing sales opportunities while maintaining and growing existing accounts.
  • Ability to analyze account and territory performance data to identify growth opportunities and develop sales strategies.
  • Ability to occasionally travel up to 25% within the assigned territory and for business-related meetings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Medical device, healthcare, or surgical products sales experience.
  • Experience selling to hospitals, healthcare systems, ambulatory surgery centers, or related clinical environments.
  • Demonstrated success driving product adoption, utilization, and account penetration initiatives.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and virtual selling capabilities.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or providing guidance to other sales professionals.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human imagination and intelligence. Make the choice, join our diverse team today!

We are looking for an outstanding hands-on architect/engineer for a Senior HPC architect role to support deployment and bringup of large-scale GPU compute clusters. Be a key player to enable the most exciting computing hardware and software and contribute to the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and GPU computing. Provide insights on and implement at-scale system administration and tuning mechanisms for large-scale compute runs. You will work with the latest accelerated computing and Deep Learning software and hardware platforms, and with many scientific researchers, developers, and customers to craft improved workflows and develop new, leading differentiated solutions. You will interact with HPC, OS, GPU compute, and systems specialist to architect, develop and bring up large scale performance platforms.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Provide engineering solutions to operationalize the latest GPU Computing products and software stacks, ensure technical relationships with internal and external engineering teams, and assisting systems, machine learning/deep learning engineers in building creative solutions based on NVIDIA technology.

  • Be an internal reference for system administration, at-scale system analysis, and other datacenter and large-scale GPU-accelerated system solutions among the NVIDIA technical community.

What we need to see:

  • 8+ years of experience using in accelerated computing for datacenter/HPC-based Enterprise computing solutions.

  • Solid understanding of accelerated computing scheduling and I/O stacks.

  • C/C++/Python/Bash programming/scripting experience.

  • Experience working with engineering or academic research community supporting high performance computing or deep learning.

  • Experience with parallel filesystems.

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Ability to multitask effectively in a dynamic environment.

  • Action driven with strong analytical skills.

  • Desire to be involved in multiple diverse and innovative projects.

  • BS (or equivalent experience) in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Computer Science. MS or PhD desirable.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Deep Learning framework skills.

  • Exposure to using and deploying telemetry and visualization pipelines

  • Exposure to container technology and Linux performance tools.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 8, 2026.

raw.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a dedicated engineer for the Senior Systems Software Engineer role, focusing on GPU Performance at Scale. At NVIDIA, this role is uniquely positioned to drive innovation in AI and GPU computing. You will contribute to world-class computing hardware and software, fueling groundbreaking advancements in artificial intelligence. You will provide insights on large-scale system composition and tuning mechanisms for high-performance compute runs. Collaborate with researchers, developers, and customers to craft improved workflows and develop new, leading solutions. Engage with HPC, OS, CPU, GPU compute, and systems specialists to architect, build, and optimize large-scale performance platforms.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the implementation of performance practices in large-scale GPU infrastructure, delivering powerful tools, methodologies, and flows to validate and improve multiple datacenter products concurrently.

  • Align next-generation AI workloads with next-generation datacenter builds for NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and networking hardware. Engage early with HW/FW/SW/platform internal and customer teams.

  • Develop engineering solutions that provide continuous insights into the performance of AI workloads in evolving environments, generating swift insights into improvements and regressions.

  • Decompose high-complexity performance or stability issues into minimal reproduction cases, working towards identifying the root cause.

  • Participate in collaborations with various SW and FW teams (BMC/SBIOS/OS/drivers, etc.) to develop outstanding methods and tools. Analyze, debug, and resolve critical firmware and software issues to achieve the highest AI workload performance at scale.

What we need to see:

  • Proven understanding of accelerated computing software stacks (CUDA).

  • Experience with modern cloud and container-based enterprise computing architectures, with Slurm preferred.

  • Strong programming and scripting experience in C/C++/Python/Bash.

  • Deep expertise in systems architecture and the impact of various components on performance.

  • Experience with container technology and Linux-based OSes, with Docker preferred.

  • Experience supporting high-performance computing or deep learning in engineering or academic research communities.

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, coupled with results-focused analytical abilities.

  • BS in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Computer Science (or equivalent experience); MS or PhD desirable with 8+ years of applicable experience.

Ways to Stand Out From the Crowd

  • End-to-end GPU performance engineering from the profiler to systems analysis.

  • Linux systems programming and optimization experience.

  • Exposure to virtualization techniques and cloud platform solutions.

  • Experience with scheduling and resource management systems.

  • Experience with large-scale HPC environments.

Cardinal Health's Pharmaceutical & Specialty Solutions business helps specialty physician practices deliver high-quality, cost-effective patient care through a broad portfolio of specialty medications, innovative solutions, and industry expertise. We are committed to supporting oncology providers with the products, services, and partnerships they need to deliver exceptional patient care.


The Account Director – Oncology Provider is a Director level individual contributor role responsible for expanding the Cardinal Health Specialty footprint within existing community-based oncology provider office customer bases by pursuing new product lines, technology services and the retention of existing business within a defined geography. This leader will ensure a strong market presence for Cardinal Health Specialty within drug distribution and technology solutions that support community oncology practices. This role will partner closely with other Sales Executives, Key Account Managers and Inside Sales to ensure a strong Cardinal Health network and a seamless focus on the customer.

This position reports to the Director, Account Management. This is a remote role with travel up to 50%.

Territory: East Coast United States

Responsibilities

  • Grow market share and profitability through the execution of consultative sales strategies and tactics
  • Deliver well designed, compelling sales presentations to executive customers
  • Manage executive relationships with a myriad of professionals
  • Develop territory business plans; communicate real-time updates to all appropriate stakeholders
  • Manage key accounts effectively and efficiently within specific assigned geographic regions
  • Demonstrate professional development initiative; keep abreast of industry changes
  • Participate in, and when asked lead, sales training programs
  • Mentor junior members of the sales team
  • Utilize Cardinal Health’s CRM to maintain accurate records, track business, monitor sales leads and enact retention and expansion strategies
  • Provide reliable competitive intelligence to appropriate stakeholders
  • Professionally represent Cardinal Health at industry association and tradeshow events
  • Develop key relationships with pharmaceutical company counterparts; appropriately leverage the relationships for mutual benefit
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or commiserate experience preferred; graduate degree preferred
  • Minimum eight years of healthcare sales and complex account/relationship management experience
  • Experience with customers of and understanding of oncology practice business
  • Experience with contracting, demand realization, and GPO pull through
  • Excellent planning, forecasting, financial and negotiation skills
  • Proven ability to design win-win strategies for Cardinal Health and the client base
  • Self-starter; able to independently determine solutions that ensure business objectives are achieved within acceptable limits
  • Demonstrated matrix management skills; ability to work with cross-functional teams
  • Strong executive presence, presentation and communication capabilities
  • Ability to travel 50% within the territory; work from home when not traveling

  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)

  • Healthy lifestyle programs

description: Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

raw.title: Sustainability Analyst
raw.excerpt: Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.
raw.description:
Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Description

Position Overview

The Sustainability Analyst supports Amcor Rigid Packaging North America's sustainability strategy through data management, reporting, compliance, and stakeholder engagement. This role is responsible for administering key sustainability platforms, driving data quality and integrity across global manufacturing sites, leading life cycle assessment (LCA) work, managing regulatory and compliance programs, and supporting both internal and external reporting obligations. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, cross-functional communication ability, and a proactive approach to managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs in a fast-paced environment.


Essential Responsibilities & Duties

  • Administer and maintain Altruistiq (AQ), Amcor’s primary sustainability data platform: user management, configuration, training new users, and recurring office hours for site troubleshooting.
  • Conduct quarterly data validation cycles, issue completion reports and reminders to drive on-time submissions, and review site methodology templates annually.
  • Support Scope 3 GHG reporting, coordinate sustainability targets, and manage reporting to Amcor Limited per the GHG Protocol.
  • Build and refine dashboards and reporting tools for QSR, PCR, recyclability, and transportation, and automate data pulls to improve efficiency, accuracy, and access.
  • Lead integration of legacy Berry and Amcor site data into unified global reporting, and drive continuous improvement in data collection, assurance, and insights.
  • Collect and maintain packaging, component, SKU, customer, and product-line data, running quality checks to resolve outliers, inconsistencies, and duplicates.
  • Document analysis methodology and assumptions for transparency, reproducibility, and audit readiness.
  • Conduct Life Cycle Assessments to substantiate environmental claims, present findings at conferences, expos, and customer meetings, and support discussions on LCA methodology, carbon reduction roadmaps, and Amcor’s sustainability commitments.
  • Support customers’ EPR obligations and translate product specifications into structured data for regulatory compliance.
  • Administer the Sedex program across all Amcor Rigid Packaging sites, including customer linking and audit prep with site HR teams.
  • Support internal and external year-end audits through documentation, logistics, and data accuracy.
  • Assist with recyclability and QSR reporting and contribute to corporate disclosures, sustainability partnerships, and the Annual Sustainability Report.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2-3 years of experience in sustainability, environmental management, or a related role, preferably in a manufacturing or packaging context.
  • Demonstrated experience with sustainability data platforms and GHG reporting frameworks (e.g., GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3).
  • Strong analytical and data management skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with data visualization or BI tools a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Altruistiq, Sedex, or similar sustainability/ESG platforms.
  • Familiarity with Life Cycle Assessment methodology and tools.
  • Knowledge of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations.
  • Experience supporting third-party audits.

Our Expectations

title: Account Manager Italy
description: DO IT Organic has been active in the Italian market for many years, but there is still plenty of room to grow.

raw.title: Account Manager Italy
raw.excerpt: DO IT Organic has been active in the Italian market for many years, but there is still plenty of room to grow.
raw.description:
DO IT Organic has been active in the Italian market for many years, but there is still plenty of room to grow. That’s why we are looking for a commercial and proactive Account Manager who wants to strengthen our position in Italy and make a visible impact on our growth.

You will build long-term relationships with Italian food manufacturers, grow existing accounts and create new business across our broad portfolio of organic ingredients.

What will you be doing?

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing sustainable and profitable customer relationships in the Italian market. You will manage existing accounts, identify new opportunities and connect customers with the right organic ingredients from our broad portfolio.

As an Account Manager, your responsibilities include:

  • Growing existing accounts by identifying opportunities for new products, categories and applications.

  • Actively developing new business and building relationships with potential customers.

  • Managing the complete sales process, from first contact to long-term partnership.

  • Staying close to customers through regular calls, visits and follow-ups.

  • Negotiating prices, volumes and commercial agreements, with a clear focus on sustainable and profitable growth.

  • Keeping opportunities, forecasts and customer information accurate and up to date in our CRM.

  • Managing the administrative side of your accounts and ensuring timely internal follow-up.

  • Sharing customer insights, market developments and opportunities with your colleagues.

  • Working closely with colleagues in Sales, Category Management, Quality and other teams to find the best solutions for customers.

  • Representing DO IT Organic during customer visits and trade fairs in Italy and abroad.

As you will be based in Italy and work remotely, this role offers a lot of freedom and responsibility. You should be comfortable working independently while actively staying connected with colleagues. Some days will be filled with customer conversations and travel, while others require you to focus on follow-ups, administration and developing your pipeline. As we are growing, not every process is set in stone yet, so you should be comfortable adapting, finding solutions and taking ownership when things change.

What will you bring?

You are commercially driven and entrepreneurial, with a natural ability to spot opportunities, find solutions and grow both new and existing business. You also bring:

  • Around 5-10 years of experience in B2B sales or account management, combined with experience in or a good understanding of the food industry.

  • Full-time availability of 40 hours per week.

  • Fluency in Italian and English.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Willingness to travel regularly for customer visits and trade fairs, as well as to our headquarters in the Netherlands.

  • A genuine interest in sustainability and organic food.

Who are we?

For over 35 years, DO IT Organic has been building a fully organic food chain together with more than 30,000 farmers and 180 suppliers worldwide. Our portfolio includes over 1,000 organic products, ranging from food ingredients to private label solutions and our own brands, La Bio Idea and Amaizin.

We partner with customers who value quality, sustainability and transparency. As a certified B Corp, we are committed to driving positive change and were recently honoured with the prestigious King Willem I Award for Sustainable Entrepreneurship.

With strong growth and ambitious plans ahead, we are looking for people who want to help shape our future, adapt with us, and make a real impact.

What do we offer?

You will work closely with your colleague in Italy and stay connected with colleagues across different countries, including at our headquarters in the Netherlands. This gives you both the independence to develop your market and the support of a wider international team.

Your employment conditions, including holiday entitlement and pension arrangements, will be aligned with the applicable local requirements in Italy. During the recruitment process, we will explain what this means for your situation.

Curious about the salary?
During an initial phone call, we’re happy to give you an indication of the salary range for this role. The final offer will be tailored to your experience, knowledge, and responsibilities.

Ready to apply?

Ready to grow the Italian market with us? The sooner you apply, the sooner you can start contributing to our mission!

Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3) to protect the whole home.

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Senior Corporate Development Manager

Location: United States

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Corporate Development Manager.

We are seeking an experienced, highly capable professional to join our Corporate Development team. The Corporate Development group is responsible for leading Porch's acquisition activity, driving enterprise-level business development, and executing critical strategic initiatives across the organization — all under the direct leadership of the VP, Corporate Development, who reports to the CEO. This is a high-impact individual-contributor role that sits at the intersection of M&A, business development, and corporate strategy, offering direct exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to shape Porch's long-term growth trajectory. The Senior Manager's primary emphasis will be leading the integration of newly acquired companies and ensuring Porch maximizes value through M&A. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative, and is passionate about solving meaningful business problems with wide latitude.

What You Will Do As A Senior Corporate Development Manager

  • Source and screen potential acquisition targets, developing well-reasoned points of view on strategic and financial fit.
  • Support due diligence workstreams and coordinate cross-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Operations) to drive deal execution from term sheet through close.
  • Create detailed project plans for acquisition integrations, with clear identification of resources, dependencies, risks, and milestones.
  • Drive integration project plans with clear goals, operating mechanisms, and regular updates to stakeholders.
  • Assist in building an integration toolkit and framework that can support a high volume of M&A activity.
  • Contribute to enterprise business development efforts, including pipeline building and managing partner relationships.
  • Lead targeted strategy projects from scoping through execution, with guidance from the VP, Corporate Development.
  • Leverage company-provided tools, systems, and AI technologies to support daily work, staying current on new tools as they are introduced.

What You Will Bring As A Senior Corporate Development Manager

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field (required); MBA a plus. Or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years in M&A, partnerships, or business development, with Property and Casualty Insurance industry experience strongly preferred — home services, utilities, or B2B SaaS experience also valued.
  • 2–4 years of directly related M&A integration experience in a matrixed organization supporting multiple functions.
  • Proven program management skills to organize and manage large-scale, complex projects, including M&A, organizational change, operational restructuring, business process redesign, and systems implementations.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating acquisition opportunities (both strategically and financially) and managing day-to-day execution of transactions (required).
  • Track record of driving results on critical initiatives over a sustained period of time (12+ months) (required).
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with expert-level proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Clear, concise, and persuasive written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with a proven ability to navigate ambiguity and operate with wide latitude in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience building enterprise business development pipelines and early-stage relationships (preferred).
  • Experience operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, or startup environment (preferred).

The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from 8/7/2026. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs.

At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states or jurisdictions for Remote positions: Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Mississippi, Nebraska, Montana, New Hampshire, West Virginia, or the District of Columbia.

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: $138,800 – $194,300 annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets, job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

Additionally, you will be eligible to receive long-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

You will also be eligible to receive an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing.

  • Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3) Medical plan options, two (2) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose.
  • Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis.
  • We offer pre-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options.
  • We provide company paid Basic Life and AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD&D plans.
  • Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match.
  • Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation.
  • LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more.
  • Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs.

#Remote

Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! If your resume gets us intrigued, we will look to connect with you for a chat to learn more about your background, and then possibly invite you to have virtual interviews. What's important to call out is that we want to make sure not only that you're the right person for us, but also that we're the right next step for you, so come prepared with all the questions you have!

We are now looking for a Senior Software Engineer for Agent Simulation & Evaluation! Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work.

Demand for inference is growing rapidly, driven by reasoning models, coding agents, parallel subagents, and long-horizon tool use. These workloads are increasing the complexity of how AI systems must be evaluated, simulated, and optimized across different accelerator platforms. We are looking for an AI-native engineer who can combine a strong understanding of model architectures with performance analysis across GPU and LPU systems. You will use agentic methods to streamline simulation, evaluation, and critical engineering workflows for the LPU organization, helping NVIDIA develop a deeper understanding of emerging AI workloads and how they map to future hardware.

What you will be doing:

  • Building agentic systems that automate simulation, evaluation, performance analysis, and reporting.

  • Developing tools that configure experiments, run evaluations, analyze results, identify regressions, and recommend follow-up work.

  • Analyzing the inference characteristics of LLMs, reasoning models, coding agents, multimodal models, and agentic harnesses.

  • Building and validating performance models for GPU, LPU, and heterogeneous GPU–LPU systems.

  • Collaborating with inference, hardware, runtime, compiler, evaluation, and product teams to improve simulation quality and accelerate engineering decisions.

  • Automating critical LPU workflows such as benchmarking, workload characterization, capacity planning, and release qualification.

What we need to see:

  • Strong experience building AI agents or AI-backed engineering systems.

  • Familiarity with modern model architectures and AI inference workloads.

  • Experience evaluating AI models or agents and analyzing performance.

  • Experience with simulation, profiling, benchmarking, or performance modelling.

  • Strong Python skills and experience building reliable engineering tools.

  • MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of relevant software development experience.

  • 2 years of experience building AI agents or building AI-backed engineering systems.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience using coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, or similar tools to automate technical workflows.

  • Knowledge of GPU or accelerator architecture, distributed inference, or high-performance computing.

  • Open-source projects demonstrating agentic AI, evaluation, or performance-engineering applications.

  • A rigorous analytical approach to experimentation, data collection, and validation.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you’re creative, analytical, and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

In a world of noise, we find the signal — the pulse of potential. We weave the strands of talent, vision, and purpose into organizations that endure. Blending intelligence with intuition, we honor the human art of connection at the heart of every great company.

Remote (USA) | Base $135,000 to $150,000 plus commission | Target Year 1 OTE $300,000

ABOUT THE JOB

Build a new market in the industry you already know.

Our client is a fast-growing outsourcing company that builds dedicated remote teams for US businesses. Their people handle customer support, sales support, scheduling, admin, and back-office work inside the client’s own systems, as part of the client’s team. They became a known name in two niche industries by learning those businesses deeply, and the model worked well enough that they’re now taking it into new markets, starting with an acquisition that opens the door to real estate.

They’re hiring one or two Vice Presidents of Business Development to lead that expansion. Each VP owns a vertical: Real Estate, Home Services and Construction, Waste Management and Environmental Services, or Hospitality. You’ll build the go-to-market from the ground up: who to call, what to offer them, how to price and package it, and how to turn the first few clients into a reputation. You’ll report to the Senior Vice President of Sales and work alongside Marketing and Customer Experience. This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial seat for someone who wants to build a market, not inherit one.

THE MANDATE

Our client is clear about who will thrive in this role, and who won’t.

They’re not looking for someone who has spent their career selling staffing, outsourcing, or BPO services. They’re not looking for a strategist who needs a team to execute, or an account manager who’s most comfortable growing relationships someone else opened.

They’re seeking an industry insider: someone who has spent years in real estate, home services or construction, waste and environmental services, or hospitality, running part of the business or selling into it, who knows the owners and operators by name and understands where the work piles up: the phones, the scheduling, the paperwork, the follow-up that never gets done. You can sit across from a CEO and talk about their business, not about outsourcing. You don’t need to have sold a service like this before. They’ll teach you the offering. You bring the industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own new business for your vertical, from first conversation to signed agreement, with a pipeline you build yourself
  • Design the go-to-market for a new industry: the ideal client profile, the offer, the pricing conversation, and the partnerships that open doors
  • Land strategic partnerships and national accounts, then deepen them
  • Be the face of the company in your industry: conferences, trade associations, client visits, and the dinners where deals get started
  • Work with Marketing and Customer Experience so what you sell is what gets delivered, and what you hear in the market shapes the offer
  • Help set the strategic direction of the division as the new verticals take hold

IDEAL PROFILE

  • 5+ years in B2B business development with deep relationships in one of the target industries: real estate, home services and construction, waste management and environmental services, or hospitality
  • 5+ years in senior sales leadership with a track record of winning in that industry, or selling into it
  • Comfortable building and managing relationships with owners and the C-suite
  • Experience in high-growth environments, using data and technology to drive results
  • An entrepreneur’s mindset: strategic enough to design the plan, hands-on enough to run it
  • Collaborative, efficient, and motivated by results; you want to win the day
  • Energized by networking and industry events
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, management, communication, or a related field
  • Strong written and spoken communication; tech-savvy and quick to adopt new tools
  • Not required: any background in outsourcing, staffing, or BPO

LOCATION & WORK MODEL

  • Remote, anywhere in the US
  • Core hours Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central
  • Travel for industry events, conferences, and client meetings

COMPENSATION

Base salary: $135,000 to $150,000, plus commission

Target OTE: $300,000

raw.description:
We are seeking a Public Health Data Analyst to support data analysis, data quality, visualization, and epidemiologic activities for public health surveillance programs. This position combines hands-on quantitative analysis with an understanding of epidemiology, surveillance systems, and public health data.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in either public health surveillance, including syndromic surveillance and ESSENCE, or analytical programming and data analysis using R or comparable tools. This role offers the opportunity to apply those skills to meaningful public health surveillance work while developing additional expertise and working closely with project colleagues and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyze public health surveillance data using ESSENCE, R, and other analytical tools to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, data-quality issues, and potential public health events of interest.
  • Support enhanced and time-sensitive surveillance activities, including analysis, reporting, and development or maintenance of analytical and dashboard products using CDC-provided formats and requirements.
  • Contribute to reports, slides, dashboards, and other analytical products for CDC and response partners, working with senior epidemiologists and analysts as appropriate.
  • Support the development, testing, and validation of syndrome definitions and surveillance categories, incorporating feedback from CDC subject-matter experts and STLT public health partners.
  • Support analysis and reporting of emergency department data and additional public health data sources, such as NNDSS, commercial laboratory, Veteran’s Affairs, and other data sources, as they are incorporated into surveillance activities.
  • Take ownership of assigned analytical work, manage multiple priorities and short timelines, and communicate questions, issues, or risks as they arise.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Data Science, Informatics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field and 2-4 years of relevant professional experience in public health, epidemiology, healthcare data analysis, surveillance, or a related analytical field.
  • 3+ years experience with either public health or syndromic surveillance, including ESSENCE or comparable surveillance systems; or 3+ years experience with analytical programming and data analysis using R, or comparable tools.
  • Experience analyzing public health, epidemiologic, healthcare, or other complex datasets.
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned work, manage competing priorities, and communicate questions or issues as they arise.
  • Understanding of basic epidemiologic and statistical concepts.
  • Experience cleaning, transforming, validating, analyzing, or visualizing data.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with syndromic surveillance and/or ESSENCE.
  • Experience using R or other analytical programming tools for public health or epidemiologic analysis.
  • Experience working with state, local, tribal, or territorial (STLT) public health agencies or their surveillance data, systems, or reporting activities.
  • Master's degree in Epidemiology, Public Health, Biostatistics, Data Science, Informatics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Familiarity with healthcare and public health data standards or terminology, such as HL7, ICD-9/10, SNOMED, or LOINC.

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy when serving both internal and external teams
  • Advanced organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

raw.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel


Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Clinical Data Associate II to join our team in South Africa in a remote capacity.


As a Clinical Data Associate II, you will support global clinical research programs by delivering high-quality data management activities across Phase I-IV clinical studies. This position plays a key role in clinical data quality, regulatory compliance, study execution, and cross-functional collaboration.


You will partner with clinical teams, statisticians, programmers, CRAs, vendors, and study management teams to ensure accurate and timely data collection, review, reconciliation, and database management activities. Responsibilities include supporting and leading data management activities, coordinating Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, developing study documentation, and contributing to database lock and study deliverables.


You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment dedicated to a single sponsor and supporting important commercial and development programs worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to clinical research that advances new therapies while expanding your expertise across data management processes, clinical technologies, and cross-functional study operations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead a small clinical study or co-lead larger studies with moderate guidance.
  • Support multiple clinical studies while ensuring high standards of data quality and delivery.
  • Manage and monitor data management activities performed by CROs and external vendors.
  • Review study protocols and evaluate data capture requirements, including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.
  • Collaborate with CRAs, programmers, study managers, and statisticians to develop annotated eCRFs and CRF completion guidelines.
  • Develop data edit check specifications and generate study data listings as required.
  • Coordinate the design, testing, and issue resolution of Electronic Data Capture systems in accordance with company standards.
  • Develop and maintain study Data Management Plans and supporting documentation
  • Perform query management, external data reconciliations, and Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities.
  • Support database upgrades, migrations, user acceptance testing, database freeze activities, and database lock activities.
  • Maintain study workbooks and data management files while ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of data management SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation.

Candidate Profile


You'll thrive in this role if you bring:


  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.
  • Experience working within clinical research and regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams as well as with external partners and vendors.
  • A patient-focused mindset with a commitment to data quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Comfort working with Electronic Data Capture systems, clinical databases, and multiple technology platforms.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's Degree in a scientific or healthcare-related field.
  • At least two years' experience in Data Management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Understanding of Phase I-IV clinical studies and demonstrated ability to perform core Data Management activities and work with vendors.
  • Knowledge of ICH/FDA guidance, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR Part 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, and related industry standards.
  • Experience with Electronic Data Capture systems and clinical data management technologies. RAVE experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication, organization, technical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in Oncology or CNS therapeutic areas.
  • Experience supporting Phase III pivotal studies.

Benefits and Compensation


  • Medical Aid Contribution
  • Gap Cover
  • Life Assurance
  • Provident Fund (8%)
  • 13th Cheque

If this job does not sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know someone who would be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply.


We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

Wir besetzen aktuell eine Rolle als Microsoft 365 Architect bei einem führenden Anbieter von IT-Infrastruktur und Managed-Services in Österreich.

In dieser Position setzt du spannende Projekte bei unterschiedlichen Kunden um, übernimmst Beratungsaufgaben und führst Workshops zu vielfältigen Microsoft 365 Themen wie Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Security & Compliance oder Copilot Chat/Suche durch. General Description:

BeOne Medicines Global Research and Development Technology Solutions (GRDTS) team is seeking a motivated, enthusiastic, and experienced Digital & Technology Systems Director to join our Development Technology team. The director, Global Digital & Technology Systems will own the end-to-end system management life cycle of the portfolio of external systems and solutions used by the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) function at BeOne.

The ideal candidate should bring deep knowledge of the clinical space and experience working in Cloud/SaaS environments with the ability to manage multiple projects across different functions in a global, geographically diverse environment. The candidate should also be experienced at running technology projects from a strategy, technology, security, process, finance, and people management standpoint. As a system owner, the individual must demonstrate a strong understanding of system lifecycle management and be able to provide technical expertise while guiding system administration activities. Additionally, they should be adept at fostering collaboration among stakeholders to ensure the system aligns with organizational goals and meets regulatory requirements.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Accountable for the entire lifecycle management of all external Global Clinical Operations (GCO) applications and platforms.

  • Responsible for end-to-end system management and oversight of all GCO external systems:

    • Implementation and delivery of systems/applications and projects that meet GCO business needs, including key initiatives to support GCO goals and objectives.

    • Provide data, digital, and technology systems expertise to GCO stakeholders for their domain related needs.

    • Coordinate and drive system maintenance such as security patching, version upgrades, enhancements and configuration changes focused on improving business processes, addressing gaps, and enabling automation and organizational growth.

    • Collaborate with GCO and GRDTS leadership to develop long-term strategies for external systems enhancements and technology investments.

    • Partner with stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop business cases that justify and prioritize system initiatives, ensuring alignment with the overall business plan.

    • Develop and manage budget around external systems ensuring alignment with organization objectives and cost-efficiency.

    • Ensure data integrity, security, and proper governance of information processed through external systems.

    • Coordinate and manage incident response for external system issues, ensuring timely resolution and communication with stakeholders.

    • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to system architecture, functionality, and operational procedures.

    • Provide guidance and support to end-users, facilitating training programs to enhance system utilization and productivity.

    • Identify potential risks related to GCO external systems, establish mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

    • Engage and collaborate with third-party vendors, service providers, and stakeholders to manage contracts, performance and service level agreements (SLAs).

    • Foster collaboration across functions to ensure seamless integration of clinical systems with corporate enterprise systems, thereby enhancing overall operational effectiveness.

Collaboration within GRDTS:

  • Collaborate with other GRDTS capabilities & teams, including Technology & Systems Engineering, GRDTS Operations to deliver solutions for the GCO function within allocated budgets.

  • Ensure all GCO-related systems and data platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal functional & Enterprise policies including security policies.

  • Liaise with computer system vendors, IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities.

  • Work within a framework and operating model that supports the current and future technology needs for GCO, that comprises requirements management, solutioning, build, implementation, and administration (run) of global Development platforms, master data, and system interfaces

GRDTS GCO Systems Management Team Leadership:

Team Leadership & Talent Development:

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing GCO Systems Management team focused on end-to-end system lifecycle management for all external GCO systems and platforms.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and drive professional development.

Operational Excellence, Compliance & Governance:

  • Ensure all systems and platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal security policies.

  • Liaise with vendors, Enterprise IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities

  • Ensure the team is trained in and embeds CSV, compliance, and health authority requirements into operational activities.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborate with R&D functions and teams on standards and best practices to attain business goals

  • Engage with peers to define, sponsor, and execute continuous improvements.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience working on validated applications in a pharmaceutical or regulated environment, primarily clinical applications and/or systems management in a pharmaceutical or medical device industry especially in CTMS, eTMF, IRT, EDC, SSU management.

  • 8+ years of experience working in a GxP or regulated environment with a strong understanding of SLC methodology, 21CFR Part 11 and GAMP principles.

  • 5+ years of proven leadership at a senior level managing a team of direct reports and associate staff

  • Proven experience in overseeing the direction, planning, installation, implementation, and maintenance of software solutions especially in the SaaS/Hybrid cloud environment.

  • Good working knowledge of O365, active directory technology and schema, and SaaS to SaaS application integration framework.

  • Working knowledge of IaaS (Amazon Web Services, Azure) PaaS and SaaS architectures and technology options a plus.

  • Extensive experience in business and technical analysis, including developing requirements and translating them into data-driven and technical solutions

  • Strong expertise in data management practices, including data integrity, accuracy, and reliability

  • Significant experience delivering technical projects and managing multiple initiatives across diverse functions in a global environment

  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to several technology areas, demonstrating a proactive approach to industry trends and innovations

Supervisory Responsibilities:

· Manage team members (employees and contingent workers) at global sites, including coaching and mentoring of staff with training and professional development.

· Must be an effective leader and communicator and considered to be a developer of people comfortable working with a broad cross-section of people in direct and matrixed relationships.

Key Capabilities

  • Strategic System Roadmap: Translating long-term clinical objectives into a multi-year system capability roadmap for external GCO systems.

  • Clinical & Technical Translation: Fluency in "clinical domain speak" related to GCO to accurately translate complex clinical workflows into structural, technical system and data requirements.

  • Stakeholder Orchestration & Influence: Navigating a matrixed environment to align with various clinical functions, internal IT groups, and external vendors around external systems standards.

  • Solution Lifecycle Oversight: Managing the end-to-end delivery of digital & technology systems & solutions—from initial scoping and vendor selection through deployment and value realization.

Key Competencies

  • Pharma Industry R&D Domain Literacy: Understanding of the pharmaceutical research and development value chain, mainly for the Clinical Operations function.

  • AI & Data Literacy: Comprehensive understanding of how AI solutions integrate within external systems and platforms, including knowledge of machine learning lifecycles, foundational models, and the requirements for "AI-ready data" to ensure effective clinical systems implementations and management.

  • Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate the business value proposition of external systems and platforms to clinical leadership, helping them understand the strategic roadmap and how the platform aligns with organizational goals and objectives

Key Deliverables

  • GCO function Data, Digital, & Technology Roadmap for external systems: Short-term and long-term strategic blueprint mapping technology solutions directly to clinical capability milestones.

  • Business Capability Maps: Visual matrices mapping out current-state vs. future-state technical capabilities across GCO, and relationships to other functions.

  • Product Requirements Documents (PRDs): Detailed, prioritized functional and technical requirement backlogs that can be used by the Systems Engineering team to integrate or enhance platforms.

  • Conceptual design & specification documents for existing GCO platforms & systems and its interactions with other systems.

  • Vendor Selection & Proof-of-Concept (PoC) Briefs: Formal evaluations, technical scores, and business cases for onboarding specialized vendor platforms or niche scientific AI tools.

  • Platform Operating Models: Governance structures co-authored with the Systems Engineering capability & GTS to ensure GCO platforms remain stable, highly available, and optimized during production runs.

  • Delivery & launch of AOP projects based on approved requirements, specifications, development activities & implementation plans.

Other Qualifications:

  • Strong process improvement skills and orientation.

  • Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user-friendly language.

  • Must have proven business and technology skills, with success providing customer-oriented technology solutions environment.

Travel:

  • < 15%

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology

raw.description:
Job Description Summary

The Technical Support Engineer 2 (TSE II) drives customer satisfaction through Service Excellence by providing advanced technical support, implementation leadership, project participation, and expert consultation for Digital Central Monitoring Unit (Digital CMU) solutions. This role partners with internal project teams and customer stakeholders to support implementations, upgrades, migrations, and other project activities, ensuring the successful deployment, adoption, and ongoing support of Digital CMU products and services.

As a senior technical resource, the TSE II provides guidance and support to remote and onsite Field Engineers (FEs), Client Service Technicians (CSTs), customer technical support personnel, clinical staff, peers, and customers experiencing system performance issues. The position serves as a primary escalation point for service-related issues involving Digital CMU software, hardware, networking, infrastructure, and integration components.

The TSE II participates in a shared 24x7x365 support model, delivering expert software, hardware, and network troubleshooting, incident management, and technical consultation. During ongoing customer support, the role collaborates closely with customer technical teams, clinical personnel, GE HealthCare resources, and Field Engineers to resolve complex issues, optimize system performance, support customer operations, and drive long-term customer success.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Technical Support & Incident Management

  • Provide advanced remote technical support for GE HealthCare software solutions and customer hardware environments, including coaching customers and field teams on contributing factors such as antivirus software, Cisco networking, Citrix, Microsoft technologies, and third-party infrastructure.
  • Lead customer escalation meetings, define logical engagement plans, and drive timely issue resolution using appropriate escalation processes.
  • Apply advanced diagnostic methods and remote support tools to reduce case resolution times and improve Time to Repair (TTR).
  • Serve as a recognized technical expert for complex customer issues involving software, hardware, networking, cloud, virtualization, and integration technologies.

Project Support & Implementations

  • Provide technical leadership and support for customer implementations, upgrades, migrations, system expansions, and related project activities.
  • Participate in project planning, technical reviews, testing, validation, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with project managers, implementation teams, field resources, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
  • Identify, communicate, and help mitigate technical risks that may impact project timelines, system performance, or customer outcomes.
  • Provide onsite support as needed during customer implementations, upgrades, migrations, and go-live activities throughout the United States and Canada.

Escalations, Quality & Productivity

  • Serve as the senior technical resource for service-related escalations and coordinate corrective action plans with customers, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Champion productivity initiatives and serve as a change agent for product serviceability, reliability, quality improvement, trend analysis, and new product introduction (NPI) activities.
  • Identify, lead, and implement process improvements, troubleshooting enhancements, and business process initiatives that improve service delivery and organizational effectiveness.
  • Analyze recurring issues and quality trends and work with engineering and product teams to develop corrective actions.

Knowledge Management & Tools

  • Develop, approve, and publish Knowledge Management (KM) content to expand technical solutions available to Field Engineers and Technical Support Engineers.
  • Contribute ideas and participate in continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance productivity tools, service readiness, and support effectiveness.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of GE HealthCare products, service processes, and diagnostic tools to maintain subject matter expertise and trusted advisor status.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & New Product Support

  • Partner with Service Engineering, Product Engineering, Development, Quality, and onsite engineering teams to improve product quality, serviceability, and escalation resolution.
  • Provide valuable input into new product development, service readiness activities, diagnostic tools, feature enhancements, and overall product quality.
  • Represent Technical Support during design reviews, service readiness activities, and product lifecycle initiatives as required.

Training & Mentorship

  • Coach and mentor TSE I team members, onsite engineers, and peers to ensure technical and customer-facing skills meet business needs.
  • Frequently serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for GE HealthCare software applications, technologies, and support processes.
  • Lead or co-lead project teams focused on serviceability improvements, reliability initiatives, quality trend analysis, productivity programs, and new product introduction support.

Documentation & Workflow

  • Maintain timely, accurate, and complete documentation that satisfies all process and quality requirements, including CRM case notes, troubleshooting records, technical findings, and customer communications.
  • Effectively manage case workflow and backlog to ensure customer-focused support and timely issue resolution.
  • Maintain compliance with all departmental service processes, documentation standards, and quality requirements.

Customer-Centric Support

  • Provide support within a 24x7x365 customer care environment to ensure customer satisfaction and timely issue resolution.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with customer technical teams, clinical staff, project stakeholders, and internal GE HealthCare partners.
  • Support customer success through proactive communication, technical consultation, and continuous service improvement.

Willingness To:

  • Submit to a background investigation, including verification of employment history, criminal history, and educational background.
  • Participate in required drug screening programs where applicable.
  • Be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship or employment restrictions.
  • Work overtime, on-call rotations, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Complete customer and vendor credentialing requirements, as necessary.

Required Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Five years of experience as a Technical Support Engineer I (TSE I); or
  • A minimum of five years of experience as a Field Engineer II and/or Field Engineer III, or equivalent external experience providing advanced technical support for comparable systems and technologies.
  • Demonstrated expertise supporting GE HealthCare software solutions, Cisco network environments, and associated customer hardware infrastructure.
  • Proven experience in incident management, customer escalation leadership, and technical engagement planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to function independently as a senior escalation resource and recognized subject matter expert.

Technical Skills

Advanced Proficiency With:

  • Remote diagnostic and troubleshooting tools, including CRM systems, Common Service Desktop, and other remote support platforms.
  • Technical problem analysis, root cause determination, and corrective action planning.

Strong Working Knowledge Of:

  • Networking concepts, protocols, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Cisco networking technologies.
  • AWS and cloud-based technologies.
  • Citrix environments and Microsoft operating systems, server technologies, and infrastructure.
  • Linux operating systems, virtualization platforms, Kubernetes, cloud technologies, and monitoring/alerting platforms.
  • HL7, interfaces, integration workflows, and legacy healthcare technology integrations where applicable.
  • Customer infrastructure including servers, storage, networking, cybersecurity, and remote access technologies.

Core Competencies

  • Expert troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve complex and ambiguous technical issues.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and facilitation skills with customers and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to confidently lead project discussions, escalation calls, and customer-facing technical engagements.
  • Leadership in change management, quality improvement, service transformation, and productivity initiatives.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a demonstrated history of reducing resolution cycle times and improving Time to Repair (TTR).
  • Ability to balance customer priorities, project responsibilities, and operational support requirements within a fast-paced environment.

Work Conditions

  • Remote support position requiring a professional home office environment suitable for customer-facing meetings, project discussions, troubleshooting activities, and technical support engagements.
  • Employee must maintain reliable high-speed internet connectivity and a distraction-free work environment.
  • Participation in an on-call rotation supporting 24x7x365 customer operations.
  • Fast-paced professional environment supporting mission-critical healthcare operations and customer care delivery.
  • Ability to work standard business hours (8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST) and participate in a shared rotation for after-hours, weekend, and holiday support coverage.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the United States and Canada, as needed, to support customer implementations, upgrades, migrations, system expansions, project activities, training, escalations, and customer go-live events. Travel is expected to average approximately 4-8 one-week trips per year, based on business needs, project schedules, and customer requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking, Healthcare Technology, or a related discipline preferred.

Certifications

  • Cisco (CCNA, CCNP)
  • Microsoft certifications
  • AWS certifications
  • Kubernetes or cloud platform certifications
  • Other vendor-specific technical certifications relevant to the role.

Additional Preferences

  • Experience supporting healthcare IT environments.
  • Experience working with cloud-hosted clinical applications and monitoring solutions.
  • Demonstrated success participating in customer implementations, upgrades, migrations, and enterprise-scale support operations.
  • Basic understanding of customer-managed Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions and mobile devices (Android and iOS), including their integration and use within hospital Clinical Communication and Collaboration (CC&C) ecosystems, such as Epic, Mobile Heartbeat, Vocera, Spectralink, and other clinical mobility and communication platforms.
  • Familiarity with Ascom software applications

raw.description:
Position Summary


The Underwriter II will evaluate new and renewal risks to ensure proper risk selection, pricing and terms for policies generated in assigned territory. This position will work within the established strategy and delegated authority to generate a profitable portfolio.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Risk evaluation. Evaluate submissions to determine acceptability of risks in accordance with company guidelines and standards. Determine proper coverage, pricing, limits and terms based on exposure.
  • Guideline adherence. Understand and follow the applicable underwriting guidelines, policies, and procedures to maintain consistency and adherence to industry regulations. Operate within assigned letter of underwriting authority.
  • External communication. Interact with customers, agents, and brokers to gather necessary information and to clarify underwriting requirements. Negotiate policy terms. Participate in stewardship meetings.
  • Data analysis. Utilize analytical tools to evaluate exposure and understand the driver of claims.
  • Collaboration. Drive a multi-disciplinary approach to understanding insureds’ risks. Collaborate with other underwriters and team members to gain a comprehensive understanding of the exposure and best means to provide coverage.
  • Documentation. Maintain accurate and detailed records of underwriting decisions and communication with both internal and external parties. Responsible for documenting the underwriting process and decisions of assigned policies.
  • Portfolio Management. Manage profitability, risk characteristics, submission flow, agent/broker relationships and customer service of assigned territory. Exhibit knowledge of insurance and health care industries and other companies underwriting similar coverage.
  • Marketing. Assist in marketing activities.
  • Project work. May participate on or lead projects.

Education, Experience, Competencies & Values

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university preferred; or four to seven years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Willingness to complete requirements of the CPCU or RPLU designation is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, governmental regulations, underwriting guidelines and manuals, bylaws, financials, articles of organization, loss runs, Joint Commission reports and other industry reports.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of programs.
  • Comfortable and effective in presenting information and responding to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 20% of the year.

The base salary range for this role is $81,665 - $110,480. Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors that are unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications and education.

Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET (Canada-only)

Digital Banking & Credit Union Transformation

Company: Aequilibrium Software Inc.
Location: Canada (Remote)
Employment type: Full-time or contract, depending on client engagement
Seniority: Senior
Industry: Financial Services / Credit Unions

About Aequilibrium

Aequilibrium is a Canadian digital transformation and software engineering company specializing in digital banking, financial services, customer experience, and emerging technologies. We partner with Canadian and US credit unions to modernize digital banking platforms, integrate enterprise systems, and deliver reliable, intuitive member experiences. We are expanding our QA engineering capability to support multiple Canadian credit union clients undergoing digital banking modernization, platform migrations, and integration initiatives.

The Opportunity

We are looking for experienced Senior QA Automation Engineers / Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) who combine strong technical testing expertise with practical knowledge of banking and credit union operations. You will work with developers, business analysts, solution architects, product owners, and client teams to ensure complex digital banking applications are secure, reliable, accessible, and production-ready.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are particularly interested in candidates who can design and maintain automated testing frameworks, validate end-to-end banking workflows, and test integrations between digital banking platforms and core banking systems.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, and integration tests for web and mobile banking applications.

  • Build reusable test automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Develop test strategies, test plans, scenarios, and traceability aligned with business requirements.

  • Execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.

  • Investigate defects, analyze logs, identify root causes, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.

  • Improve test coverage, automation reliability, and quality reporting.

Digital Banking & Credit Union Testing

  • Validate member-facing journeys, including login, MFA, account balances, transfers, bill payments, Interac e-Transfer, mobile cheque deposit and account servicing.

  • Test commercial banking capabilities such as delegated access, entitlements, approvals and business payments.

  • Validate integrations between digital banking platforms, core banking systems, payment services, lending applications and CRM systems.

  • Support data migration testing, reconciliation and regression testing during platform replacements.

  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and production validation.

  • Collaborate with client business teams to ensure test scenarios reflect real banking operations and member needs.

Engineering & Delivery

  • Work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, refinement and acceptance criteria.

  • Integrate quality engineering practices into development workflows.

  • Support performance, security, and accessibility testing in collaboration with specialists.

  • Provide clear quality metrics, defect reporting, and release-readiness assessments.

  • Help establish automated quality gates for AI-assisted software development.

Required Qualifications
