raw.description:
We are now looking for a Senior Research Engineer passionate about Generative AI inference. Are you excited to change the way people infuse AI into products and services? NVIDIA is at the forefront of generative AI models, from language to images. NVIDIA provides building blocks to democratize AI and make generative AI easy to develop, integrate, and deploy. Our team is dedicated to developing optimized inferencing technologies to support our growing generative AI needs. We contribute to all steps of the machine learning lifecycle: from conceptualization, to applied research, engineering for optimized inference, and deployment. Collaborate with research teams, engineers, and open-source community.

What you will be doing:

  • Design and evaluate routing policies for LLM traffic to best use mixture of model systems.

  • Build and run agentic benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench ) to measure algorithm quality, and turn results into calibration data and routing profiles

  • Ship to an open-source repo: design docs, code review, docs, and community contributions

  • Collaborating with engineering teams across all of NVIDIA to ensure our software integrates seamlessly up and down the NVIDIA accelerated serving stack.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's of Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of industry experience in Deep Learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow).

  • Experience designing or running LLM evaluations/benchmarks — ideally agentic ones — and drawing statistically sound conclusions from them

  • Understanding of modern techniques in Machine Learning, Deep Neural Networks, Natural Language Processing, or Speech Recognition.

  • Empirical research mindset: forming hypotheses about new algorithms, running calibrations, iterating on results

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, along with the ability to work in a dynamic and distributed team. A history of mentoring junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.

  • A desire to constantly grow and learn new things.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals - algorithms and data structures, computational complexity, parallel and distributed computing, system software.

Ways to stand out from a crowd:

  • Experience architecting or developing large-scale distributed systems for deep learning.

  • Agentic benchmark creation and publications.

  • Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture.

  • GPU programming (CUDA).

raw.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Marshallese-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Marshallese Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $20 - $23 per hour​​​

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Marshallese Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Marshallese and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inMarshallese and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Thirty (30) days from the posting date of October 16, 2026.

We're looking for someone who understands wholesale fuel markets, thrives in a highly autonomous environment, and has a track record of building profitable customer relationships. In this role, you'll manage your own territory, develop new business opportunities, and help customers navigate their fuel supply needs through both delivered and FOB rack solutions.

If you're energized by creating opportunities, closing deals, and becoming a trusted partner to customers, we'd like to hear from you.


What You'll Do

Drive Territory Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to grow fuel volumes, revenue, and profitability throughout the territory.
  • Identify, pursue, and secure new wholesale fuel customers.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and industry relationships.
  • Expand World Fuel's presence within the assigned market.

Manage and Grow Customer Accounts

  • Develop trusted relationships with fuel distributors, marketers, retailers, jobbers, resellers, and commercial fuel consumers.
  • Manage an existing portfolio of accounts while identifying opportunities for additional growth.
  • Understand customer supply requirements and deliver competitive fuel solutions.
  • Retain and expand business by consistently delivering value and exceptional service.

Deliver Commercial Solutions

  • Sell both delivered transport fuel and FOB rack fuel supply programs.
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and commercial agreements.
  • Partner with supply, operations, and customer service teams to ensure successful execution.
  • Provide customers with market insights and supply strategies that support their business objectives.

Be a Trusted Market Expert

  • Monitor fuel market trends, pricing, terminal activity, transportation costs, and competitive dynamics.
  • Maintain a strong market presence through customer visits, industry events, and professional networking.
  • Provide market intelligence and sales forecasts to leadership.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience in wholesale fuel sales, fuel distribution, commercial fuels, energy sales, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success developing new business and growing customer accounts.
  • Experience managing a territory and achieving revenue, volume, and profitability goals.
  • Strong understanding of wholesale fuel pricing, supply, terminals, economics, and market dynamics.
  • Proven ability to negotiate commercial agreements and build long-term customer relationships.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the territory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Established relationships within the wholesale fuel, fuel distribution, transportation fuel, or fuel marketing industries.
  • Experience selling delivered transport fuel and/or FOB rack supply.
  • Existing relationships with distributors, jobbers, retailers, resellers, and commercial fuel customers.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or a related field.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $75,000 annually
  • Incentive Compensation: Uncapped commission plan based on fuel volume and gross profit performance.

For Colorado applicants, the expected pay for this position is $75,000 annually plus uncapped commission opportunities.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision start day one with 3 different plan options
  • 160 hours of PTO accrual per year starting
  • 401k match starts 30 days after you begin
  • Basic Life, AD&D, and more

Please note applications should be submitted no later than November 30th, 2026


The Ideal Candidate

You understand the wholesale fuels business and know how to create value for customers. You're comfortable discussing supply strategy, pricing, market conditions, and fuel logistics with decision-makers. You enjoy opening new doors, building trusted relationships, and turning opportunities into long-term partnerships.

Most importantly, you're motivated by growth, accountability, and delivering results.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.World Fuel Services, Inc.

Position Overview

As a member of the BG ICS Leadership Team, reporting to the BG ICS General Manager, the Director of Strategy is the General Manager's right hand, shaping the long-term direction while simultaneously providing governance and operating discipline in the now.

Amongst the most critical functions of the role are guiding where we invest (or divest), and driving the operating rhythm that keeps leadership aligned across Nijmegen, Dallas and our global sites.

The position further holds decision rights on segment priorities, co-own roadmap priorities with Product Management and R&D leaders, and represents BG ICS in the company strategy and the annual planning & LTP processes with Corporate Strategy and Corporate Development.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Market Development

  • Consolidate the global, BG ICS demand picture aligned with sales (GSM), business group ambition and central marketing strategy teams; lead BG ICS input to the annual strategy cycle, LTP and Deep Dive.
  • Decide priority market segments and applications (e.g., automotive, industrial, consumer, mobile, computing); set segment strategies with revenue, share and design-win targets.
  • Direct market research and market intelligence to size markets, track share and identify opportunities and trends.
  • Analyze competitor portfolios and strategic directions; provide market input to M&A, partnership and investment opportunities with Corporate Strategy office.
  • Track competitors such as Texas Instruments, On Semi, Analog Devices, and MPS; briefing leadership on pricing, capacity and technology moves.
  • Own the BG ICS T&E budget, including market reports and intelligence sources (e.g., S&P Global / IHS Markit), events and demand-creation programs

Portfolio & Roadmap

  • Co-own BG ICS roadmap priorities with Product Management, R&D and Technology teams; hold decision rights on market requirements and segment fit for new products.
  • Define market-level segment value propositions and positioning for new and existing product families.
  • Approve go-to-market plans for new product introductions, including launch messaging and sales enablement

Customers & Demand Creation

  • Meet key customers to discuss strategic directions and future requirements; continuously searching for mega trends and market openings.
  • Along with the General Manager, be the spokesperson at a BG level, at corporate events, townhalls, webinars and external events and conferences.
  • Pipeline management – process and tool (Sales Bridge today) to develop sales opportunities from promotion to design-in / win.
  • Build the BG ICS application online presence (application notes, reference designs, web content).
  • Coordinate the BG ICS application and product demos for Nexperia’s exhibitions, e.g. Embedded World, Electronica and PCIM.
  • Represent Nexperia to media and analysts, e.g. in press interviews and industry events.

Leadership & Organization

  • Member of the BG ICS Leadership Team; contribute to BG business decisions, targets and resource allocation.
  • Establish (consolidating across all BG ICS LT members), monitor, track, and report out on annual and quarterly KPI and OKR results
  • Serve as the one connection point for all matters coming form the company[1]
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product Management, R&D, Quality and central Marketing; act as BG ICS representative toward the EMT and corporate functions as called upon.
  • Coordinate BG ICS Sales & Marketing trainings for regional sales and FAE teams

Skills Needed

  • Master degree of Electrical Engineering or Physics; business qualification (e.g., MBA) is a plus.
  • 15+ years in Semiconductor Sales & Marketing, including senior strategic marketing leadership.
  • Deep knowledge of Power, Signal and Analog ICs and their associated applications and markets
  • Proven record growing revenue and market share in IC segments through segment strategy, pricing and go-to-market.
  • Experience owning marketing budgets and contributing to BG-level P&L, LTP and investment decisions.
  • Strong command of pipeline and design-in management processes and tools.
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills (Excel, Power BI or similar).
  • Experience working across cultures in European, US and Asian settings; Dutch, Indian, or Mandarin speaking ability is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills with senior executives and boards.
  • Senior leadership: leading leaders and building high-performing global teams.
  • Strategic thinking and decision-making under uncertainty.
  • Influence across BGs, regions and the EMT; executive presence with C-level customers, media and analysts.
  • Fluent English in spoken and written; intercultural awareness.
  • Self-driven and demonstrating the Nexperia´s values: Passion, Professionalism, Perseverance and Performance

raw.description:
Director, Digital Engagement

College Board - Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

College Board's Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance user experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement (AP) examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. ADO’s User Readiness team ensures every district-level member, school-level educator, and test taker has what they need, and takes the critical actions required, to succeed on test day. This is done through multi-channel community engagement, effective digital communications, curated technical guidance, and risk-based outreach.

About the Opportunity

As the Director of Digital Engagement, you will own the full lifecycle of seasonal User Readiness campaigns and communications that reach thousands of coordinators, staff, and students across every College Board program. You’ll design and execute the strategy for how we communicate to our users, i.e., who needs to hear what, and when, then run the experiments and dig into user behavior to figure out what actually drives people to act and scale what works.

Not every educator or student needs to hear the same thing, the same way. You will help define the segments and personas that capture those differences and own the communication strategy built on top of them, translating a deep understanding of program policy, and the latest system and technology content, into messaging that surfaces what each user most needs to know and is delivered in the way that’s most likely to reach them. You will partner across College Board functional teams to get that translation right and connect every campaign directly to the User Readiness outcomes we’re driving toward for test day.

In this role, you will:

Seasonal Campaign Strategy & Lifecycle (30%)

  • Own the full lifecycle of seasonal User Readiness campaigns, from planning through execution and post-season retrospective
  • Set the cadence and sequencing of communications against program milestones, deciding who needs to hear what, and when
  • Build and maintain the campaign calendar that keeps every message landing at the right moment in a user’s readiness journey

Segmentation & Messaging Craft (25%)

  • Design and maintain audience segmentation based on coordinator type, program, and readiness stage, and refine segments over time with analytics partners
  • Translate program policy and the latest system and technology updates into messaging that surfaces what each user most needs to know
  • Own message quality end to end, from clarity and tone to the specific call to action and resources each segment needs
  • Write, build, test, and deploy email campaigns and automated journeys in Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Pilot AI tools to speed up drafting, personalization, and quality checks of content

Experimentation, Insights, and Partnership Outcomes (45%)

  • Design and run experiments and dig into user behavior to find what drives engagement and action. Examples include testing subject lines, timing, content, and channel
  • Define and track engagement metrics, from opens and clicks to completion of target actions, and report results and recommendations to stakeholders
  • Connect every campaign directly to the User Readiness outcomes we’re driving toward on test day, using engagement as a signal, not the goal itself
  • Partner across College Board functional teams to align messaging and ensure campaigns reflect the latest program, policy, and technology updates
  • Share audience insights with partner teams in community engagement, technical readiness, and proactive outreach to improve their work and reduce the need for intervention
  • Build relationships across teams that let you move quickly when a message needs to be revised or a new campaign needs to launch

About You

  • Expertise in lifecycle, CRM, or digital communications, with 5-7 years of experience planning and delivering multi-channel campaigns to large, segmented audiences
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying campaigns in an email marketing platform, with Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience preferred
  • Experience designing audience segmentation and personalization, using data to decide who receives which message and when
  • A track record of running experiments, analyzing engagement data, and turning results into measurable improvements
  • Strong writing and editing skills, including turning complex operational, policy, or technical information into clear, actionable messages
  • Experience with SMS and in-app messaging, including best practices for deliverability and message compliance
  • Experience managing a high volume of requests across many stakeholders, with familiarity with Jira or similar work-tracking tools
  • Preferred: Experience communicating with educators or school-based audiences
  • A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, a performance exercise relevant to the role, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$130,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.


The mission of Stride is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!


The Family and Consumer Sciences Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering specific course content in an online environment. FACS Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. FACS Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. FACS Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.


THIS IS A PART-TIME POSITION THAT WILL LIKELY PAY $20-$25/HOUR

This is a part-time hourly position up to 25 hours per week. Ability to work independently is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday is imperative. Instructional hours fall between 9-5 EST (or 8-4) based on the needs of the schools we serve. Assigned hours may range based on various factors (school need, content area, teacher availability, etc.).


Additionally, the number of assigned hours may be impacted by various factors such as school need, certifications, teacher availability, etc.

As part of our program, we work with a variety of schools to support their needs and their students by offering live class sessions based on the daily school schedule.  This means that availability and flexibility are important within our program to properly support the schools we serve, and students' needs as they arise. 

Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint.
  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to modern technologies and teaching platforms.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with online learning platforms.

At Lanteris Space, our next generation spacecraft range from Earth observation to interplanetary missions, including the SR-1 Freedom Power and Propulsion Element (PPE).

We are looking for an experienced Power Subsystems Engineer to join our growing Space Program Delivery team in San Jose CA. This position may also be performed remotely within the U.S. This position provides an opportunity to develop new Power architectures for various mission types, including low earth orbit constellation designs. An ideal candidate would have knowledge of existing space power hardware and background design platforms to accommodate this hardware.

As a Power Subsystems Engineer, you will act as the engineering focal point for the entire power subsystem of a spacecraft being designed. Collaborating closely with a cohort of system and subsystem leads, you will develop power subsystem requirements and specifications through analysis and system trade studies, which translate customer requests into feasible design solutions. You will assist in flowing down power requirements into unit specifications, subsystem verification tests, and risk reduction plans. This will include make/buy decisions and vendor selection if new unit design is required. If a unit is purchased, you will coordination with vendors while tracking unit deliveries to Lanteris Space.

Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate and optimize power system selection and design
  • Create power budgets & provide inputs for power subsystem sizing
  • Collaborate with Database, Harness Thermal, Flight Software, and other subsystem engineers
  • Resolve issues during AIT (Assembly, Integration & Test) test phases

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
  • BS degree in an engineering or STEM discipline. In lieu of a degree, 4 additional years of experience may be substituted. A master's degree may count for two years of experience
  • 5 years of engineering experience, preferably in power subsystems or electrical engineering
  • Experience performing all/most aspects of the system engineering (requirements analysis, interface control documentation, concept of operations development, Use Case development, Operational details, and developing Test Plans.)
  • Familiarity with a Requirements Tool.

Preferred Skills:

  • 10 years of power subsystem experience
  • Familiarity with satellite Power System design and test obtained through educational training and/or on-the-job experience in a related field
  • Experience leading electrical engineering designs through the full lifecycle
  • Experience in Model Based Systems Engineering.
  • Experience with software and system development projects using model bases system engineering.
  • Knowledgeable in most of the following areas: power system design, solar arrays, batteries, bus regulation and distribution, power quality and DC/DC conversion.
  • Familiar with deployment and maintenance of Development, Test and Operational environments.

raw.description:
About PushPress
PushPress is the AI-powered gym management platform built for boutique fitness.
We are transforming how boutique fitness owners operate and how the entire $100B global fitness industry connects, transacts, and grows. Trusted by more than 5,000 gyms and 500,000 members, PushPress processes ~$1B annually.
We're a Series B company backed by Altos Ventures, StepStone, and Mucker Capital, and we're going all-in on AI. Our AI Assistant, AI Member Intel, and AI-powered reporting tools are already changing how gym owners and coaches operate. We believe AI should make the human side of fitness better, not replace it.
By embedding intelligence directly into the product, we enable boutique fitness owners to make faster decisions, unlock new revenue streams, and collaborate across a connected network. As more gyms join the platform, data compounds, intelligence strengthens, and the value of the ecosystem increases for every owner.
We are a global team of builders, operators, and fitness fanatics on a mission to level the playing field for independent fitness entrepreneurs. If you are ready to help reshape an industry, let's talk!

The Role

PushPress is building a suite of data-driven products and customer experiences that powers reporting and AI features for 5,000+ gyms and our internal teams. We're hiring our first Data Platform Engineer to own the foundation that all of it runs on: how data gets in, where it lives, how it's governed, how it's extracted (while monitoring who uses it and why), and whether people and AI agents can trust it. Our direction: anyone at PushPress, and the AI agents they work with, should get answers they can rely on without waiting on the Data team. You'll design the platform that makes that possible and support the teams who build on it. You'll collaborate closely with our Data team (Data Engineering and Analytics) and the broader R&D team, and you'll have a real say in how we turn our data into tools, including AI, that help gyms run better businesses.

What You'll Own

    Fast, trustworthy data for 5,000+ gyms

  • Make the reporting gym owners see in PushPress fresh, fast and right, so they can act on their business in the moment
    Make sure every number we run the company on, up to what the Board sees, traces back to where it came from
  • Set the bar for freshness and uptime, take part in incident response, and fix root causes so problems don't come back

    • A full view of the customer journey

  • Bring product, payment and third-party data together so we can see how gyms and their members use PushPress, from first inquiry to daily check-in
  • Partner with Engineering so new features and integrations produce clean, well-structured data from day one, with breaking changes caught before they ship
  • Simplify how data moves: fewer paths and tools, each with a clear owner, and costs that stay visible and in check

    • Privacy and security by design

  • Protect the gym and member data entrusted to us: who can see what, a record of every access by a person or an AI agent, and safeguards no AI system can change
  • Make honoring a privacy request routine, without breaking financial reporting or audit

    • The foundation for AI at PushPress

  • Give our AI Assistant, AI Member Intel, and AI reporting the context they need to give gym owners useful, personal answers
  • Make business definitions readable by people and AI, so a metric means the same thing in a dashboard, a chat or a Board deck
  • Help every team at PushPress answer its own questions through AI, safely and with clear limits on cost and access

What We're Looking For

    You've done this hands-on

  • 5+ years in data engineering, data platform, data infrastructure, or software engineering roles, with production infrastructure you owned end to end (ideally at a B2B SaaS or payments company)
  • A cloud warehouse experience at scale: performance tuning, cost management, access controls (RBAC, masking) and schema design
  • Strong Python and SQL, with solid software engineering habits (testing, CI/CD, code review, infrastructure as code such as Terraform)
  • Hands-on experience initiating, maintaining, and running an orchestrator like Airflow or Dagster in production, not just writing DAGs
  • Managed ingestion tools (Hevo, Fivetran) and custom pipelines when they fall short, including at least one of CDC, streaming or event-driven
  • Data quality checks and alerting you built (Monte Carlo, Elementary, or your own), with a runbook someone else can follow
  • Using AI daily, including at least one workflow others rely on and a check that catches it when it's wrong

    • You've worked with

  • A real-time analytics database such as ClickHouse, and a view on when to use it instead of a warehouse
  • Privacy and governance requirements under GDPR, CCPA or PCI (access, auditing, retention and deletion)
    TypeScript codebases, alongside the product engineers who produce our data

    • You're curious about

  • Data for AI: semantic layers, retrieval, evals and giving agents governed access to data
  • Data contracts with the teams that produce data
  • Event platforms or CDPs (Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow, PostHog) and identity resolution across product, billing and CRM data

    • How you work

  • You're curious about the gyms and members behind the data
  • You tackle messy data head on, and you find out what changed upstream
  • You explain tradeoffs in plain terms, and can say "not yet, and here's why"
  • You improve as you go: docs, runbooks and alerts are standard practice

Benefits & Perks

  • Equity Incentive Plan
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (and Public Holidays)
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (Company Sponsored 401k with Match)
  • Life Insurance
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Work From Home Stipend
  • Wellness Stipend
PushPress is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and dynamic workplace. We’re all about leveling up, and that means we don’t tolerate any form of discrimination or harassment. We’re committed to providing equal opportunities, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability, genetic info, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
At PushPress, we’re dedicated to helping both our technology and our team reach peak performance. Whether it’s with your proactive approach, eye for detail, or drive to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. At PushPress, we’re all about pushing boundaries and achieving new personal bests—come join us and be part of our fitness-tech journey!

The Collections Analyst II manages an accounts receivable portfolio of Commercial & Industrial natural gas and electricity supply customers. This role works to resolve delinquent customer balances and collaborates with internal and external partners to verify compliance with company policies while reducing bad debt and protecting the company from negative financial exposure. The position supports both pre- and post-payment collections activity across a wide range of businesses, markets, and billing arrangements, and the analyst is expected to recommend appropriate actions based on company policies.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manages an assigned portfolio of C&I accounts, proactively contacting customers by phone and email to secure payment of outstanding balances.
  • Reviews aging receivables to identify delinquency trends, account-specific issues, and potential bad debt, and recommends appropriate disposition of balances.
  • Positively collaborates with internal stakeholders to research and resolve complex billing and payment disputes, payment discrepancies, etc. to resolve customer delinquencies.
  • Negotiates/establishes payment or payment arrangements within the policy framework and escalates exceptions to the Collections Lead and Senior Manager.
  • Actively documents customer contacts, payment commitments, and account actions accurately in CRM and billing systems.
  • Fully verifies credit and collections policy compliance and completes related tasks as requested by internal staff, team and organization leadership, etc.
  • Engages actively to become a collections subject matter expert to engage in addressing process, policy, or compliance questions from any internal teams.
  • Escalates credit decisions, collection agency referrals, bankruptcies, and legal matters as required to the Lead and Senior Manager with supporting analysis and recommended actions.
  • Monitors customer payment behavior and energy market developments that affect C&I risk and reports emerging concerns to the Lead.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned.

Required Skills:

  • Maintains a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail with a bias to urgency in all activities.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally with customers and internal partners
  • Navigates difficult payment conversations with tact, persistence, and professionalism.
  • Consistently manages and prioritizes multiple accounts and deadlines independently in a remote or hybrid setting.

title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
description: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

  • Incident Response & Triage:Lead incident response efforts by investigating security alerts, conducting root cause analysis, and executing remediation plans in alignment with security incident handling frameworks.

  • Operational Enablement:Partner with the global operations team to ensure they have the necessary operational tools, documentation, and actionable information required to provide rapid first-response to network and security incidents.

  • Network & Cloud Security Architecture:Proven expertise in secure cloud-native and hybrid network architectures across major CSPs (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), ensuring seamless connectivity and stringent security posture.

  • Secure Network Infrastructure:Proficiency in securely deploying and managing Fortigate (FortiManager), Arista, Cisco, and Cumulus OS devices.

  • Automation & AI-Assisted Development:Proven ability to leverage Python, Shell scripting, and AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to build efficient automation, frameworks, and operational dashboards.

  • Large-Scale Experience:Demonstrated success in designing and securing hyper-scale network environments.

  • Innovation Outlook:Passion for driving progress through the adoption of groundbreaking technologies.

NVIDIA is looking for great people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

raw.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
raw.excerpt: Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
raw.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

About this Role

The Senior Revenue Accountant plays a critical role in strengthening global revenue assurance across a diversified product portfolio, including SaaS subscription and usage-based models, professional services, and perpetual license offerings. This role helps ensure revenue processes are accurate, compliant, scalable, and aligned to the company’s growth objectives.

This position supports the review and approval of complex revenue arrangements, including multi-element contracts and non-standard commercial terms, to ensure full compliance with ASC 606. As a trusted business partner, the Senior Revenue Accountant works closely with Sales, Professional Services, Legal, Deal Desk, and other cross-functional teams to provide practical guidance on deal structure and the financial implications of customer contracts.

Operating in a global environment, this role partners with teams across regions to drive operational consistency, improve processes, and support predictable, profitable growth.

Main Responsibilities

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on revenue recognition and advise stakeholders on the application of ASC 606 across complex customer arrangements, contract modifications, and non-standard deal structures.
  • Review and analyze complex customer contracts to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment and document technical accounting conclusions.
  • Own key aspects of the monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue close process, including reconciliations, revenue analytics, forecasting support, reserve calculations, flux analysis, and management reporting.
  • Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, FP&A, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure accurate contract setup, revenue forecasting, and financial reporting.
  • Identify revenue recognition risks, operational inefficiencies, and control gaps, and drive process improvements to enhance scalability and compliance.
  • Prepare and review revenue-related schedules and disclosures supporting internal and external financial reporting requirements.
  • Lead revenue accounting initiatives, including system implementations, process automation, ERP enhancements, and integration projects.
  • Collaborate with business and technology partners to define system requirements, evaluate impacts to accounting processes, and ensure alignment with company accounting policies.
  • Execute and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), validation activities, and change management efforts for new system implementations and enhancements.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing technical accounting support, maintaining SOX controls, and ensuring compliance with corporate policies and US GAAP.
  • Mentor junior team members and provide guidance on revenue accounting processes, controls, and best practices.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 3-5 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2-4 years focused on revenue accounting within a SaaS, software, subscription-based, or technology company.
  • Strong understanding and practical application of ASC 606 revenue recognition guidance, including experience evaluating complex contractual arrangements and multi-element transactions.
  • Public accounting experience and/or experience at a publicly traded company strongly preferred.
  • CPA certification or progress toward CPA preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business.
  • Demonstrated experience owning components of the monthly and quarterly close process with minimal supervision.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, data analysis, and reconciliation techniques.
  • Strong experience with NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment is required.
  • Experience with RevPro, Salesforce CRM, Power BI, or similar financial systems and reporting tools preferred.
  • Experience supporting ERP, revenue system implementations, integrations, or process automation initiatives.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively across functions and influence stakeholders on accounting and process-related decisions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

We focus on our mission: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

  • Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

  • Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

  • Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

We invest in our people: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

EEO - Our philosophy: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful. 

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

JOB REQ COMPENSATION RANGE

$83,000 - $138,000

The base salary range for this role is shown above. At Sprinklr, base pay depends on multiple individualized factors, including experience, qualifications, job-related knowledge and skills, and geographic location. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package: the successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in Sprinklr’s discretionary bonus plan, commission plan, and/or equity plan, depending on role.

US-based Sprinklr employees are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well-being, and financial protection. The US-based benefits include a 401k plan with 100% vested company contributions, flexible paid time off, holidays, generous caregiver and parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

Warning about Recruiting Scams: Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

Ready to be a Titan?

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Billing Analyst to help manage and optimize our end-to-end billing operations. As our Senior Billing Analyst, you will assist with the billing, payments, and contract management function for various ServiceTitan and affiliate products. In this high-impact position, you will partner cross-functionally across departments (Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations, Onboarding, Support, Success, AR/Collections) to manage client accounts, set up billing, track contract data, and address customer billing issues.

What You’ll Do

  • Billing Operations & Contract Management:
    • Participate in both recurring automated customer billing and complex manual invoicing for new products and more complex enterprise customers, ensuring accurate pricing, usage calculations, and delivery schedules.
    • Partner cross-functionally with Deal Desk, Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations, Onboarding, Support, Success, AR/Collections to manage client accounts, set up billing, track contract data, and address customer billing issues.
    • Review contract terms to ensure accuracy in billing and Salesforce data before signing.
    • Work alongside Collections specialists to resolve billing disputes, issue approved credit/debit memos, and accelerate cash collection on past-due accounts.
    • Act as an escalation point for customer billing issues, conducting root-cause analysis to address recurring discrepancies.
    • Support internal teams on escalations and reconciliations to resolve any billing issues.
  • Month-End Close & Revenue Accounting:
    • Assist with month-end close responsibilities related to billing and partner with Revenue Accounting to ensure revenue is appropriately recognized following US GAAP.
    • Support internal and external financial audits by maintaining clear documentation and audit trails.
  • Systems & Migration Partnership:
    • Identify gaps and operational bottlenecks in current billing workflows; lead initiatives to automate manual tasks and scale billing infrastructure.
    • Participate in billing software testing (UAT), Billing system implementation projects, and system rule updates.
    • Lead efforts to streamline billing processes across various entities.
  • Reporting & Ad-Hoc Analysis:
    • Assist with various billing-related reporting, including ad hoc requests.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 4-6+ years of billing, accounts receivable, or billing-operations experience (preferably in a B2B SaaS, tech, or high-volume environment).
  • Knowledge: Deep understanding of contact management, order-to-cash processes, sales tax and basic revenue recognition (ASC 606) and accounts receivable principles.
  • Systems & Software: Proficiency with Microsoft Excel; experience with Salesforce is a plus.
  • Execution & Multi-Tasking: Strong ability to meet deadlines and multi-task within a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and oral communication skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with all levels of employees, management, and external agencies to maximize performance, creativity, problem solving, and results.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role isZone 1: $76,900 USD - $115,300 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WAZone 2: $71,800 USD - $107,800 USD Applicable for: All other US locations.International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

raw.description:
Job Title:

Solution Consultant

About Trellix 
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at .

Role Overview:

Trellix Professional Services Solution Consultant

Work Location:

Remote Poland

Role Overview:

Join an industry leading team performing challenging and meaningful work. Trellix is supporting customers in the planning, deployment, migration, operation, and sustainment of key endpoint security systems comprised of Trellix and third-party technologies.

The Solution Consultant will report to the Senior Manager of the Professional Services Delivery team. The Solution Consultant will be an professional services consultant who will be focused on daily deployments, operations and maintenance of Trellix solutions in the customer environment. This consultant also serves as a cybersecurity Subject-Matter Expert and advises the customer of cybersecurity matters. The consultant also communicates, coordinates, and facilitates problem resolution and other customer issues with Trellix Customer Success Managers, Technical Support Engineers, and Professional Services management.

The solution consultant will work with the customer and diverse stakeholders throughout the customer organization to create technical project plans, schedules, test plans, deployment plans, and migration plans to evolve the customer’s systems to the next generation capabilities.

Candidates should have experience in large-scale operational environments focusing on cyber defense along with experience performing incident analysis, developing defensive capabilities, and designing and implementing security solutions.

About the role:

  • You will be responsible for overall customer experience and successful delivery of services.

  • You will build and maintain strong customer relationships.

  • You will work with a group of customer organizations to deploy, integrate, and operationalize Trellix’s solution capabilities across a broad enterprise.

  • You will write technical documentation and briefings.

  • You will lead and/or participate in technical exchange meetings.

  • You will develop engineering artifacts such as system design diagrams, data flow diagrams, test plans, test reports, etc.

  • You will lead or participate in development testing, debugging, pre-deployment testing, and post-deployment testing.

  • You will lead or participate in deployment planning and execution.

  • You will analyze technical/integration requirements and develop technical solutions for Customer review and consideration, and once approved, integrate into the customer's infrastructure.

  • You will lead or participate in system configuration, tuning, and policy development.

  • You will lead or participate in the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and playbooks.

  • You will monitor and manage system health, status, availability, and functionality.

  • You will report on technical problems, operational problems, and end user/customer feedback.

  • You will analyze data and provide recommendations for solutions to operational and/or technical problems.

  • You will lead or participate in technical troubleshooting efforts and problem resolution, including assessment, hands-on tasks, log reviews, performing triage tools, reviewing product documentation, and communicating with product support and development teams.

About you:

  • You are self-motivated and passionate about cybersecurity and information technology.

  • You have experience with enterprise network technology planning, deployment, user migration and operations.

  • You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • You have demonstrated technical proficiency in cybersecurity operations, cybersecurity engineering, systems engineering and/or Windows and Linux systems administration.

  • You have hands-on experience with at least two or more security technologies, such as EDR, XDR, network detection and response (NDR).

  • You have the aptitude and ability to develop expertise with Trellix products.

  • You have experience with Active Directory, Virtualization, Cloud Services [i.e., AWS, Azure]) and enterprise networks.

  • You have experience with Threat Hunting / Incident Response background.

  • Your background includes 5+ years in a technical capacity (i.e. technical consulting role within the cybersecurity or IT security field, ideally at a security vendor, systems integrator, or value-added distributor).

  • You hold a B.S. or higher in a related technical field (i.e., computer science, Information technology, or engineering).

  • You have familiarity with cyber threat identification, management, mitigation, and response strategies.

  • You are based in Poland, and willingness to travel across the DACH region (Germany, Austria and Switzerland) and the Eastern European region is required to support the broader business.

  • You are fluent in Polish, German and English.

Product & Group Configuration Quality Specialist II will support accurate customer benefit delivery by performing foundational audits of product configuration and group setup across medical, dental, and pharmacy. The role will review configuration outputs against source documentation and established standards to identify discrepancies and ensure corrections are completed prior to downstream processing impacts. Root-cause thinking — moving beyond individual errors to understand why issues occur and how to prevent them.

Influential communication — delivering feedback that builds trust, encourages learning, and leads to action.

Systems thinking — understanding how configuration decisions affect customers and downstream business processes.

Professional adaptability — building confidence with increasingly complex work, evolving standards, and changing priorities.

Creation Technologies is a leading global electronics manufacturing services (EMS) provider. Our 14 business units span across four countries and many customers. We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior EDI Architect to join our team.

In this role, you will be the primary technical authority for our Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) strategy and infrastructure. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing robust data exchange solutions that connect Creation Technologies with our global customer and vendor base. This role requires a deep technical mastery of EDI platforms, specifically Oracle and Cleo, alongside a strong understanding of supply chain business processes. The successful candidate will lead the architectural vision for our B2B integrations, ensuring scalability, security, and seamless data flow across our enterprise ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain EDI communications & design, ensuring the architecture supports global scalability and high availability across all business units.
  • Lead the end-to-end design and deployment of complex EDI integrations using Oracle EDI modules, Oracle integration cloud (OIC) and Cleo Integration Cloud (CIC).
  • Manage and optimize communication protocols (AS2, SFTP, HTTPS, API) and oversee the onboarding of new trading partners (customers and suppliers).
  • Collaborate with IT developers and ERP specialists to integrate EDI workflows with ERPs like Oracle, ensuring data integrity across the transactions.
  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of complex EDI maps (X12, EDIFACT) and translation rules to meet diverse partner requirements.
  • Conduct thorough analysis of existing EDI processes to identify latencies or manual touchpoints, implementing automated solutions to improve operational efficiency.
  • Lead the development of comprehensive test plans and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for all new partner integrations or system upgrades.
  • Provide Tier 3 technical support for EDI failures and mentor junior analysts/developers on EDI best practices and standards.

Personal Characteristics

  • Exceptional ability to troubleshoot complex integration failures and design long-term architectural fixes rather than temporary patches.
  • Advanced ability to translate technical EDI concepts into business language for stakeholders and executives.
  • Proven track record of building trusting relationships with cross-functional teams, including Supply Chain, Finance, and IT.
  • Ability to work with a high degree of accuracy, specifically regarding data mapping and compliance with global messaging standards.
  • Self-motivated individual who thrives on autonomy and takes ownership of the entire B2B integration lifecycle.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced EMS environment with shifting priorities and diverse customer requirements.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience in related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in EDI architecture and development.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with either Oracle EDI/E-Business Suite and Cleo (CIC) is required, experience with both is preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and communication protocols (AS2, FTP/S, API).
  • Prior experience in the EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) or High-Tech Manufacturing industry is a must.
  • Strong grasp of supply chain business processes, including Demand Planning, Manufacturing Operations, and Intercompany transactions.
  • Familiarity with SQL, XML, and JSON; experience with ERP-integrated EDI is essential.
  • Understanding of secure data transmission standards and B2B security best practices.

Why Join Finch

Requirements

  • Fluent English, written and spoken, and comfortable leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders (required).
  • Availability to work with consistent overlap with US business hours. (required)
  • Background managing SEO-driven accounts or hands-on SEO experience (advantage).
  • Experience working with US or international clients (advantage).
